title: Real-Time FJ/MAC PDE Solvers via Tensorized, Back-Propagation-Free Optical PINN Training
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种光学计算加速的PINN训练框架，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学验证。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no FEA validation on structural problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维PDE求解的高能耗与实时性需求
summary_zh.method: 提出基于张量化光神经网络的免反向传播PINN训练框架
summary_zh.result: 20维HJB方程求解能耗仅1.36J，时间1.15s
summary_zh.validation: 通过20维HJB方程的数值仿真验证

summary_en.motivation: To enable near real-time PDE solving with ultra-low energy consumption for resource-constrained applications.
summary_en.method: Proposes a tensorized optical neural network (TONN) with back-propagation-free training and in-situ MZI phase-domain optimization.
summary_en.result: Achieves 1.36 J and 1.15 s to solve a 20-dimensional HJB PDE, with 1.17×10^3 reduction in MZI count.
summary_en.validation: Validated via numerical simulation of a high-dimensional Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman PDE.

summary_zh.motivation: 讨论无骨水泥全膝关节置换术的进展，以实现更持久和生理性的固定。
summary_zh.method: 综述现代植入物设计、多孔金属表面和生物活性涂层（如羟基磷灰石）的创新。

title: PINN surrogate of Li-ion battery models for parameter inference. Part I: Implementation and multi-fidelity hierarchies for the single-particle model
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了PINN替代模型在电池参数推断中的应用，其多保真训练和贝叶斯校准方法可迁移至植入物力学代理模型。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, contact mechanics, or stress shielding; it focuses on Li-ion battery models.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低锂离子电池内部状态诊断的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 用PINN替代物理模型，采用多保真分层训练提高精度
summary_zh.result: 多保真训练显著提升仅基于方程残差训练的代理模型精度
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与全阶模型对比

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost for diagnosing internal states of Li-ion batteries by replacing physics-based models with efficient surrogates.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network (PINN) surrogate is constructed for the single-particle model, employing multi-fidelity hierarchical training to improve accuracy when training only on governing equation residuals.
summary_en.result: Multi-fidelity training significantly improves surrogate accuracy compared to single-fidelity training on equation residuals alone.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks against the full-order single-particle model.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : Illustrative PINN architecture used to enforce spatiotemporal dependencies of the state variables for the single-particle model. PINN inputs are in black rectangles, while outputs are in blue rectangles. White rectangles denote blocks of hidden layers that could be of any type (see Sec. 4.3 ).

title: PG-LBO: Enhancing High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization with Pseudo-Label and Gaussian Process Guidance
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过伪标签和GP引导提升高维贝叶斯优化效率，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有VAE-BO方法未充分利用无标签数据，计算效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出伪标签技术揭示无标签数据的目标值，并用GP引导VAE训练。
summary_zh.result: 在多个高维优化场景中优于现有VAE-BO算法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上对比实验。

summary_en.motivation: Current VAE-BO methods overlook unlabeled data and suffer from computational inefficiency.
summary_en.method: A pseudo-labeling technique assigns training weights to unlabeled data, and Gaussian Process guidance integrates GP accuracy into VAE training.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms existing VAE-BO algorithms on various high-dimensional optimization benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard optimization benchmarks.

why_not_core: This paper does not explicitly analyze stress shielding or fatigue performance, which are key for implant stability assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索仿生Voronoi支架的综合性能，以改善骨植入物的力学与生物学功能。
summary_zh.method: 使用缩放因子算法设计Voronoi支架，并LPBF制造，进行力学测试、有限元分析及体内外实验。
summary_zh.result: Voronoi支架的力学行为和流体特性类似人松质骨，细胞增殖和成骨效果显著。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试、FEA、体内外细胞及动物实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the comprehensive biomechanical and biological properties of biomimetic Voronoi scaffolds for improved bone implant performance.
summary_en.method: Voronoi scaffolds were designed using scaling factor algorithms, fabricated by selective laser melting, and evaluated via mechanical tests, finite element analysis, in vitro, and in vivo experiments.
summary_en.result: Voronoi scaffolds exhibited mechanical behavior and fluid flow similar to trabecular bone, with enhanced cell proliferation and osteogenesis.
summary_en.validation: Validation included mechanical testing, finite element analysis, in vitro cell assays, and in vivo animal models.

title: Targeted materials discovery using Bayesian algorithm execution
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于贝叶斯算法执行的目标材料发现框架，可处理复杂约束和多目标优化，对用户研究中的昂贵仿真采样效率问题具有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on materials discovery with discrete search spaces and does not address continuous design optimization, surrogate modeling for FEA, or biomechanical implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速新材料发现，处理复杂设计目标。
summary_zh.method: 将用户定义的过滤算法自动转化为三种贝叶斯数据采集策略。
summary_zh.result: 在纳米颗粒合成和磁性材料数据集上效率显著优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在两个公开材料数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate materials discovery by efficiently navigating large design spaces with complex, user-defined goals.
summary_en.method: A framework that translates user-defined filtering algorithms into three parameter-free Bayesian data acquisition strategies (SwitchBAX, InfoBAX, MeanBAX).
summary_en.result: The proposed methods achieve significantly higher efficiency than state-of-the-art approaches on TiO2 nanoparticle and magnetic materials datasets.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two materials science datasets with multiple measured physical properties.

title: HyperDeepONet: learning operator with complex target function space using the limited resources via hypernetwork
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的HyperDeepONet通过超网络减少参数，提高算子学习效率，可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics-specific applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低DeepONet在复杂算子学习中的参数和计算成本
summary_zh.method: 利用超网络表达力，以更少参数学习复杂目标函数空间
summary_zh.result: HyperDeepONet在多个基准上以更低资源达到相当或更优精度
summary_zh.validation: 在多个数值算子学习任务上对比DeepONet等模型

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the parameter count and computational cost of DeepONet when learning operators with complex target functions.
summary_en.method: HyperDeepONet leverages a hypernetwork to generate the trunk net weights, enabling efficient representation of complex operators with fewer parameters.
summary_en.result: HyperDeepONet achieves comparable or better accuracy than DeepONet and its variants on several operator learning benchmarks while using significantly fewer computational resources.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on multiple numerical operator learning tasks, including discontinuous and non-smooth target functions, with comparisons to standard DeepONet and other baselines.

title: Make Me a BNN: A Simple Strategy for Estimating Bayesian Uncertainty from Pre-trained Models
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种将预训练DNN转化为BNN的后处理方法，可用于不确定性量化，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on computer vision tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决深度神经网络缺乏可靠不确定性量化的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出ABNN方法，通过附加BNN适配层和微调将预训练DNN转化为BNN
summary_zh.result: 在图像分类和语义分割任务上达到与集成方法相当的不确定性量化性能
summary_zh.validation: 在多个图像数据集上进行分类和分割实验验证

summary_en.motivation: Deep neural networks lack reliable uncertainty quantification, which is critical for real-world applications.
summary_en.method: ABNN transforms pre-trained DNNs into Bayesian neural networks by attaching adaptation layers to normalization layers and fine-tuning with minimal overhead.
summary_en.result: ABNN achieves state-of-the-art uncertainty estimation on image classification and semantic segmentation tasks without the computational cost of ensembles.
summary_en.validation: Extensive experiments on multiple datasets for classification and segmentation tasks demonstrate performance comparable to ensemble methods.

visual.caption: Figure 1 : Illustration of the training process for the ABNN. The procedure begins with training a single DNN 𝝎 MAP \boldsymbol{\mathbf{\omega}}_{\textrm{MAP}} , followed by architectural adjustments to transform it into an ABNN. The final step involves fine-tuning the ABNN model.

title: Efficient training of Gaussian processes with tensor product structure
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的张量积高斯过程训练方法可提高大规模数据下的计算效率，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计中的约束处理与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification for design, or biomechanical/ implant applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 大规模高斯过程超参数优化计算成本高，需高效数值方法。
summary_zh.method: 利用张量列格式表示协方差矩阵，结合AMEn和Krylov子空间方法求解矩阵函数。
summary_zh.result: 提出高效方案计算梯度与目标函数，降低训练复杂度。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上验证了方法的效率与准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of hyperparameter optimization in Gaussian processes with large training datasets.
summary_en.method: Represent the covariance matrix as a sum of Kronecker products in tensor train format and employ AMEn and Krylov subspace methods for matrix function computation.
summary_en.result: An efficient scheme for evaluating the gradient and objective function in hyperparameter optimization is derived.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate the efficiency and accuracy of the proposed method.

title: Effect of laser power on microstructure and mechanical properties of pure Zn fabricated via laser powder bed fusion

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了纯锌LPBF工艺参数对力学性能的影响，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与生物医学植入物的直接相关性较低。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover porous structure design, stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, or surface roughness/osceointegration, which are the core focus of the user's direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究激光功率对LPBF纯锌显微组织和拉伸性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 改变激光功率(40-60W)制备纯锌试样，进行显微组织表征和拉伸测试
summary_zh.result: 提高激光功率增加再结晶程度，提升延展性，60W时综合力学性能最佳
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸实验和微观分析验证工艺-组织-性能关系

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of laser power on the microstructural evolution and tensile properties of pure zinc fabricated via laser powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: Pure Zn samples were fabricated by LPBF with varying laser power (40-60 W) and characterized by microstructural analysis and tensile testing.
summary_en.result: Increasing laser power enhanced recrystallization, reducing KAM and Taylor factor, leading to significant improvement in ductility; optimal mechanical properties were achieved at 60 W.
summary_en.validation: The findings were validated through experimental tensile tests and microstructural observations.

title: Reduced order modelling of fully coupled electro-mechanical systems through invariant manifolds with applications to microstructures
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的降阶建模方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, stress shielding, or uncertainty quantification, and its validation is limited to MEMS rather than biomedical FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决电-机械耦合系统非线性振动的高效降阶建模问题
summary_zh.method: 采用不变流形直接参数化方法，结合混合拉格朗日公式和有限元离散
summary_zh.result: 降阶模型准确恢复主共振的硬化-软化转变及超谐波、参数共振
summary_zh.validation: 与全阶时域积分结果对比验证精度

summary_en.motivation: To develop a reduced-order model for fully coupled electro-mechanical systems undergoing nonlinear vibrations, enabling efficient simulation of MEMS resonators.
summary_en.method: The direct parametrisation method for invariant manifolds is applied to a mixed fully Lagrangian formulation with polynomial nonlinearities, discretized via finite elements.
summary_en.result: The reduced-order model accurately captures hardening-to-softening transition of primary resonance and secondary resonances under electrostatic actuation.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing reduced-order model predictions with full-order time integration simulations on a parallel plate configuration.

title: Hutchinson Trace Estimation for High-Dimensional and High-Order Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过Hutchinson迹估计加速高维高阶PINN的训练，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的高维参数空间采样效率问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on computational efficiency for high-dimensional PDEs without biomedical application.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN在高维高阶PDE中自动微分计算成本过高的问题
summary_zh.method: 引入Hutchinson迹估计，将Hessian矩阵计算转化为Hessian向量积，降低内存和计算开销
summary_zh.result: 在内存和速度约束下与SDGD收敛率相当，并扩展到双调和方程和gPINN
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证收敛性和无偏性，与SDGD对比

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational bottleneck of automatic differentiation in PINNs for high-dimensional and high-order PDEs.
summary_en.method: Introduces Hutchinson Trace Estimation (HTE) to replace full Hessian computation with Hessian-vector products via Taylor-mode automatic differentiation.
summary_en.result: HTE achieves comparable convergence to SDGD under memory and speed constraints, and extends to fourth-order biharmonic equations and gradient-enhanced PINNs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate convergence, unbiasedness, and memory savings compared to SDGD.

title: Deep learning-enabled design for tailored mechanical properties of SLM-manufactured metallic lattice structures

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Industrial Design Engineering, Gazi University, Ankara, 06500, Turkey

relevance_to_user: 这篇论文利用深度学习和SLM制造技术优化晶格结构的力学性能，虽然不直接涉及生物医学应用，但其方法可用于设计具有特定力学性能的骨科植入物多孔结构。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, osseointegration, or fatigue testing for biomedical implants; it uses aluminum alloy (not medical-grade titanium or biocompatible materials) and focuses on compressive/impact properties rather than fatigue or bone-implant interface.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用深度学习优化SLM制造金属晶格结构的力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于3DGAN的晶格设计方法，结合模拟退火数据集，通过SLM制造并进行压缩与冲击测试。
summary_zh.result: 生成的设计相比传统设计能量吸收提升57%，延伸率提升26%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SLM制造实际样品并进行力学测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the challenge of designing SLM-manufactured lattice structures with tailored mechanical properties using deep learning.
summary_en.method: A 3D generative adversarial network (3DGAN) trained on parametric and simulated annealing-derived datasets generates new lattice designs, which are fabricated by selective laser melting and tested mechanically.
summary_en.result: The generated lattice configurations achieve up to 57% higher normalized energy absorption and 26% higher extension compared to conventional designs.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (compression and impact) of SLM-fabricated AlSi10Mg unit cell samples.

title: Packed-Ensemble Surrogate Models for Fluid Flow Estimation Arround Airfoil Geometries
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了Packed-Ensemble方法用于流体动力学代理建模，其高效集成策略可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid flow estimation around airfoil geometries, not on solid mechanics, implant design, or biomechanics; it lacks constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, and biomedical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速流体仿真中昂贵的物理模拟
summary_zh.method: 使用Packed-Ensemble集成方法训练代理模型
summary_zh.result: PE(8,4,1)模型在精度和训练速度上优于Deep Ensemble
summary_zh.validation: 在标准气动数据集上对比多种集成模型性能

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate computationally expensive fluid dynamics simulations by developing efficient data-driven surrogate models.
summary_en.method: Packed-Ensemble, a generalization of Deep Ensembles that reduces training cost, is applied to learn from existing simulation data.
summary_en.result: The PE(8,4,1) configuration outperforms Deep Ensemble in accuracy while reducing training time by 25%.
summary_en.validation: Multiple ensemble models are compared on a standard airfoil flow estimation benchmark.

title: Gaussian process learning of nonlinear dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过高斯过程学习动力学系统，可迁移至代理建模中的不确定性量化，但未直接应用于FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design; it focuses on learning nonlinear dynamics from time series data.

summary_zh.motivation: 从含噪声的稀疏时间序列数据中学习非线性动力学系统
summary_zh.method: 利用高斯过程表示状态，构建状态与导数相关性似然函数，避免显式计算时间导数
summary_zh.result: 通过贝叶斯推断给出模型参数的后验分布，量化不确定性
summary_zh.validation: 在多个典型动力学系统场景（仿射参数化、非线性逼近、一般参数估计）上进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To learn nonlinear dynamical systems from noisy and sparse time series data without explicit derivative computation.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process representation of states is used to construct a likelihood function that correlates state data and their derivatives, enabling Bayesian inference of model parameters.
summary_en.result: The method provides probabilistic parameter estimates via posterior distributions, facilitating uncertainty quantification from noisy data and learning process.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on affine parametrization, nonlinear parametric approximation, and general parameter estimation scenarios demonstrate the method's effectiveness.

title: Dual parametric and state estimation for partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合卡尔曼滤波和降阶模型的PDE状态与参数联合估计方法，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型中的不确定量化与参数识别。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics PDEs (Burgers, Navier-Stokes) and does not address solid mechanics, implant design, or biomedical FEA constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PDE系统中高维状态与未知参数联合实时估计的难题
summary_zh.method: 结合卡尔曼滤波与基于DMD的数据驱动多胞线性降阶模型
summary_zh.result: 在Burgers和Navier-Stokes方程上实现了状态与参数的高精度估计
summary_zh.validation: 通过非线性PDE数值算例验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time joint estimation of high-dimensional states and unknown parameters in PDE-governed systems.
summary_en.method: A Kalman filter combined with a data-driven polytopic linear reduced-order model derived from dynamic mode decomposition (DMD).
summary_en.result: Accurate estimation of both state and unknown physical parameters along trajectories of nonlinear Burgers and Navier-Stokes equations.

summary_zh.result: 流变预测精度达96%，打印线条长度精度达99%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过低/高粘度墨水打印实验验证模型和路径优化。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the printability of biomaterial inks with varying viscosities and optimize the extrusion printing process.
summary_en.method: Response surface methodology was used to predict rheological properties from material components, combined with Latin hypercube sampling and CFD to simulate flow, and pattern path planning to improve print accuracy.
summary_en.result: Prediction accuracy for power-law index reached 96%, and filament length accuracy reached 99% after path optimization.
summary_en.validation: Experimental printing trials with low- and high-viscosity inks validated the predictions and path planning improvements.

title: Controllable Expensive Multi-objective Learning with Warm-starting Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法利用贝叶斯优化和Pareto集学习解决昂贵多目标优化问题，可迁移至生物力学中的代理模型优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve FEA simulations, biomechanics context, or implant design; it is validated on abstract optimization problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有的Pareto集学习方法在处理昂贵黑箱多目标优化时不稳定且效率低。
summary_zh.method: 提出Co-PSL，先通过贝叶斯优化预热获得高斯过程先验，再进行可控Pareto集学习。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实多目标问题中，Co-PSL有效降低昂贵评估次数并支持实时偏好调控。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个无基准函数和实际问题上对比了收敛性和Pareto前沿覆盖度。

summary_en.motivation: Existing Pareto set learning methods suffer from instability and inefficiency when applied to expensive black-box multi-objective optimization problems.
summary_en.method: Co-PSL first uses warm-starting Bayesian optimization to obtain quality Gaussian process priors, then performs controllable Pareto set learning to map preferences to Pareto solutions.
summary_en.result: Co-PSL demonstrates improved stability and efficiency across synthetic and real-world multi-objective optimization benchmarks, reducing expensive function evaluations.
summary_en.validation: Validation was conducted on numerical benchmarks and a real-world engineering problem, comparing against state-of-the-art PSL methods.

title: Bias-Variance Trade-off in Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Randomized Smoothing for High-Dimensional PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效求解高维PDE的PINN方法，可迁移至FEA代理建模，但未涉及植入物力学中的约束和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: Does not address constraints in surrogate-based optimization, lacks explicit uncertainty quantification for design reliability, and is not applied to implant/biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低高维PDE求解中PINN的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 引入高斯噪声随机平滑替代自动微分，并提出偏差校正
summary_zh.result: 混合方法平衡偏差和方差，在多个高维PDE上有效
summary_zh.validation: 在Fokker-Planck、HJB等方程上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of PINNs for high-dimensional PDEs by avoiding costly automatic differentiation.
summary_en.method: Introduces Gaussian noise for randomized smoothing of the neural network to approximate derivatives via Monte Carlo, then proposes bias correction techniques tailored to PDE nonlinearity.
summary_en.result: A hybrid method combining biased and unbiased versions balances rapid convergence and high accuracy, validated on several high-dimensional PDEs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on Fokker-Planck, HJB, viscous Burgers', Allen-Cahn, and Sine-Gordon equations demonstrate the bias-variance trade-off.

title: One-Shot Transfer Learning for Nonlinear ODEs
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过一次性迁移学习解决非线性ODE，可被迁移至代理模型以加速植入物设计的仿真，但未直接涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No application to biomechanics or implant design, no handling of constraints or uncertainty quantification, and not demonstrated on FEA-style problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解同一类非线性ODE族而无需重复训练
summary_zh.method: 结合微扰法与一次迁移学习，将非线性ODE线性化后训练单一PINN
summary_zh.result: 对族内新实例可直接给出封闭形式解，避免重训练
summary_zh.validation: 在Duffing方程上验证数值精度与泛化能力

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve a family of nonlinear ODEs without retraining for each new instance.
summary_en.method: Combines perturbation method with one-shot transfer learning, transforming nonlinear ODEs into linear systems and training a single Physics-Informed Neural Network.
summary_en.result: Yields a closed-form solution for any new instance within the same nonlinear ODE class, eliminating re-training.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated on the Duffing equation with numerical accuracy and generalization assessment.

title: Microstructural Characteristics and Material Failure Mechanism of SLM Ti-6Al-4V-Zn Alloy
first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, National Cheng Kung University, Tainan 701, Taiwan

corresponding_authors.name: Fei‐Yi Hung
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Materials Science and Engineering, National Cheng Kung University, Tainan 701, Taiwan

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM Ti-6Al-4V-Zn合金的微观结构和力学性能，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮蔽或骨整合，对用户方向参考价值有限。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structure, stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration—key aspects of AM biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过锌掺杂改善SLM Ti-6Al-4V合金的强度与塑性
summary_zh.method: 采用选择性激光熔化制备Ti-6Al-4V-0.3Zn合金，并施加不同真空热处理
summary_zh.result: 800-4-FC热处理试样获得最佳综合力学性能
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、冲击、高温拉伸及微观表征验证

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the strength and ductility of SLM-fabricated Ti-6Al-4V via zinc microalloying.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting of Ti-6Al-4V with 0.3 wt.% Zn followed by various vacuum heat treatments.
summary_en.result: The 800-4-FC condition yielded the best overall mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (tensile, impact, high-temperature tensile) and microstructural analysis.

title: Deep encoder-decoder hierarchical convolutional neural networks for conjugate heat transfer surrogate modeling
relevance_to_user: 该方法针对计算密集型共轭传热问题构建代理模型，可迁移至生物力学中替代有限元分析，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification, which are central to the user's FEA surrogate direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 共轭传热仿真计算昂贵，限制设计优化应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出深度编码器-解码器层级卷积神经网络，耦合速度与温度场进行两阶段预测。
summary_zh.result: 在冷板电池热管理案例中，R²相比U-Net等方法提升高达65%。
summary_zh.validation: 基于1500组有限元仿真数据评估模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity conjugate heat transfer simulations are computationally prohibitive for design optimization requiring many evaluations.
summary_en.method: A modular deep encoder-decoder hierarchical convolutional neural network (DeepEDH) is developed, coupling velocity and temperature fields in a two-stage prediction architecture.
summary_en.result: On a liquid-cooled cold-plate battery thermal management system, the proposed surrogate achieves up to 65% improvement in R² over U-Net and DenseED baselines.
summary_en.validation: Performance is validated on a dataset of 1,500 FEM simulations with analysis of architectural choices and boundary condition effects.

title: Data-driven Prior Learning for Bayesian Optimisation
relevance_to_user: 该方法在贝叶斯优化中通过先验学习提高了采样效率，可迁移到FEA代理模型的优化，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP variance, or biomechanics/implant design context; validation is only on synthetic and air pollution benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过先验学习提高贝叶斯优化在少量评估下的效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出PLeBO方法，从相似任务学习高斯过程超参数先验，仅假设地形相似。
summary_zh.result: 在合成数据和空气污染优化中，PLeBO以更少评估找到更优解。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成基准和空气污染问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve Bayesian optimisation efficiency by learning priors for Gaussian process hyperparameters from related tasks with a weaker similarity assumption.
summary_en.method: Proposes PLeBO, which transfers knowledge by learning hyperparameter priors across tasks assuming only a similar optimisation landscape shape, not identical optima.
summary_en.result: PLeBO achieves better optimisation performance with fewer function evaluations compared to standard BO and other transfer approaches.
summary_en.validation: Numerically validated on synthetic benchmarks and an air pollution optimisation problem.

title: Physics Informed Neural Network Framework for Unsteady Discretized Reduced Order System
relevance_to_user: 提出一种基于降阶模型的物理信息神经网络方法，可潜在迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模。
why_not_core: No application to implant/biomechanics design, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, and validation only on fluid/rigid-body dynamics benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高物理信息神经网络在数据稀疏时的训练效率和泛化能力。
summary_zh.method: 将离散化降阶残差作为损失惩罚项，结合ANN或LSTM进行训练。
summary_zh.result: 在俯仰-浮沉翼型和Burgers方程上验证了该方法在小样本下的预测能力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例与标准有限差分结果对比验证精度。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the training efficiency and generalization of PINNs under sparse data conditions by incorporating residuals from a discretized reduced-order system.
summary_en.method: A PINN framework is developed that uses the residual of a POD-Galerkin reduced-order discretized system as an additional loss term, combined with ANN or LSTM networks.
summary_en.result: The proposed method demonstrates accurate prediction for a pitch-plunge airfoil and Burgers' equation even with very limited data.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical benchmarks comparing predictions to standard finite difference solutions.

title: Quantitative Biofabrication Platform for Collagen‐Based Peripheral Nerve Grafts with Structural and Chemical Guidance
first_author_affiliation: Institutes for Robotics and Intelligent Manufacturing Chinese Academy of Sciences  Shenyang 110169 China

corresponding_authors.name: Xiongfei Zheng
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institutes for Robotics and Intelligent Manufacturing Chinese Academy of Sciences  Shenyang 110169 China

corresponding_authors.name: Jinghui Huang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedics Xijing Hospital The Fourth Military Medical University  Xi'an 710032 China

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了基于胶原的神经移植物定量生物制造平台，但没有集成人工智能或机器学习方法。
why_not_core: This paper presents a bioprinting platform with computational modeling but does not embed AI/ML into any bioprinting workflow stage, lacking data-driven or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发定量生物制造平台，构建具有结构及化学引导的胶原神经移植物。
summary_zh.method: 建立胶原粘弹性模型和梯度打印控制模型，实现高精度微通道和NGF梯度分布。
summary_zh.result: 生物打印移植物在体外和体内有效引导线性轴突生长。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验和动物体内植入验证神经引导效果。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a quantitative biofabrication platform for constructing collagen-based peripheral nerve grafts that incorporate bionic structural and chemical guidance cues.
summary_en.method: A viscoelastic model for collagen relaxation and a gradient printing control model were established to fabricate grafts with high-density microchannels and precise nerve growth factor gradients.
summary_en.result: The bioprinted grafts successfully guided linear axonal regeneration both in vitro and in vivo.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using in vitro axonal growth assays and in vivo implantation in animal models.

title: Multi-fidelity Bayesian Optimization: A Review
relevance_to_user: 该综述直接针对多保真贝叶斯优化方法，适用于昂贵仿真采样问题，但缺乏具体实现和验证。
why_not_core: This paper is a review without new experiments or specific FEA/constraint handling implementations, and does not address biomechanics implant design directly.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述多保真贝叶斯优化方法，解决昂贵仿真优化问题
summary_zh.method: 分类并概述GP-based多保真代理模型与采集函数
summary_zh.result: 总结现有方法并指出未来方向如约束优化与不确定性处理
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，纯文献综述

summary_en.motivation: To provide a comprehensive review of multi-fidelity Bayesian optimization methods for expensive engineering design optimization.
summary_en.method: The paper categorizes and describes Gaussian process-based multi-fidelity surrogate models and various acquisition functions.
summary_en.result: The review summarizes existing MF BO methods and identifies future research directions including constrained, high-dimensional, and uncertainty-aware optimization.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; this is a literature survey.

title: Enhancing Solutions for Complex PDEs: Introducing Complementary Convolution and Equivariant Attention in Fourier Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过提升神经网络算子对高频成分的捕捉能力来加速PDE求解，可用于用户方向中的代理建模，但缺乏约束处理、不确定性量化及生物力学验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or demonstrate transferability to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服FNO在复杂PDE中的低频偏差，提升高频分量捕捉能力
summary_zh.method: 引入互补卷积层和等变注意力机制构建分层FNO架构
summary_zh.result: 在多尺度椭圆方程与Navier-Stokes方程上性能优越
summary_zh.validation: 通过前向和逆向PDE数值基准测试验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the low-frequency bias of standard Fourier neural operators when solving complex PDEs with rapid coefficient variations.
summary_en.method: Proposes a hierarchical Fourier neural operator with complementary convolution and equivariant attention to capture high-frequency components effectively.
summary_en.result: Achieves superior performance on multiscale elliptic equations, Navier-Stokes equations, and other physical benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated through extensive numerical experiments on forward and inverse PDE benchmarks.

title: $p$-multilevel Monte Carlo for acoustic scattering from large deviation rough random surfaces
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的p-多重蒙特卡洛方法可用于不确定度量化，但应用场景为声学散射，而非植入物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant biomechanics; it focuses on acoustic scattering UQ.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化低规则粗糙随机表面声波散射的不确定性
summary_zh.method: 采用p-多重蒙特卡洛和高阶多项式逼近变形场
summary_zh.result: 证明p-MLMC对大偏差粗糙随机表面高效
summary_zh.validation: 三维复杂散射几何数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To quantify uncertainty in acoustic scattering from rough random surfaces with low Sobolev regularity.
summary_en.method: A p-multilevel Monte Carlo method combined with higher-order polynomial approximation of the deformation field via barycentric interpolation.
summary_en.result: The p-MLMC method is shown to be efficient for large deviation rough random surfaces, enabling accurate UQ with reduced computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments in three dimensions on a complex scattering geometry.

title: Predictions of Transient Vector Solution Fields with Sequential Deep Operator Network
relevance_to_user: 该方法可在瞬态向量场（如流体、塑性载荷）上实现高精度代理建模，并有助于迁移到植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真加速。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no explicit constraint handling, and no application to implant or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高瞬态向量场求解效率
summary_zh.method: 扩展序贯DeepONet同时预测多分量解
summary_zh.result: 高精度且加速显著，R²>0.99
summary_zh.validation: 流体与塑性加载数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate transient vector field predictions by developing a surrogate model.
summary_en.method: Extends sequential DeepONet to predict multiple solution components simultaneously with a modified branch-trunk combination.
summary_en.result: Achieves R² above 0.99 and inference speedup over three orders of magnitude on transient fluid flow and path-dependent plastic loading.
summary_en.validation: Tested on two example problems (fluid flow and plastic loading) with numerical benchmarks and comparison against direct numerical simulations.

title: Ni–Ti multicell interlacing Gyroid lattice structures with ultra-high hyperelastic response fabricated by laser powder bed fusion
venue: International Journal of Machine Tools and Manufacture
first_author_affiliation: School of Transportation and Logistics Engineering, Wuhan University of Technology, Wuhan, China

corresponding_authors.name: Lei Yang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Transportation and Logistics Engineering, Wuhan University of Technology, Wuhan, China

corresponding_authors.name: Chunze Yan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: State Key Laboratory of Materials Processing and Die & Mould Technology, School of Materials Science and Engineering, Huazhong University of Science and Technology, Wuhan, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了Ni-Ti形状记忆合金Gyroid点阵结构的超弹性性能，但未涉及应力遮挡、骨整合等生物医学植入物关键问题。
why_not_core: Does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, and does not report surface roughness, as-built morphology, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索Ni-Ti形状记忆合金多孔点阵的超弹性性能与结构设计
summary_zh.method: 采用激光粉末床熔融制备多单元交织Gyroid点阵，进行准静态与循环压缩测试
summary_zh.result: 该结构实现了高达8%的可恢复应变和优异的能量吸收能力
summary_zh.validation: 通过X射线显微成像与SEM表征变形机制

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the ultra-high hyperelastic response of Ni-Ti shape memory alloy lattice structures fabricated by laser powder bed fusion.
summary_en.method: Multicell interlacing Gyroid lattice structures were designed and fabricated via LPBF, then subjected to quasi-static and cyclic compression tests with in-situ X-ray tomography.
summary_en.result: The structures achieved fully recoverable strain up to 8% and exhibited outstanding energy absorption under cyclic loading.
summary_en.validation: Deformation mechanisms were validated through micro-CT imaging and SEM fractography.

title: Neural Dynamical Operator: Continuous Spatial-Temporal Model with Gradient-Based and Derivative-Free Optimization Methods
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经动力学算子及混合优化方法可用于生物力学代理模型中的长时程统计预测，但未直接应用于植入物设计或FEA仿真。
why_not_core: No FEA or biomechanics application, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发同时具有空间和时间连续性的数据驱动模型，处理不同分辨率数据。
summary_zh.method: 提出神经动力学算子框架，结合梯度与无梯度混合优化方法。
summary_zh.result: 模型具有分辨率不变性，仅用短时数据实现稳定长时统计预测。
summary_zh.validation: 在粘性Burgers、Navier-Stokes和Kuramoto-Sivashinsky方程上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a continuous spatial-temporal data-driven model that leverages information from multi-resolution data and improves long-term prediction.
summary_en.method: The neural dynamical operator framework integrates gradient-based and derivative-free optimization to train on both short-term trajectories and long-term statistics.
summary_en.result: The model achieves resolution-invariance and stable long-term simulations using only short-term data, with improved long-term statistics via hybrid optimization.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three numerical PDE benchmarks: viscous Burgers, Navier-Stokes, and Kuramoto-Sivashinsky equations.

title: LABCAT: Locally adaptive Bayesian optimization using principal-component-aligned trust regions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出一种改进的贝叶斯优化算法，可应用于替代模型的采样优化，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学领域。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification beyond GP length-scales, and no validation on FEA or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决贝叶斯优化在非平稳、病态目标函数上的局限性。
summary_zh.method: 提出LABCAT算法，通过主成分对齐信任区域和自适应缩放改进局部优化。
summary_zh.result: 在合成函数和COCO基准上优于多种先进优化算法。
summary_zh.validation: 基于标准测试函数和COCO软件进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address shortcomings of Bayesian optimization including poor convergence on non-stationary or ill-conditioned functions.
summary_en.method: Proposes LABCAT, which rotates trust regions using weighted principal components and adapts their scale based on local GP length-scales with ARD.
summary_en.result: Outperforms several state-of-the-art black-box optimization algorithms on synthetic functions and the COCO benchmark.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard test functions and the COCO benchmarking software.

title: BOIS: Bayesian Optimization of Interconnected Systems
relevance_to_user: 该方法可转移到植入物/生物力学设计的代理建模和不确定性量化，但未涉及约束处理或具体生物医学验证。
why_not_core: It does not handle constraints (only unconstrained optimization), and the validation is on a chemical process case study without implant or biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准BO将系统视为黑盒，无法利用结构知识；复合函数BO存在采样计算量大的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应线性化方法，获得复合函数统计矩的闭式表达式，从而高效利用结构知识。
summary_zh.result: 在化学过程优化案例中，BOIS在性能上优于标准BO和采样方法，并准确捕捉复合函数统计数据。
summary_zh.validation: 通过与标准BO和采样方法对比的数值案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard Bayesian optimization treats systems as black boxes, failing to exploit structural knowledge; composite function approaches suffer from high sampling cost.
summary_en.method: This work introduces adaptive linearizations of the composite function to obtain closed-form statistical moments, enabling efficient exploitation of structural knowledge in BO.
summary_en.result: In a chemical process optimization case study, BOIS outperforms standard BO and sampling approaches, accurately capturing the statistics of composite functions.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through numerical benchmarking against standard BO and sampling approaches on a chemical process case study.

title: RONAALP: Reduced-Order Nonlinear Approximation with Active Learning Procedure
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一种主动学习降阶代理建模框架，可迁移至生物力学有限元分析中的昂贵仿真替代，但未涉及不确定性量化与约束处理。
why_not_core: The paper does not include uncertainty quantification or constraint handling, and its demonstration is limited to hypersonic flows rather than implant/biomechanics FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低高维非线性工程仿真的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 结合非线性自编码器、社区聚类和径向基网络，并通过主动学习处理外推问题
summary_zh.result: 在化学非平衡高超声速流仿真中降低75%成本，误差低于10%
summary_zh.validation: 基于直接数值仿真的算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of expensive high-dimensional nonlinear simulations in engineering.
summary_en.method: A reduced-order surrogate model combining nonlinear autoencoder, community clustering, and radial basis function networks with an active learning procedure to handle extrapolation.
summary_en.result: Achieved up to 75% cost reduction with less than 10% error on relevant quantities of interest for hypersonic flow simulations.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated on direct numerical simulations of hypersonic flows in chemical nonequilibrium.

title: Equivariant Neural Operator Learning with Graphon Convolution
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的等变神经算子可用于3D函数映射学习，可能迁移至植入物力学的代理建模，但缺乏不确定量化和约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not include FEA validation, uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or any biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 学习三维欧氏空间中具有SE(3)等变性的连续函数映射。
summary_zh.method: 结合系数学习与残差算子层，基于图卷积解释为图卷积网络。
summary_zh.result: 在大规模电子密度数据集上显著优于当前最优架构。
summary_zh.validation: 通过电子密度数据集和消融实验验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: To learn SE(3)-equivariant mappings between continuous functions in 3D Euclidean space. The paper proposes a general architecture that combines coefficient learning with a residual operator layer.
summary_en.method: The proposed InfGCN model leverages both graphon and graph structures, achieving SE(3)-equivariance by design through convolution on dense graphs with infinitely many nodes.
summary_en.result: The model significantly outperforms state-of-the-art architectures on large-scale electron density datasets, with ablation studies confirming the effectiveness of each component.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on large-scale electron density datasets using comparative benchmarks and ablation studies.

relevance_to_user: 该综述讨论了髋关节植入物的力学问题和设计创新，但未提供定量应力或微动分析。
why_not_core: This paper is a review that does not present any quantification of proximal femur stress/strain in Gruen zones, micromotion values, or patient-specific FE modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述髋关节植入物力学和性能参数，以解决应力遮挡和微动问题。
summary_zh.method: 通过文献分析，分类评估不同植入物几何设计的力学性能。
summary_zh.result: 提出带多孔晶格和梯度材料的领状柄以及螺旋/齿轮形接头以减少磨损和增强稳定性。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，基于文献调研和假设提出方案。

summary_en.motivation: To review the mechanics and performance parameters of hip implants with novel geometries to address stress shielding and micromotion.
summary_en.method: The authors categorize existing hip implants based on stem and joint design and analyze their mechanical performance through literature synthesis.
summary_en.result: A collared stem with porous lattice FGM and a spiral/gear-shaped thread joint are hypothesized to reduce wear and enhance stability.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is provided; the paper is a literature review with proposed hypotheses.

title: Adaptive space-time model order reduction with dual-weighted residual (MORe DWR) error control for poroelasticity
relevance_to_user: 该方法基于模型降阶和误差控制，可迁移至植入物生物力学模拟中提高计算效率。
why_not_core: It does not handle constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant-specific validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高多孔弹性问题中全阶模型求解的计算效率。
summary_zh.method: 基于目标导向自适应POD的时空模型降阶方法，结合对偶加权残差误差估计。
summary_zh.result: 在曼德尔基准和三维地基问题中验证了降阶效率和精度。
summary_zh.validation: 二维和三维数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of full-order simulations for poroelasticity problems in porous media.
summary_en.method: A space-time model order reduction with goal-oriented adaptive POD and dual-weighted residual error control.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrated efficiency and accuracy on the Mandel benchmark and a 3D footing problem.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks in 2D and 3D.

title: Overcoming the Size Limit of First Principles Molecular Dynamics Simulations with an In-Distribution Substructure Embedding Active Learner
relevance_to_user: 该方法中的主动学习与不确定性量化策略可迁移至骨骼植入物有限元代理模型的构建，但需适配连续介质力学场景。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on molecular dynamics and quantum-scale force fields, lacking continuum FEA, structural constraints, and implant biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服第一性原理分子动力学模拟的尺寸限制。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于子结构嵌入的主动学习器，高效训练机器学习力场代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 实现亚线性复杂度，加速模拟数千倍至数百万倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在分子动力学基准和大规模实际体系上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the prohibitive computational cost of first principles molecular dynamics for large systems by building an efficient surrogate model.
summary_en.method: Proposes an In-Distribution substructure Embedding Active Learner (IDEAL) that uses uncertainty-driven sampling from substructures to train a machine learning force field.
summary_en.result: Achieves sub-linear complexity and accelerates simulations by thousands to millions of times compared to conventional methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard molecular dynamics benchmarks and demonstrated on a million-atom polycrystalline lithium system and a Haber-Bosch reaction on a nanoparticle catalyst.

title: Moving Sampling Physics-informed Neural Networks induced by Moving Mesh PDE
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过移动网格PDE自适应生成采样点，可提高PINN求解效率，但未直接应用于植入物或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraints handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design scenarios.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高物理信息神经网络中采样点的质量与求解效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于移动网格PDE的端到端自适应采样网络MMPDE-Net。
summary_zh.result: 与PINN结合后的MS-PINN在数值实验中表现出更优精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过四个典型数值算例对比验证了方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Improve the efficiency and accuracy of physics-informed neural networks by adaptively generating high-quality sampling points.
summary_en.method: Propose an end-to-end adaptive sampling network MMPDE-Net that generates sampling points by solving a moving mesh PDE, integrated with PINN to form MS-PINN.
summary_en.result: MS-PINN achieves lower approximation error than standard PINN across four benchmark numerical examples.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on four typical PDE examples, with error analysis under theoretical assumptions.

title: Mechanical Properties and Deformation Behaviors of Layered‐Hybrid Lattice Structure Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting
first_author_affiliation: School of Aeronautics Chongqing Jiaotong University  Chongqing 400074 China

corresponding_authors.name: Yi Ren
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Aeronautics Chongqing Jiaotong University  Chongqing 400074 China

corresponding_authors.name: Wei Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Chongqing Key Laboratory of Green Aviation Energy and Power  Chongqing 401130 China

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及选择性激光熔化制备的层状混合晶格结构的力学性能，与生物医学植入物的刚度匹配和应力遮挡相关，但未直接针对生物医学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not include biomedical context, fatigue testing, stress shielding analysis, or osseointegration evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究层厚对混合晶格结构力学性能与变形行为的影响。
summary_zh.method: 用SLM制备不同层厚BCC/FCC混合晶格，进行准静态压缩实验。
summary_zh.result: 弹性模量、屈服强度和抗压强度随层厚增加而增大，变形模式包括剪切带和阶梯状带。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM观察微观形貌，准静态压缩实验验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of layer thickness on the mechanical properties and deformation behaviors of layered-hybrid lattice structures fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Three types of LHLS with varying BCC and FCC layer thicknesses were manufactured via SLM using Ti-6Al-4V powder, and quasi-static compression tests were conducted.
summary_en.result: Elastic modulus, yield strength, and ultimate compressive strength increased with layer thickness; deformation modes included 45° shear bands and step-like bands depending on layer thickness.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through quasi-static compression experiments and microstructural characterization via SEM and optical microscopy.

title: Probabilistic Physics-integrated Neural Differentiable Modeling for Isothermal Chemical Vapor Infiltration Process
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用物理集成神经网络与不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学FEA替代建模，但未涉及骨植入物设计。
why_not_core: Does not address implant biomechanics, bone remodeling, or structural FEA surrogate; applied to manufacturing process modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: CVI工艺优化因数据稀少且耗时长而极具挑战
summary_zh.method: 采用带不确定性量化的物理集成神经网络可微PiNDiff框架
summary_zh.result: 模型能准确预测致密化过程，适用于稀疏数据场景
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成与真实制造业数据的数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: Optimizing the isothermal CVI process is difficult due to limited experimental data and long cycle times.
summary_en.method: A probabilistic physics-integrated neural differentiable (PiNDiff) model with uncertainty quantification is developed.
summary_en.result: The proposed model accurately predicts densification dynamics under sparse data and incomplete physics.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical experiments on synthetic and real-world manufacturing datasets.

key_terms.zh: 物理集成神经网络可微模型

title: Novel models for fatigue life prediction under wideband random loads based on machine learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于机器学习的疲劳寿命预测方法可迁移至植入物疲劳分析，但未涉及生物力学或人体植入物。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, patient-specific geometry, or FEA of biomedical devices.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高宽带随机载荷下疲劳寿命预测的精度
summary_zh.method: 基于SVM、GPR和ANN三种机器学习模型建立预测模型
summary_zh.result: ANN模型在疲劳寿命预测中表现最佳，优于传统频域方法
summary_zh.validation: 通过蒙特卡洛数值模拟验证模型精度

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy of fatigue life prediction under wideband random loading conditions.
summary_en.method: Three machine learning models (SVM, GPR, ANN) were trained on power spectra and material properties to predict fatigue life.
summary_en.result: The ANN model outperformed traditional frequency-domain methods and the other ML models in prediction accuracy.
summary_en.validation: The models were validated using extensive Monte Carlo numerical simulations.

title: Bayesian Calibration and Uncertainty Quantification of a Rate-dependent Cohesive Zone Model for Polymer Interfaces
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯校准和不确定性量化方法可用于植入物生物力学有限元代理模型的参数标定，但未直接针对植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on polymer interfaces and does not address surrogate modeling for implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效校准聚合物界面速率相关的内聚力模型参数并量化不确定性。
summary_zh.method: 采用模块化贝叶斯方法结合高斯过程差异函数进行参数校准和模型不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 引入差异函数显著提高了模型预测精度，并提供了置信区间。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验数据对聚合物界面断裂进行反演校准。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently calibrate parameters of a rate-dependent cohesive zone model for polymer interfaces and quantify uncertainties.
summary_en.method: A modular Bayesian approach with a Gaussian process discrepancy function is employed for inverse parameter estimation and model uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: Introducing a discrepancy function improves model predictions, and confidence intervals are provided for overall uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Inverse calibration using experimental data from polymer interface fracture tests.

title: In-situ Printability Maps (IPM): A new approach for in-situ printability assessment with application to extrusion-based bioprinting
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Via La Masa, 1, 20156, Milano, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Bianca Maria Colosimo
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Politecnico di Milano, Via La Masa, 1, 20156, Milano, Italy

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了基于概率的原位可打印性图谱方法，但未使用AI技术，仅作为生物打印过程优化的背景参考。
why_not_core: Paper does not integrate AI/ML into the bioprinting workflow; it uses a statistical probabilistic approach without experimental validation or autonomous decision-making.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少生物打印试验次数，快速评估可打印性
summary_zh.method: 基于原位质量数据的概率性可打印性图谱方法
summary_zh.result: 实现过程参数窗口快速评价与鲁棒优化
summary_zh.validation: 基于示例数据展示，未进行真实生物打印实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce experimental campaigns in extrusion-based bioprinting by providing a rapid printability assessment method that can adapt to different bioinks and geometries.
summary_en.method: The paper proposes in-situ printability maps (IPM) based on a probabilistic approach that uses in-situ quality data and defines acceptable deviations from nominal geometry.
summary_en.result: The IPM enables visualization of process domain boundaries, acceptable regions, and their sensitivity to variations, facilitating robust process optimization and material printability assessment.
summary_en.validation: The method is demonstrated with reference to extrusion-based bioprinting but the abstract does not specify experimental validation; it appears to be a simulation-based or conceptual illustration.

title: High-dimensional mixed-categorical Gaussian processes with application to multidisciplinary design optimization for a green aircraft
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的混合类别高斯过程降维方法虽可迁移至植入物代理建模，但未涉及生物力学具体问题。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply to implant/biomechanics design, no contact mechanics, no stress shielding analysis, no patient-specific geometry.

summary_zh.motivation: 混合类别高斯过程超参数过多，需降维。
summary_zh.method: 基于偏最小二乘回归的维度缩减算法。
summary_zh.result: 在悬臂梁和绿色飞机优化中验证，燃油消耗减少439公斤。
summary_zh.validation: 数值算例验证，包括结构和多学科优化案例。

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional hyperparameters in mixed-categorical Gaussian processes hinder efficiency, motivating a dimension reduction technique.
summary_en.method: A partial least squares regression-based algorithm generalizes classical dimension reduction to mixed-categorical inputs within Gaussian processes.
summary_en.result: The method significantly reduces fuel consumption (439 kg) in a green aircraft multidisciplinary optimization, while also validated on a cantilever beam.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks including structural and multidisciplinary design optimization scenarios demonstrate the method's effectiveness.

title: Fast and Reliable Reduced-Order Models for Cardiac Electrophysiology
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的自适应降阶模型方法可迁移到骨骼植入物力学仿真的代理模型构建中。
why_not_core: Does not address implant mechanics, constraint handling, or design optimization in biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 心脏电生理模拟计算成本高，需要高效代理模型。
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应投影降阶模型，集成后验误差估计和贪婪参数采样。
summary_zh.result: 在三个基准模型上验证了方法的效率、精度和泛化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个基准数值模型进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: The high computational cost of cardiac electrophysiology simulations motivates the need for efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: An adaptive projection-based reduced-order model is developed, incorporating an a posteriori error estimator and greedy parameter sampling.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates efficiency, accuracy, and generalization ability on three benchmark models.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on three standard models were used for validation.

title: 3D printed dental implants with a porous structure: The in vitro response of osteoblasts, fibroblasts, mesenchymal stem cells, and monocytes
first_author_affiliation: Department of Medical, Oral and Biotechnological Sciences, University "G. d'Annunzio" Chieti-Pescara, Via dei Vestini, 31, Chieti 66100, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Emira D’Amico
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Medical, Oral and Biotechnological Sciences, University "G. d'Annunzio" Chieti-Pescara, Via dei Vestini, 31, Chieti 66100, Italy. Electronic address: emira.damico@unich.it

relevance_to_user: 提供了LPBF牙种植体的生物学验证，但缺乏机械测试和应力遮挡分析，可补充生物相容性数据
why_not_core: No mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, and no quantification of implant-bone interface mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 表征3D打印牙种植体表面形貌并评估其生物学响应
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备多孔钛合金种植体，经酸蚀处理，进行多种细胞实验
summary_zh.result: 多孔表面促进成骨细胞增殖、胶原生成及M2巨噬细胞极化
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞培养结合SEM、基因表达分析

summary_en.motivation: To characterize the surface topography of a novel 3D-printed dental implant and evaluate its osteogenic, angiogenic, and immunogenic responses in vitro.
summary_en.method: A Ti-6Al-4V implant was fabricated via selective laser melting and organic acid etching, then compared with a machined surface using cell proliferation, morphology, gene expression, and collagen assays.
summary_en.result: The porous acid-etched surface enhanced human osteoblast growth, osteogenic gene expression, and M2 macrophage polarization relative to the machined control.
summary_en.validation: In vitro assays with four human cell types (hOBs, hGFs, hAD-MSCs, monocytes) and SEM characterization.

title: Optimal simulation-based Bayesian decisions
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过主动学习代理模型实现高效贝叶斯决策，可迁移至生物力学设计优化中的昂贵仿真问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not specifically address FEA simulations or biomechanics design; it presents a general Bayesian decision framework without constraints handling or implant-related context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高不可处理似然下贝叶斯决策的计算效率。
summary_zh.method: 学习期望效用的代理模型，结合主动学习和贝叶斯优化。
summary_zh.result: 所需模拟次数比后验推理还少，比蒙特卡洛方法快100-1000倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上验证了模拟效率。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient Bayesian decision making under intractable likelihoods with expensive simulations.
summary_en.method: A surrogate model for expected utility is learned via active learning with Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: The framework requires fewer simulations than posterior inference alone and is 100-1000 times more efficient than Monte Carlo methods.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated on numerical benchmarks showing simulation efficiency.

title: Solving High Frequency and Multi-Scale PDEs with Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用高斯过程求解高频多尺度偏微分方程，可迁移到生物力学FEA替代模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency or surrogate construction for FEA, and lacks biomedical or implant-specific context.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服PINN求解高频多尺度PDE时的谱偏差问题
summary_zh.method: 用学生t或高斯混合模化解功率谱，通过逆傅里叶变换得到协方差函数，并利用Kronecker积实现高阶点高效计算
summary_zh.result: 提出GP框架在系统实验中展示了对高频多尺度PDE的求解优势
summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准PDE算例上验证精度与效率

summary_en.motivation: To overcome spectral bias in PINNs when solving high-frequency and multi-scale PDEs.
summary_en.method: Models the power spectrum of the PDE solution with a student t or Gaussian mixture, obtains the covariance via inverse Fourier transform, and enables efficient computation on grid collocation points using Kronecker product structure.
summary_en.result: The proposed GP framework demonstrates advantage over PINNs in solving high-frequency and multi-scale PDEs in systematic experiments.
summary_en.validation: Validated on multiple benchmark PDE problems with comparison to baseline methods.

title: Evaluating Uncertainty Quantification approaches for Neural PDEs in scientific applications
relevance_to_user: 该论文评估了神经偏微分方程的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的置信度评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply UQ methods to biomechanics or implant design, nor does it address constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估神经PDE在科学应用中不确定性量化方法的可信度
summary_zh.method: 在Burgers和Navier-Stokes方程上比较HMC、MCD和Deep Ensembles的UQ效果
summary_zh.result: 神经PDE能重建流场，但贝叶斯方法比Deep Ensembles更自信（低估不确定性）
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个标准PDE数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To assess the trustworthiness of Neural PDEs for scientific applications under sparse/noisy data and modeling approximations.
summary_en.method: Evaluates Bayesian methods (HMC, MCD) and Deep Ensembles for UQ on Burgers' and Navier-Stokes equations.
summary_en.result: Neural PDEs effectively reconstruct systems and predict parameters, but Bayesian methods exhibit overconfidence compared to Deep Ensembles.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on two canonical PDE test cases.

title: A Hierarchical Spatial Transformer for Massive Point Samples in Continuous Space
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的分层空间变压器和不确定性量化方法可移植到有限元替代建模中，以提高处理大规模空间点数据的效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or optimization; it focuses on general spatial point data processing without any implant or biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 处理连续空间中大规模不规则点样本的高效建模需求

title: Optimize the pore size-pore distribution-pore geometry-porosity of 3D-printed porous tantalum to obtain optimal critical bone defect repair capability.
first_author_affiliation: Biomaterials Laboratory of the Medical Device Inspection Institute, National Institutes for Food and Drug Control, Beijing, China; School of Material Science and Engineering, Beihang University, Beijing, China.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Shenzhen Dazhou Medical Technology Co., Ltd., Shenzhen, Guangdong, China; School of Mechanical and Automobile Engineering, Qingdao University of Technology, Qingdao, Shandong, China. Electronic address: yangjz@qut.edu.cn.

corresponding_authors.name: Yan Li
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Material Science and Engineering, Beihang University, Beijing, China. Electronic address: liyan@buaa.edu.cn.
