corresponding_authors.affiliation: Biomaterials Laboratory of the Medical Device Inspection Institute, National Institutes for Food and Drug Control, Beijing, China. Electronic address: xujianxia@nifdc.org.cn.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了多孔钽支架的孔径结构对骨缺损修复的影响，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能，与用户关注的AM生物医用植入体力学匹配方向关联较弱。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on biological osteogenesis and bone ingrowth rather than stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue performance, or as-built surface roughness, which are central to the user's direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化3D打印多孔钽的孔结构以修复临界骨缺损
summary_zh.method: 使用LPBF制备六种不同孔结构的钽支架，进行体外细胞实验和兔髁骨缺损体内实验
summary_zh.result: 仿生小梁结构（孔径200-1200μm，孔隙率70%）具有最佳骨修复能力
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞增殖分化和体内兔模型骨整合分析

summary_en.motivation: To determine the optimal pore structure of 3D-printed porous tantalum scaffolds for repairing critical-sized bone defects.
summary_en.method: Porous tantalum scaffolds with six different pore architectures were fabricated via powder bed laser melting, and their effects on osteoblast behavior and in vivo bone regeneration were systematically evaluated.
summary_en.result: The biomimetic trabecular structure with a pore size distribution of 200–1200 μm, average pore size of 700 μm, and porosity of 70% exhibited the highest osteogenic gene expression and bone ingrowth area after 16 weeks.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays and a rabbit condyle critical bone defect model were used to validate the biological performance.

title: Implications of humeral short-stem diametral sizing on implant stability.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Materials Engineering, The University of Western Ontario, London, ON, Canada.; The Roth | McFarlane Hand and Upper Limb Centre, London, ON, Canada.

corresponding_authors.name: G Daniel G Langohr
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Materials Engineering, The University of Western Ontario, London, ON, Canada.; The Roth | McFarlane Hand and Upper Limb Centre, London, ON, Canada.

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了肱骨短柄假体尺寸对稳定性的影响，方法可迁移至髋关节股骨柄的类似研究。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on humeral short-stem implants in shoulder arthroplasty, not hip or femoral stem implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估肱骨短柄假体直径尺寸对构建刚度和稳定性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用配对尸体肱骨进行手术选择与增大2毫米假体的循环加载实验。
summary_zh.result: 增大假体使刚度加倍且下沉减少，但微动无显著变化。
summary_zh.validation: 尸体机械测试与光学追踪验证。

summary_en.motivation: To assess the influence of humeral short-stem diametral sizing on construct stiffness and stability in shoulder arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Eight paired cadaveric humeri were reconstructed with surgeon-selected and 2 mm larger short-stem press-fit implants, then subjected to cyclic loading simulating forward flexion.
summary_en.result: Larger stems more than doubled construct stiffness and significantly reduced subsidence, but did not significantly affect micromotion.
summary_en.validation: Cadaveric mechanical testing with optical tracking of stem subsidence and micromotion.

title: Geometric Mismatch Promotes Anatomic Repair in Periorbital Bony Defects in Skeletally Mature Yucatan Minipigs.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore, MD, 21218, USA.; Translational Tissue Engineering Center, Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine, Baltimore, MD, 21231, USA.

corresponding_authors.name: Warren L Grayson
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Chemical and Biomolecular Engineering, Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore, MD, 21218, USA.; Translational Tissue Engineering Center, Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine, Baltimore, MD, 21231, USA.; Department of Biomedical Engineering, Johns Hopkins University School of Medicine, Baltimore, MD, 21205, USA.; Department of Materials Science and Engineering, Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore, MD, 21218, USA.; Institute for Nanobiotechnology, Johns Hopkins University, Baltimore, MD, 21218, USA.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印骨支架和骨整合，但与AM生物医学材料方向中的LPBF制造、力学测试和应力遮挡直接相关性较低。
why_not_core: This paper lacks LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding analysis, and as-built morphology characterization; it focuses on bone regeneration via geometric mismatch rather than implant mechanical performance.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索几何不匹配能否促进眶周骨缺损的解剖修复
summary_zh.method: 在成年尤卡坦小型猪双侧颧骨缺损中植入3D打印解剖镜像支架，并引入几何不匹配
summary_zh.result: 发现几何不匹配与缺损部位原位骨沉积呈强正相关，>20%的不匹配可改善骨整合
summary_zh.validation: 大型动物模型体内实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate whether introducing geometric mismatch in 3D-printed scaffolds can enhance anatomic repair of periorbital bone defects.
summary_en.method: Anatomically mirrored scaffolds with strategic geometric mismatch were implanted in bilateral zygomatic defects of adult Yucatan minipigs, combined with stromal vascular fraction cells.
summary_en.result: A strong positive correlation was found between geometric mismatch (>20%) and orthotopic bone deposition, improving osseointegration and scaffold integration.
summary_en.validation: In vivo validation using a large animal (minipig) model with advanced image-registration workflow.

title: Domain decomposition-based coupling of physics-informed neural networks via the Schwarz alternating method
relevance_to_user: 该文研究通过域分解加速PINN训练，方法可推广至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及不确定性量化或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or transferability to biomedical implant design, and validates only on a simple 1D advection-diffusion problem.

summary_zh.motivation: 改善PINN求解陡梯度PDE时的训练困难
summary_zh.method: 采用Schwarz交替方法进行域分解，耦合多个PINN或PINN与传统数值模型
summary_zh.result: 强施加边界条件未必加速收敛，PINN-FOM耦合显著提升高Peclet数下的训练效果
summary_zh.validation: 一维稳态对流扩散方程，Peclet数高达1e6的数值实验

summary_en.motivation: To alleviate training difficulties of physics-informed neural networks for PDEs with steep gradients.
summary_en.method: The Schwarz alternating method is used to decompose the domain and couple multiple PINNs or PINNs with conventional numerical models.
summary_en.result: Strong enforcement of boundary conditions does not always accelerate convergence, but PINN-FOM coupling substantially improves training for Peclet numbers up to 1e6.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on the one-dimensional steady-state advection-diffusion equation in the advection-dominated regime.

title: Conformalized Deep Splines for Optimal and Efficient Prediction Sets
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了一种具有统计覆盖保证的不确定性量化技术，可转移到替代模型中用于植入物设计的不确定性评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not address simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or biomechanical design contexts; it focuses purely on UQ for regression.

summary_zh.motivation: 为高风险应用提供可保证覆盖率的预测区间
summary_zh.method: 用神经网络参数化样条估计条件密度，结合两种共形得分
summary_zh.result: 在基准数据集上实现最小预测集大小和最佳条件覆盖
summary_zh.validation: 理论证明加基准实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To provide prediction intervals with statistical coverage guarantees for high-stakes machine learning applications.
summary_en.method: Proposes SPICE, which uses neural-network-parameterized splines to estimate conditional density and conformal scores for marginal and conditional coverage.
summary_en.result: SPICE achieves the smallest average prediction set sizes and best conditional coverage on benchmark datasets.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks with theoretical proofs of optimality.

title: A Unified Framework for the Error Analysis of Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文为PINN求解线性PDE提供了严格的误差分析，对构建可靠的生物力学替代模型具有重要理论参考价值。
why_not_core: Does not address constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification, or biomedical implant applications; purely theoretical error analysis on linear PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 为物理信息神经网络求解线性PDE提供严格的先验和后验误差估计。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于双线性形式的统一抽象框架，利用强制性和连续性推导误差界。
summary_zh.result: 误差估计是锐利的，并揭示L2边界损失惩罚会削弱误差衰减范数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个线性PDE数值算例验证理论分析的正确性。

summary_en.motivation: This work aims to provide rigorous a priori and a posteriori error estimates for physics-informed neural networks applied to linear partial differential equations.
summary_en.method: An abstract framework based on bilinear forms is proposed, leveraging coercivity and continuity to derive error bounds across various PDE types including elliptic, parabolic, hyperbolic, and Stokes equations.
summary_en.result: The obtained sharp error estimates reveal that the L2 penalty approach for initial and boundary conditions weakens the norm of the error decay.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples on standard linear PDE benchmarks demonstrate the method's ability to achieve accurate solutions consistent with the theoretical bounds.

title: Unexpected Improvements to Expected Improvement for Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出改进贝叶斯优化中采集函数数值优化的方法，可转移至基于代理模型的昂贵仿真优化，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA or biomechanics design, does not address constraints beyond standard constrained BO, and lacks uncertainty quantification beyond acquisition function optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决贝叶斯优化中期望改进函数数值优化困难的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出LogEI系列采集函数，通过对数变换改善优化性态
summary_zh.result: LogEI在标准测试问题上显著优于传统EI，且与最新方法性能相当
summary_zh.validation: 在标准优化基准测试上验证

summary_en.motivation: To address numerical difficulties in optimizing expected improvement acquisition functions in Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: Propose LogEI, a family of acquisition functions that use logarithmic transformations to improve numerical stability.
summary_en.result: LogEI substantially improves optimization performance over canonical EI and matches or exceeds state-of-the-art methods.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on standard benchmark optimization problems.

title: Stochastic Gradient Descent for Gaussian Processes Done Right
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽然不涉及生物力学或FEA，但其高效的高斯过程回归技术可用于构建替代模型，以加速植入物设计中的仿真优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, lacks validation on physical or biomedical simulations, and does not incorporate constraints or uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP inherent properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高大规模高斯过程回归的计算效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出随机对偶下降算法，结合优化与核方法见解。
summary_zh.result: 在UCI回归与贝叶斯优化任务上超越传统方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准机器学习基准数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve computational efficiency of Gaussian process regression for large-scale problems.
summary_en.method: Introduces a stochastic dual descent algorithm that leverages insights from optimization and kernel methods.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on UCI regression and Bayesian optimization benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard machine learning benchmarks and molecular binding affinity prediction.

title: Projecting basis functions with tensor networks for Gaussian process regression
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用张量网络实现高效高斯过程回归，可转移到生物力学替代建模中，但未涉及FEA验证或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification emphasis.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低使用大量基函数的高斯过程回归的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 通过低秩张量网络在数据子空间中推断权重并投影回原空间。
summary_zh.result: 实现指数数量基函数的近似GP，无指数计算复杂度。
summary_zh.validation: 在18维逆动力学基准数据集上验证方法。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of Gaussian process regression when using a large number of basis functions by employing tensor networks.
summary_en.method: Utilizes low-rank tensor networks to project data into a low-dimensional subspace, performs Bayesian inference on weights, and projects back to original space for GP predictions.
summary_en.result: Achieves approximate GP regression with an exponential number of basis functions without exponential computational complexity.
summary_en.validation: Validates the method on an 18-dimensional inverse dynamics benchmark dataset.

title: Ensemble models outperform single model uncertainties and predictions for operator-learning of hypersonic flows
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的集成不确定性量化方法可用于生物力学替代模型的可靠性评估，但尚未在植入物设计或生物医学背景下验证。
why_not_core: No biomechanics/implant design context, no constraint handling, no experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 高保真CFD计算成本高，需要不确定性感知的代理模型来评估预测可靠性。
summary_zh.method: 在DeepONet中集成均值-方差估计、证据不确定性和集成学习三种UQ机制。
summary_zh.result: 集成方法在插值和外推中均优于其他两种方法，误差最小且不确定性校准最好。
summary_zh.validation: 基于钝锥物体高超声速流场的CFD数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity CFD simulations are expensive, motivating uncertainty-aware surrogate models to assess prediction reliability in unexplored input spaces.
summary_en.method: Extended DeepONet with three uncertainty quantification mechanisms: mean-variance estimation, evidential uncertainty, and ensembling.
summary_en.result: Ensembling outperformed the other two methods in minimizing error and calibrating uncertainty for both interpolation and extrapolation regimes.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation using CFD-generated data of hypersonic flow around a blunt cone over various Mach numbers and altitudes.

title: Efficient Robust Bayesian Optimization for Arbitrary Uncertain Inputs
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移到植入物设计中考虑输入不确定性的鲁棒优化，但未针对生物力学场景。
why_not_core: This paper does not address finite element simulation surrogates, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升贝叶斯优化在任意输入不确定下的鲁棒性
summary_zh.method: 高斯过程结合最大均值差异与Nyström加速推理
summary_zh.result: 合成和真实问题上达到最优鲁棒优化性能
summary_zh.validation: 标准数值基准与真实问题实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To perform robust Bayesian Optimization under arbitrary input uncertainty for consistent performance.
summary_en.method: Empowers Gaussian Process with Maximum Mean Discrepancy and accelerates inference via Nyström approximation.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art robust optimization on synthetic and real-world problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks and real-world problem instances.

title: A physics-informed GAN Framework based on Model-free Data-Driven Computational Mechanics
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一种物理信息生成对抗网络框架，可用于替代传统有限元模拟，有望移植到植入物力学设计中。
why_not_core: does not quantify uncertainty, lacks experimental or biomechanical validation, and does not address implant-specific constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 用深度学习替代传统本构模型，提升力学模拟的效率与泛化能力。
summary_zh.method: 将数据驱动计算力学原理融入生成对抗网络，生成器受物理约束，判别器基于最近应变-应力数据。
summary_zh.result: 提出一种无需本构模型、结合物理与数据的力学行为模拟新框架。
summary_zh.validation: 未提供具体验证，仅描述方法框架。

summary_en.motivation: To replace phenomenological constitutive models with a data-driven and physics-informed deep learning framework for efficient mechanical simulation.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed GAN where the generator incorporates physical constraints and the discriminator uses nearest-neighbor strain-stress data from a material database.
summary_en.result: The framework offers a new paradigm integrating data-driven computational mechanics with deep learning to predict mechanical behaviors without explicit constitutive laws.
summary_en.validation: The paper presents a theoretical framework without experimental or numerical validation.

key_terms.zh: 无模型数据驱动计算力学
物理信息生成对抗网络

title: Operator Learning Enhanced Physics-informed Neural Networks for Solving Partial Differential Equations Characterized by Sharp Solutions
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过算子学习增强PINN，适用于求解尖锐解PDE，可迁移至生物力学有限元仿真代理模型。
why_not_core: Does not apply to implant/biomechanics design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and does not handle constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN和神经算子对尖锐解PDE求解困难的问题。
summary_zh.method: 先用DeepONet学习平滑解算子，再结合PINN求解尖锐解问题。
summary_zh.result: 仅需少量残差点即可实现强泛化能力，显著提高精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在非线性扩散反应、Burgers和Navier-Stokes方程上进行数值实验。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of solving PDEs with sharp solutions using PINNs and neural operators.
summary_en.method: Pre-train a DeepONet on smooth problems, then integrate it with PINN to solve the target sharp solution problem.
summary_en.result: The method achieves strong generalization with few residual points and substantially improves accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on nonlinear diffusion-reaction, Burgers, and Navier-Stokes equations.

title: A foundational neural operator that continuously learns without forgetting
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的神经算子方法可用于替代昂贵的有限元仿真，但未直接针对植入物或生物力学设计中的约束处理与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 为解决多物理系统学习中的灾难性遗忘，提出通用神经算子模型。
summary_zh.method: 采用门控结构与局部小波专家组合，记忆集成实现连续学习。
summary_zh.result: 在多个参数化PDE上优于任务特定基线模型，实现正向迁移。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准实例验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: To address catastrophic forgetting in learning multiple physical systems, a foundational neural operator is proposed for continuous adaptation to parametric PDEs.
summary_en.method: The NCWNO uses a gated structure with local wavelet experts and memory-based ensembling to share features across tasks and enable rapid fine-tuning.
summary_en.result: Outperforms task-specific baselines on multiple parametric PDE benchmarks with minimal hyperparameter tuning and achieves positive transfer.
summary_en.validation: Extensive numerical benchmark examples on standard PDE datasets.

title: Sustainable Concrete via Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法采用贝叶斯优化搜索可持续混凝土配方，可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标优化和代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve finite element analysis, implant biomechanics, or contact mechanics; it focuses on concrete formulation rather than biomedical device design.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少水泥生产中的二氧化碳排放，寻找可持续混凝土配方。
summary_zh.method: 使用高斯过程代理模型进行多目标贝叶斯优化。
summary_zh.result: 获得比行业实践更优的全球变暖潜能与抗压强度权衡。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实际混凝土抗压强度测量验证优化结果。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce carbon dioxide emissions from cement production by discovering low-carbon concrete formulations.
summary_en.method: Proposed a multi-objective Bayesian optimization framework with Gaussian process surrogate modeling.
summary_en.result: Achieved improved trade-offs between global warming potential and compressive strength compared to industry baselines.
summary_en.validation: Validated through real-world compressive strength measurements of algorithmically proposed concrete mixes.

title: Local Reduced-Order Modeling for Electrostatic Plasmas by Physics-Informed Solution Manifold Decomposition
relevance_to_user: 该方法基于POD的降阶建模可加速多查询模拟，但应用于等离子体物理而非生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on electrostatic plasma simulations and does not address structural FEA, biomechanical implants, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速多查询等离子体动力学模拟
summary_zh.method: 使用POD和时窗/能量窗分解构建局部降阶模型
summary_zh.result: 获得90倍加速，最大误差<11%
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试：朗道阻尼和双流不稳定性

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost of multi-query kinetic plasma simulations using reduced-order modeling.
summary_en.method: A POD-based reduced-order model is combined with temporal and energy-based windowing of the solution manifold and a tensorial approach for efficient nonlinear term evaluation.
summary_en.result: The energy-windowing ROM achieves approximately 90x speedup over Eulerian simulations with maximum relative error below 11%.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on 1D1V Vlasov-Poisson benchmarks including Landau damping and two-stream instability.

title: Adaptive operator learning for infinite-dimensional Bayesian inverse problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文的算子学习方法可以迁移到生物力学FEA代理建模中，解决正向模型成本高和不确定性问题。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context; lacks constraint handling for multi-objective design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯反问题中正向模型重复求解计算代价高
summary_zh.method: 自适应算子学习框架，使用DeepONet构建代理模型并基于贪心算法微调
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准问题上显著降低计算成本同时保持反演精度
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验验证Darcy流、热源反演和反应扩散问题

summary_en.motivation: To mitigate the high computational cost of repeated forward model evaluations in Bayesian inverse problems governed by PDEs.
summary_en.method: An adaptive operator learning framework that fine-tunes a pre-trained DeepONet surrogate using greedy sampling during posterior evaluation.
summary_en.result: The method substantially reduces computational cost while maintaining inversion accuracy on benchmarks including Darcy flow and heat source inversion.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard PDE inverse benchmarks (Darcy flow, heat source, reaction-diffusion) demonstrate performance.

title: Multi-fidelity uncertainty quantification for homogenization problems in structure-property relationships from crystal plasticity finite elements
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过多保真度不确定性量化加速有限元模拟，可转移至种植体设计中昂贵的生物力学仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or stress shielding; it focuses on homogenization of polycrystalline materials, not biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低晶体塑性有限元不确定性量化的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 应用多层蒙特卡洛方法在不同网格分辨率下进行多保真度模拟。
summary_zh.result: 相比经典蒙特卡洛方法，实现了2.23倍的加速。
summary_zh.validation: 通过晶体塑性有限元数值案例验证加速效果与精度。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of uncertainty quantification in crystal plasticity finite element simulations for structure-property relationships.
summary_en.method: The authors apply a multi-level Monte Carlo method that leverages coarse-mesh simulations to approximate fine-mesh responses with lower cost.

relevance_to_user: 该论文将深度学习用于预测组织自组装性质，虽未直接涉及生物打印，但其方法可迁移至生物打印中的组织性质预测。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve actual bioprinting, experimental validation, or autonomous decision-making in the bioprinting workflow; it focuses on simulation-based tissue self-organization in moulds.

summary_zh.motivation: 用机器学习快速预测细胞-基质相互作用下的组织自组装性质。
summary_zh.method: 通过pix2pix模型在6400个模拟数据上训练，预测水凝胶在模具中的自组装结果。
summary_zh.result: 模型预测与模拟结果高度一致，且速度显著提升。
summary_zh.validation: 保留100个模拟案例进行对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To rapidly predict tissue self-organization properties by leveraging machine learning on biophysical simulations of cell-matrix interactions.
summary_en.method: A pix2pix deep learning model was trained on 6400 biophysical simulation cases of cell-laden hydrogels in tethered moulds to predict tissue organization.
summary_en.result: The ML model achieved excellent agreement with simulation results at a fraction of the computational cost, enabling high-throughput mould design.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing predictions against 100 held-out simulation cases.

key_terms.zh: 收缩网络偶极取向模型

title: Parallel Bayesian Optimization Using Satisficing Thompson Sampling for Time-Sensitive Black-Box Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法可以迁移到基于有限元代理模型的生物力学优化中，但未涉及约束处理或具体植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, nor does it demonstrate application to biomechanics or structural FEA surrogate optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 时间敏感黑箱优化需平衡信息获取与最优性。
summary_zh.method: 基于满意Thompson采样的并行贝叶斯优化，引入率失真理论构造损失函数。
summary_zh.result: 方法在电池快充设计问题上优于传统并行BO。
summary_zh.validation: 通过锂离子电池快充设计仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: Time-sensitive black-box optimization requires efficient satisficing solutions that balance information acquisition with sub-optimality.
summary_en.method: Proposes satisficing Thompson sampling-based parallel Bayesian optimization using rate-distortion theory to compute target solutions under distortion limits.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods outperform traditional parallel Bayesian optimization with Thompson sampling in both synchronous and asynchronous settings on a battery fast-charging design problem.
summary_en.validation: Validated via simulation case study on Lithium-ion battery fast-charging design.

title: Low rank approximation method for perturbed linear systems with applications to elliptic type stochastic PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文的低秩逼近方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的加速求解，但未涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: Does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization, and lacks uncertainty quantification for point predictions.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解随机偏微分方程的计算瓶颈。
summary_zh.method: 提出刚度矩阵的低秩逼近方法以降低矩阵求逆计算量。
summary_zh.result: 在随机椭圆方程和最优控制问题中实现高精度数值解。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证方法的可行性和有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of solving stochastic partial differential equations by low-rank approximation of stiffness matrices.
summary_en.method: A novel low-rank approximation of stiffness matrices is proposed to reduce computational load and storage for matrix inversion.
summary_en.result: The method yields high-precision numerical solutions for stochastic elliptic equations and optimal control problems with varying dimension reduction ratios.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of the algorithm.

title: Improved Operator Learning by Orthogonal Attention
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过正交注意力提升神经算子泛化能力，间接适用于FEA替代模型，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no FEA validation, no uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 注意力神经算子过拟合训练数据，需提升泛化能力
summary_zh.method: 基于核积分算子特征分解提出正交注意力机制
summary_zh.result: 在六个标准PDE基准数据集上超越对比方法
summary_zh.validation: 在规则与不规则几何的数值基准上验证

summary_en.motivation: The overfitting issue in attention-based neural operators limits their generalization on limited training data.
summary_en.method: An orthogonal attention mechanism is developed via eigendecomposition of the kernel integral operator and neural approximation of eigenfunctions.
summary_en.result: The proposed operator outperforms competing baselines on six standard PDE benchmark datasets with regular and irregular geometries.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on multiple PDE datasets demonstrate improved generalization and reduced overfitting.

title: Approaches for Uncertainty Quantification of AI-predicted Material Properties: A Comparison
relevance_to_user: 该论文比较了不确定性量化方法，可迁移至代理模型的预测不确定性估计。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply UQ to FEA surrogate models or biomechanics design; it only tests on material property predictions without structural mechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 为AI预测的材料属性提供每个预测点的不确定性区间。
summary_zh.method: 比较了分位数法、直接预测区间法和集成方法三种不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.result: 三种方法均能有效量化不同材料属性的预测不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 在十种涵盖力学、电子、光学等性能的数据集上比较验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable uncertainty quantification for machine learning predictions of material properties by providing prediction intervals.
summary_en.method: Compare three easy-to-implement approaches: quantile regression, direct prediction interval learning, and ensemble methods.
summary_en.result: All three approaches effectively quantify prediction uncertainty across a diverse set of material properties.
summary_en.validation: Validated by comparing the methods on ten ML-predicted quantities spanning energetics, mechanical, electronic, optical, and spectral properties.

title: Exact and general decoupled solutions of the LMC Multitask Gaussian Process model
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的多任务高斯过程模型，可用于替代昂贵仿真中的多输出代理建模，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics applications; it focuses solely on algorithmic efficiency of the LMC multitask GP.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效计算多任务高斯过程模型，避免近似。
summary_zh.method: 提出投影LMC模型，利用解耦实现线性复杂度。
summary_zh.result: 投影LMC在合成和真实数据上表现竞争力且更简单。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成和真实数据实验验证模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: To enable exact and efficient computation of the Linear Model of Coregionalization (LMC) multitask Gaussian process without approximations.
summary_en.method: We derive a projected LMC model that decouples latent processes under a mild noise assumption, achieving linear complexity in the number of latent processes.
summary_en.result: The projected LMC achieves competitive performance with state-of-the-art multitask GPs while being simpler, faster, and more interpretable.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on synthetic and real-world regression datasets, demonstrating computational gains and predictive accuracy.

title: A Finite-Horizon Approach to Active Level Set Estimation
relevance_to_user: 该方法针对空间采样中的水平集估计问题，提出了有限时域搜索策略，其主动学习思路可迁移至替代模型的自适应采样，但未涉及有限元分析或植入物设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not address finite element analysis (FEA) surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any structural optimization; instead it focuses on spatial level set estimation with travel cost constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 在空间采样中高效定位函数超过阈值的区域，同时最小化移动距离。
summary_zh.method: 提出一维有限时域搜索策略，结合高斯过程推广到高维，通过解析解平衡估计误差与旅行成本。
summary_zh.result: 方法在合成数据和真实空气质量数据上优于现有算法，尤其当旅行成本高时显著降低误差。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成基准和真实空气质量数据集上对比多个基线方法。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently locate regions where a spatial function exceeds a threshold while minimizing travel distance during sampling.
summary_en.method: A finite-horizon search procedure in one dimension, extended to higher dimensions via Gaussian processes, with a tuning parameter balancing estimation error and traveled distance.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art algorithms, achieving roughly one-fifth the estimation error at less than half the travel cost on real air quality data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic benchmarks and a real-world air quality dataset against competing active learning strategies.

title: Thin and Deep Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了一种可解释的深度高斯过程，具有不确定性量化能力，可用于替代建模，但未涉及FEA或植入物设计的特定问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, does not handle design constraints, and is validated only on standard ML benchmarks without biomechanical or implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高深度高斯过程的可解释性和低维流形学习能力
summary_zh.method: 提出薄深高斯过程，每层定义局部线性变换保留长度尺度解释和潜嵌入
summary_zh.result: TDGP能有效发现低维流形，层数增加时性能稳定，基准数据集上表现良好
summary_zh.validation: 在标准机器学习基准数据集上实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve interpretability and low-dimensional manifold discovery in deep Gaussian processes while preserving kernel lengthscale meaning.
summary_en.method: Proposes Thin and Deep Gaussian Process (TDGP) with locally linear transformations per layer that retain both latent embeddings and lengthscale interpretability.
summary_en.result: TDGP effectively discovers lower-dimensional manifolds, scales well with layer depth, and achieves competitive performance on standard benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validated through theoretical analysis and numerical experiments on standard regression and classification datasets.

title: Sensitivity-Aware Amortized Bayesian Inference
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移用于FEA代理模型的敏感性分析和不确定性量化，但未直接涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no implant biomechanics context, no constraint handling or optimization for surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效整合贝叶斯模型的敏感性分析于推理中。
summary_zh.method: 利用权重共享和深度集成处理似然、先验及数据扰动。
summary_zh.result: 在疾病、气候和决策模型中验证有效。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个应用数值基准上测试。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently incorporate sensitivity analysis into amortized Bayesian inference for complex models.
summary_en.method: Weight sharing for structural similarities across likelihood/priors and deep ensembles for detecting approximation uncertainty.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated effectiveness on disease outbreak, global warming, and decision-making models.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks from applied modeling problems.

title: Effect of Support Height on Microstructure and Mechanical Properties of Selective Laser Melting Ti–15Mo Alloy
first_author_affiliation: Institute of Energy and Power Engineering, Changsha University of Science and Technology, Changsha, 410114, China

corresponding_authors.name: Libo Zhou
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Energy and Power Engineering, Changsha University of Science and Technology, Changsha, 410114, China

relevance_to_user: 涉及SLM Ti-15Mo合金的微观结构和力学性能，对生物医用植入物材料有参考价值，但未直接涉及应力遮挡或多孔结构。
why_not_core: Does not address porous structure design, stress shielding, fatigue, or surface roughness for osseointegration; focus is on support height effect on microstructure and static mechanical properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究支撑高度对选区激光熔化Ti-15Mo合金微观结构和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备不同支撑高度的SLM Ti-15Mo样品，进行微观表征和力学测试。
summary_zh.result: 揭示了支撑高度对微观组织和力学性能的具体影响规律。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证了不同支撑高度下样品的性能差异。

summary_en.motivation: Investigate the effect of support height on the microstructure and mechanical properties of selective laser melted Ti-15Mo alloy.
summary_en.method: Fabricated Ti-15Mo samples with varying support heights using SLM and characterized microstructure and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: Found that support height significantly influences grain morphology and mechanical performance, with optimal height improving strength.
summary_en.validation: Validated via tensile and microhardness testing on as-built samples.

title: Pareto Optimization to Accelerate Multi-Objective Virtual Screening
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的多目标贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物设计中的多目标FEA优化问题。
why_not_core: It focuses on molecular docking for drug discovery, not on FEA or biomechanical implant design, and lacks structural mechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速多属性虚拟筛选的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 采用多目标贝叶斯优化和Pareto优化。
summary_zh.result: 仅探索8%的库即可获得100%的Pareto前沿分子。
summary_zh.validation: 基于对接评分的数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost of multi-property virtual screening in drug discovery.
summary_en.method: Implemented multi-objective Bayesian optimization with Pareto optimization.
summary_en.result: Achieved 100% of the Pareto front molecules after exploring only 8% of a virtual library.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarking on docking scores for selective inhibitors.

title: Multifidelity Methods for Uncertainty Quantification of a Nonlocal Model for Phase Changes in Materials
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真蒙特卡洛方法可直接用于生物力学FEA模型的不确定量化，但应用场景为相变材料，非植入物设计。
why_not_core: No application to biomedical implant mechanics or FEA surrogate for bone-implant interface, and no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低非局部Cahn-Hilliard模型不确定量化计算成本
summary_zh.method: 使用多保真蒙特卡洛方法，以低保真模型为主采样，高保真模型稀疏采样
summary_zh.result: 在给定预算下，均方误差较蒙特卡洛方法降低一个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例对比蒙特卡洛方法验证精度提升

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of uncertainty quantification for expensive nonlocal phase-field models.
summary_en.method: A multifidelity Monte Carlo method is employed, allocating most samples to cheap low-fidelity surrogates and few to the high-fidelity model.
summary_en.result: The approach achieves about an order-of-magnitude reduction in mean-squared error for a fixed computational budget compared to standard Monte Carlo.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on a nonlocal Cahn-Hilliard model with obstacle potential validate the accuracy and speedup.

title: MgNO: Efficient Parameterization of Linear Operators via Multigrid
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种新的神经算子架构MgNO，利用多重网格参数化线性算子，可高效求解PDE，有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型。
why_not_core: No explicit handling of constraints, no uncertainty quantification, and no demonstration on biomechanical or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高神经算子对线性算子的参数化效率和表达能力
summary_zh.method: 利用多重网格结构参数化神经元间的有界线性算子，构建MgNO架构
summary_zh.result: 在不同类型PDE上取得最先进性能，训练更易且不易过拟合
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE数值基准上验证精度与效率

summary_en.motivation: To improve the parameterization efficiency and expressivity of bounded linear operators in neural operators for operator learning.
summary_en.method: Introduces MgNO, which leverages multigrid structures to parameterize linear operators between neurons in a fully connected neural operator framework.
summary_en.result: Achieves state-of-the-art performance on various PDE benchmarks with easier training and reduced overfitting compared to CNN-based and spectral-type neural operators.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on standard partial differential equation benchmarks.

title: How Much Protection Does a Collar Provide? Assessing Risk of Early Periprosthetic Femur Fractures Following Total Hip Arthroplasty in Elderly Patients
first_author_affiliation: Adult Reconstruction and Joint Replacement Service, Hospital for Special Surgery, New York, New York

corresponding_authors.name: Samuel Rodriguez
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Adult Reconstruction and Joint Replacement Service, Hospital for Special Surgery, New York, New York

relevance_to_user: 该论文评估了股骨柄领对早期假体周围骨折的影响，未直接涉及应力遮挡或微动分析。
why_not_core: Does not quantify stress shielding or micromotion at bone-implant interface; focuses on periprosthetic fracture risk rather than implant stability or bone remodeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估颈领对早期假体周围骨折的保护作用。
summary_zh.method: 比较有颈领和无颈领股骨柄设计的骨折风险。
summary_zh.result: 颈领可能降低早期假体周围骨折风险。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床数据或生物力学试验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the protective effect of a collar on early periprosthetic femur fractures in elderly patients.
summary_en.method: Compared collar and collarless femoral stem designs using clinical data or finite element analysis.
summary_en.result: The collar may reduce the risk of early periprosthetic fractures.
summary_en.validation: Validated with clinical records or mechanical testing.

title: Correcting model misspecification in physics-informed neural networks (PINNs)
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过额外神经网络修正物理模型偏差并量化不确定性，可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建。
why_not_core: No biomedical context or implant mechanics application; validated only on fluid dynamics benchmarks without FEA surrogate for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 修正PINNs中因物理过程未知导致的模型偏差。
summary_zh.method: 用额外DNN建模偏差，结合贝叶斯/集成PINNs量化不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 有效降低不完美模型与观测数据之间的误差。
summary_zh.validation: 通过非牛顿流体通道和空腔流动数值算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To correct misspecified physical models in PINNs when governing equations are not fully known.
summary_en.method: Additional DNNs model the discrepancy between imperfect physics and data, while Bayesian/ensemble PINNs quantify uncertainty.
summary_en.result: The proposed approach reduces prediction errors caused by model misspecification in complex systems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical examples of non-Newtonian channel and cavity flows.

title: Accurate Data-Driven Surrogates of Dynamical Systems for Forward Propagation of Uncertainty
relevance_to_user: 该方法将随机配点与SINDy结合构建动力学代理，可转移至生物力学中的不确定性量化问题，但未直接应用于植入物设计。
why_not_core: Does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or any biomedical validation; tested only on generic dynamical systems benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高动力系统代理模型的不确定性传播精度。
summary_zh.method: 将随机配点法与SINDy结合，构建动力学代理而非解代理。
summary_zh.result: 动力学代理框架在轨迹和分布误差上优于传统直接配点法。
summary_zh.validation: 在混沌ODE和固体力学PDE数值基准上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Improve the accuracy of surrogate models for uncertainty propagation in dynamical systems.
summary_en.method: Combine stochastic collocation with sparse identification of nonlinear dynamics (SINDy) to build surrogates over the dynamics rather than the solution.
summary_en.result: The dynamics-based surrogate achieves smaller errors in system trajectories and state distributions compared to direct solution surrogates.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks including a chaotic ODE and two PDEs from solid mechanics.

key_terms.zh: 稀疏非线性动力学识别

title: Pseudo-Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一个通用的仿真代理优化框架，可迁移到生物力学FEA中，但未直接处理约束或进行实际FEA验证。
why_not_core: Does not handle constraints explicitly, lacks FEA validation, and has no application to implant/biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 超越高斯过程的贝叶斯优化框架，提升黑箱优化效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于局部回归和随机先验的伪贝叶斯优化框架。
summary_zh.result: 在合成实验、超参数调优和机器人应用中优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过高维合成实验和实际应用基准进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To extend Bayesian optimization beyond Gaussian processes while maintaining convergence guarantees and empirical performance.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Pseudo-Bayesian Optimization framework using local regression and randomized prior construction for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art benchmarks on high-dimensional synthetic experiments, hyperparameter tuning, and robotics applications.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions and real-world optimization tasks.

title: Multivariate sensitivity-adaptive polynomial chaos expansion for high-dimensional surrogate modeling and uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该方法是一种高效的代理建模与不确定性量化技术，可用于生物力学和植入物设计的优化，但未直接应用于该领域。
why_not_core: The paper does not apply the method to implant or biomechanical design, does not address constraint handling or optimization, and validates only on electrical engineering benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发一种高效的高维代理建模与不确定性量化方法
summary_zh.method: 基于多变量灵敏度自适应的多项式混沌展开，构建公共各向异性基
summary_zh.result: 在低数据需求下获得高精度代理模型
summary_zh.validation: 在电机和电网仿真案例中验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a data-efficient surrogate modeling and uncertainty quantification method for high-dimensional input and output spaces.
summary_en.method: A multivariate sensitivity-adaptive polynomial chaos expansion that constructs a common anisotropic polynomial basis for vector-valued responses.
summary_en.result: The method achieves high accuracy with relatively low data requirements on engineering test cases.
summary_en.validation: Validation on electric machine and power grid simulation cases demonstrates effectiveness.

title: Surrogate modeling for stochastic crack growth processes in structural health monitoring applications
relevance_to_user: 该方法采用高斯过程代理模型进行不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物力学中的疲劳裂纹扩展代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on structural health monitoring of metal fatigue, not on implant/biomechanics design or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 为疲劳裂纹扩展过程构建高效概率代理模型，支持结构健康监测中的不确定性预测。
summary_zh.method: 采用潜在变量建模和高斯过程回归构建随机裂纹扩展代理模型，生成贝叶斯先验分布。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型有效捕捉了材料与载荷不确定性，在裂纹长度和扩展监测任务中表现良好。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值设定中通过两个基础裂纹SHM问题进行性能评估。

summary_en.motivation: To develop computationally efficient probabilistic surrogate models for stochastic crack growth that encode material and load uncertainties for structural health monitoring.
summary_en.method: A latent variable inspired approach using Gaussian Process regression to build surrogates that generate prior distributions for Bayesian SHM tasks.
summary_en.result: The surrogate models accurately represent uncertainty sources and perform well in crack length monitoring and crack growth prognosis.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation on two canonical crack SHM problems (damage quantification and prognosis).

title: On the reproducibility of extrusion-based bioprinting: round robin study on standardization in the field.
first_author_affiliation: Institute of Functional Interfaces, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, Eggenstein-Leopoldshafen, Germany.; Institute of Process Engineering in Life Sciences, Section IV: Biomolecular Separation Engineering, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, Karlsruhe, Germany.

corresponding_authors.name: Jürgen Hubbuch
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Functional Interfaces, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, Eggenstein-Leopoldshafen, Germany.; Institute of Process Engineering in Life Sciences, Section IV: Biomolecular Separation Engineering, Karlsruhe Institute of Technology, Karlsruhe, Germany.

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过多实验室重复性测试和自动图像分析，直接评估了挤出式生物打印的可重复性，为生物打印标准化提供数据支持。

why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, design constraints, or any biomedical FEA context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决稀疏数据下地下结构反演的计算成本高和精度低问题
summary_zh.method: 结合WGAN-GP生成模型和ES-MDA集合反演方法从低维潜在空间更新参数
summary_zh.result: 方法能准确刻画未知水力传导率场，优于变分反演方法，尤其在裂缝场中
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个合成地下算例验证准确性

summary_en.motivation: To address high computational cost and poor accuracy in subsurface characterization inverse problems from sparse data
summary_en.method: Combines Wasserstein GAN with gradient penalty for generative modeling and Ensemble Smoother with Multiple Data Assimilation for inversion in latent space
summary_en.result: Accurate characterization of hydraulic conductivity fields with reliable uncertainty quantification, outperforming variational inversion on channelized and fractured fields
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on several synthetic subsurface examples

title: M{é}thodologie de dimensionnement par optimisation bay{é}sienne d'une machine synchro-r{é}luctante assist{é}e d'aimants permanents
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用贝叶斯优化进行昂贵仿真采样，方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计，但缺乏生物医学背景和约束处理。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no explicit constraint handling, and only adaptive surrogate uncertainty (not full UQ).

summary_zh.motivation: 提高永磁同步磁阻电机设计中有限元仿真的采样效率。
summary_zh.method: 采用自适应代理模型的贝叶斯优化，对比固定代理模型方法。
summary_zh.result: 相同计算时间内贝叶斯方法获得更优电机性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元仿真对比优化结果与代理模型精度。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the sampling efficiency of finite element simulations in the design optimization of permanent magnet-assisted synchronous reluctance machines.
summary_en.method: Bayesian optimization with adaptive surrogate models is employed and compared against fixed surrogate model approaches.
summary_en.result: Bayesian approaches yield machines with better performance within the same computational budget (same number of FE simulations).
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing optimization results and surrogate accuracy against direct finite element simulations.

title: Multi-Agent Bayesian Optimization with Coupled Black-Box and Affine Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该方法处理带约束的贝叶斯优化，可迁移至植入物设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: Does not address implant or biomechanics design, no FEA simulation, no patient-specific geometry or mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决分布式优化中同时包含黑箱和仿射约束的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出一种原始-对偶多智能体贝叶斯优化算法。
summary_zh.result: 实现了与单智能体相似的遗憾/违反界，并保证了仿射约束的平均满足。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成GP实例和无线功率分配问题上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To solve distributed optimization problems involving both coupled black-box and known affine constraints.
summary_en.method: A primal-dual distributed algorithm is proposed that integrates multi-agent Bayesian optimization with constraint handling.
summary_en.result: The algorithm achieves sublinear regret and violation bounds comparable to single-agent settings and ensures average satisfaction of affine constraints.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic Gaussian process samples and a real-world wireless power allocation problem validate the theoretical guarantees.

title: A peridynamic-informed deep learning model for brittle damage prediction
relevance_to_user: 该方法将近场动力学与PINN结合，可迁移至生物力学中的断裂预测，但未涉及植入物设计中的接触力学或疲劳问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant stress shielding, micromotion, or biomechanical contact mechanics; it focuses on brittle damage prediction without experimental validation or patient-specific geometry.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效预测脆性材料损伤和裂纹扩展。
summary_zh.method: 将近场动力学理论嵌入PINN损失函数，并引入循环退火和变形梯度优化。
summary_zh.result: PD-INN准确高效预测裂纹扩展，与XFEM结果吻合。
summary_zh.validation: 通过XFEM和近场动力学直接数值方法进行基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop an efficient surrogate for predicting quasi-static brittle damage and crack propagation without high-fidelity computational costs.
summary_en.method: A peridynamic-informed neural network (PD-INN) is proposed, embedding the linearized peridynamic governing equation into the loss function and incorporating cyclical annealing and deformation gradient-aware optimization.
summary_en.result: PD-INN accurately predicts damage and crack propagation for various crack configurations, matching solutions from XFEM and direct peridynamic simulations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark cases validated against extended finite element method (XFEM) and peridynamic direct numerical method.

title: A Comparison of Mesh-Free Differentiable Programming and Data-Driven Strategies for Optimal Control under PDE Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该论文比较了可微编程、PINN和直接伴随循环在PDE约束最优控制中的梯度精度，对生物力学设计中的代理模型方法选择有参考价值，但未涉及UQ和约束处理。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, no biomechanical or implant design application, and not focused on sampling efficiency for surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 对比可微编程与数据驱动方法在PDE约束最优控制中的效果。
summary_zh.method: 基于径向基函数的无网格可微PDE求解器，比较DAL、PINN和DP。
summary_zh.result: 可微编程（DP）在梯度精度上优于DAL和PINN。
summary_zh.validation: 在拉普拉斯和纳维-斯托克斯方程上进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the accuracy and efficiency of mesh-free differentiable programming, physics-informed neural networks, and direct-adjoint looping for optimal control under PDE constraints.
summary_en.method: A radial basis function-based mesh-free differentiable PDE solver is used to benchmark DAL, PINN, and DP on Laplace and Navier-Stokes equations.
summary_en.result: DP yields the most accurate gradients, outperforming DAL and PINN, especially in scenarios where DAL fails and PINNs struggle.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDEs (Laplace, Navier-Stokes) with gradient comparison.

title: Pre-clinical characterization of a novel flexible surface stem design for total knee replacements.
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers. Part H, Journal of engineering in medicine
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedics, Rostock University Medical Center, Rostock, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Germany.

corresponding_authors.name: Rainer Bader
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedics, Rostock University Medical Center, Rostock, Mecklenburg-Vorpommern, Germany.

relevance_to_user: 论文研究了膝关节置换术中柔性表面股骨柄设计的初始稳定性，但未涉及髋关节植入物的应力遮挡或股骨柄生物力学。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on knee stems, not hip implants, and does not quantify femoral stress shielding or micromotion in Gruen zones; no FEA or patient-specific modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估新型柔性表面股骨柄在全膝关节置换中的初始稳定性。
summary_zh.method: 将三种股骨柄设计植入骨替代材料并进行动态加载，测量相对运动、沉降和抗拔出力。
summary_zh.result: 柔性柄相对运动增大但低于临界值，抗拔出力提高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过骨替代材料中的力学实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the primary stability of a novel flexible surface stem design in total knee replacements.
summary_en.method: Three stem designs were implanted into bone substitute material and dynamically loaded for 1000 cycles; relative movement, subsidence, and pull-out forces were measured.
summary_en.result: Flexible surface stems showed higher relative movements (0.10 mm) and subsidence (0.08-0.11 mm) but also higher pull-out forces (1815 N) compared to solid stems.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing with bone substitute material under dynamic loading was used.

title: OceanNet: A principled neural operator-based digital twin for regional oceans
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于神经算子的海洋数字孪生方法，虽非直接应用于生物力学或植入物设计，但其高效替代昂贵数值模拟的思想具有迁移潜力。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA, biomechanics, implant design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on ocean circulation surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发高效海洋环流代理模型替代高成本数值模拟
summary_zh.method: 使用Fourier神经算子和预测-评估-校正积分方案抑制自回归误差
summary_zh.result: 对墨西哥湾流预测实现500000倍加速且优于动力模型
summary_zh.validation: 基于历史海面高度数据与动力模型对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a cost-effective surrogate for regional ocean circulation that overcomes the computational burden of high-resolution numerical models.
summary_en.method: OceanNet employs a Fourier neural operator with a predictor-evaluate-corrector integration scheme to mitigate autoregressive error growth and a spectral regularizer to counteract spectral bias.
summary_en.result: The model achieves a 500,000-fold speedup over a state-of-the-art dynamical ocean model while delivering competitive seasonal forecast skill for the Gulf Stream.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed by comparing predicted sea surface height against historical data and the output of an uncoupled dynamical ocean model forecast.

why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration in the context of biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 为了优化3D打印与粉末冶金结合制备的复合结构的拓扑设计
summary_zh.method: 通过数值模拟和实验测试，研究了PLA塑料及随后由SLM和渗滤制备的钛合金复合结构的力学性能
summary_zh.result: 获得了具有优异强度（弯曲强度1140-1560 MPa,弹性模量49500-54000 MPa）的钛合金复合材料
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩、弯曲和硬度测试验证了力学性能

summary_en.motivation: To optimize the topological design of composite structures fabricated by combining 3D printing and powder metallurgy methods.

summary_en.result: Titanium alloy composites with high bending strength (1140-1560 MPa) and elastic modulus (49500-54000 MPa) were achieved.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through compression, bending, and hardness tests.

title: Icariin-loaded 3D-printed porous Ti6Al4V reconstruction rods for the treatment of necrotic femoral heads.

corresponding_authors.affiliation: National Engineering Research Center for Biomaterials, College of Biomedical Engineering, Sichuan University, 610064, Chengdu, China. Electronic address: changchunzhou@scu.edu.cn.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印多孔钛合金棒用于股骨头坏死治疗，包含有限元分析和体内骨整合验证，但缺乏机械测试和疲劳分析。
why_not_core: No experimental mechanical testing (only FEA), no fatigue analysis, and no surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发载药多孔钛合金棒治疗股骨头坏死
summary_zh.method: 3D打印制备多孔Ti6Al4V棒并负载淫羊藿苷
summary_zh.result: 促进成骨和血管新生，实现骨整合
summary_zh.validation: 有限元分析和动物实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a drug-loaded porous titanium alloy rod for treating avascular necrosis of femoral head.
summary_en.method: A porous Ti6Al4V rod was fabricated by selective laser melting and loaded with icariin via hydrogel.

title: Deterministic Langevin Unconstrained Optimization with Normalizing Flows
relevance_to_user: 该方法适用于昂贵的黑箱函数优化，可迁移至生物力学代理优化任务，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: The method does not handle constraints, does not provide uncertainty quantification, and is not validated on biomechanical or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效优化计算昂贵的黑箱函数。
summary_zh.method: 利用归一化流估计密度，结合兰之万方程驱动的确定性主动学习。
summary_zh.result: 在标准测试函数和超参数优化上与贝叶斯优化竞争。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成函数和实际超参数调优实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize expensive black-box functions without gradients by balancing exploration and exploitation.
summary_en.method: A deterministic optimization algorithm that uses normalizing flow density estimates to guide active learning based on Langevin dynamics.
summary_en.result: The method achieves competitive or superior performance against Bayesian optimization on synthetic benchmarks and neural network hyperparameter tuning.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard synthetic test functions and real-world hyperparameter optimization tasks.

title: Data-driven adaptive building thermal controller tuning with constraints: A primal-dual contextual Bayesian optimization approach
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于原始-对偶上下文贝叶斯优化的约束黑箱优化方法可用于解决植入物设计中的多目标约束优化问题，如同时最小化应力遮挡和界面微动。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve finite element analysis, biomechanics, or implant design; it applies constrained Bayesian optimization to building thermal control.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低建筑能耗并控制热不适约束
summary_zh.method: 采用基于数据的原始-对偶上下文贝叶斯优化
summary_zh.result: 相比其他方法节省4.7%能耗并跟踪时变阈值
summary_zh.validation: 单房间仿真案例验证

summary_en.motivation: Minimize building energy consumption under thermal discomfort constraint
summary_en.method: Primal-dual contextual Bayesian optimization for online constrained black-box tuning
summary_en.result: Achieves up to 4.7% energy savings and tracks time-varying thresholds
summary_en.validation: Simulation case study of a single room

title: Data-Efficient Strategies for Probabilistic Voltage Envelopes under Network Contingencies
relevance_to_user: 本文提出了一种数据高效的迁移学习代理模型方法，可显著减少仿真采样成本，未来有望应用于生物医学植入物设计的有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on power grid voltage envelopes under contingencies, lacking any biomechanical context, implant design, stress shielding, or contact mechanics relevant to the user's FEA surrogate direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少电力系统暂态仿真中大量蒙特卡洛采样的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 提出多任务顶点度核高斯过程，跨网络拓扑迁移功率流知识。
summary_zh.result: 在低训练数据下预测误差降低50%以上，采样需求减少16倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在IEEE 30节点系统上进行N-1和N-2故障仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of Monte-Carlo sampling for constructing probabilistic voltage envelopes in power systems with contingencies.
summary_en.method: A multi-task Gaussian process with a vertex-degree kernel (MT-VDK-GP) is proposed to transfer power flow knowledge across different network configurations.
summary_en.result: MT-VDK-GP achieves over 50% reduction in mean prediction error for novel N-1 contingencies and enables probabilistic envelopes with 16× fewer power flow solutions than Monte-Carlo sampling.
summary_en.validation: Validated on the IEEE 30-bus system under N-1 and N-2 contingency scenarios using numerical simulations.

title: Improved corrosion resistance of magnesium alloy prepared by selective laser melting through T4 heat treatment for biomedical applications

why_not_core: no porous structure, no stress shielding or stiffness matching analysis, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration data.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高SLM镁合金的耐腐蚀性以应用于生物医学。
summary_zh.method: 对SLM成形的AZ91D镁合金进行T4固溶处理。

summary_zh.validation: 电化学测试和浸泡实验验证耐腐蚀性提升。

summary_en.motivation: To enhance the corrosion resistance of selective laser melted magnesium alloys for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: T4 solution heat treatment was applied to as-built AZ91D magnesium alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.result: The solution-treated alloy exhibited a 70% reduction in corrosion current density and a 78% decrease in corrosion rate, while maintaining acceptable mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Electrochemical polarization and immersion tests in Hanks' solution were used to evaluate corrosion resistance.

title: Physics-Informed Induction Machine Modelling
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用物理信息神经网络对感应电机进行建模，方法上类似代理模型，但应用于电气工程，而非生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no FEA for solid mechanics, no constraint handling or UQ focus.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决感应电机电磁暂态仿真中数据不足的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理信息神经网络NeuIM，结合物理约束与数据驱动。
summary_zh.result: NeuIM在少数据或无数据情况下能准确捕获电机动态。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个案例与纯数据驱动方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of data scarcity in electromagnetic transient simulation of induction machines.
summary_en.method: Proposes a Neural Induction Machine (NeuIM) model that integrates physics-informed neural networks to capture dynamics even without data.
summary_en.result: NeuIM outperforms purely data-driven approaches in capturing fast and slow dynamics under varying data availability.
summary_en.validation: Validated through extensive case studies comparing against data-driven methods.

title: Multi-Resolution Active Learning of Fourier Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对代理模型训练中昂贵仿真数据的采集效率问题，提出多分辨率主动学习方法，可迁移至植入物力学设计中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: Does not handle explicit constraints in optimization, and validated only on abstract operator benchmarks, not on implant/biomechanics FEA problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低Fourier神经算子训练所需的昂贵仿真数据采集成本
summary_zh.method: 提出多分辨率主动学习框架，通过最大化效用-成本比动态选择输入函数和分辨率
summary_zh.result: 在多个基准算子学习任务上优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 在标准算子学习基准上进行数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the costly data collection from physical simulations required for training Fourier Neural Operators.
summary_en.method: Proposes a multi-resolution active learning framework that dynamically selects input functions and resolutions by maximizing a utility-cost ratio, with a cost annealing scheme to avoid over-penalizing high-resolution queries.
summary_en.result: Outperforms existing active learning methods on several benchmark operator learning tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical experiments on standard operator learning benchmarks, such as Darcy flow and Burgers' equation.

title: Multi-Grid Tensorized Fourier Neural Operator for High-Resolution PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多网格张量化神经算子方法可显著降低高分辨率PDE求解的内存与数据需求，有望迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物或生物医学验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to any biomedical or implant-related FEA problem, does not handle design constraints or UQ, and lacks validation on solid mechanics or structural simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高分辨率PDE求解中内存与数据稀缺问题
summary_zh.method: 提出多网格张量化傅里叶神经算子，融合域分解与全局张量分解
summary_zh.result: 在湍流Navier-Stokes上实现150倍参数压缩，误差减半
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（湍流Navier-Stokes仿真）

summary_en.motivation: To overcome memory and data limitations for learning PDE solution operators at high resolutions.
summary_en.method: Introduces a multi-grid tensorized Fourier neural operator (MG-TFNO) combining domain decomposition and global tensor factorization for parameter compression.
summary_en.result: Achieves over 150x parameter reduction and half the error on turbulent Navier-Stokes compared to baselines.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical simulations of turbulent Navier-Stokes equations.

title: Analytic and Gevrey class regularity for parametric semilinear reaction-diffusion problems and applications in uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 本文研究了参数化反应扩散问题的正则性，为不确定性量化提供了理论依据，可迁移至替代建模中的UQ分析。
why_not_core: No surrogate model or FEA method is proposed; focuses on theoretical regularity for quadrature, not on efficient sampling or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究参数化反应扩散问题解的正则性以支持不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 结合反阶乘技巧处理非线性项，证明解析与Gevrey正则性。
summary_zh.result: 得到高斯和准蒙特卡洛积分的收敛估计。
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验验证理论收敛率。

summary_en.motivation: To establish parametric regularity for semilinear reaction-diffusion problems to support efficient uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: Combined alternative-to-factorial technique with novel treatment of polynomial nonlinearity to prove analytic and Gevrey class regularity.
summary_en.result: Derived rigorous convergence estimates for Gaussian and Quasi-Monte Carlo quadrature.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments confirming theoretical convergence rates.

title: A multi-fidelity deep operator network (DeepONet) for fusing simulation and monitoring data: Application to real-time settlement prediction during tunnel construction
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一个多保真度DeepONet框架，可融合仿真与监测数据，方法可迁移到植入物设计的代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on geotechnical tunnel settlement prediction, with no application to implant biomechanics, bone-implant interface, or biomedical design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 融合仿真与监测数据实现隧道施工实时沉降预测。
summary_zh.method: 构建多保真深度算子网络，含低保真仿真子网和高保真监测子网，结合因果预处理与迁移学习。
summary_zh.result: 在有限噪声监测数据下实现全场地层沉降快速准确预测。
summary_zh.validation: 采用隧道工程实测沉降数据验证模型精度。

relevance_to_user: 本文通过LPBF制备Neovius支架并评价其力学与渗透性，与骨匹配，有助于骨组织工程中的应力屏蔽研究。
why_not_core: This paper does not report fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration characterization, and focuses on scaffold structures rather than hip stems for stress shielding quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估Neovius结构支架的力学与渗透性以用于骨组织工程
summary_zh.method: LPBF制备Neovius支架，CFD模拟非牛顿流体渗透，压缩测试及体外细胞实验
summary_zh.validation: 压缩力学测试与Alamar blue体外细胞活性实验

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the structural strength and permeability of Neovius lattice scaffolds for bone tissue engineering applications.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate Neovius scaffolds; computational fluid dynamics with a non-Newtonian blood model, static compression tests, and in vitro Alamar blue assays were performed.
summary_en.result: Elastic moduli of 3.27-3.71 GPa and permeabilities of 0.0025-0.0152×10^-9 m² were measured, comparable to human bone.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression testing and in vitro cell culture with Alamar blue assay.

title: New computational tools and experiments reveal how geometry affects tissue growth in 3D printed scaffolds
first_author_affiliation: School of Mathematical Sciences, Queensland University of Technology (QUT), Brisbane, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Matthew J. Simpson
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Mathematical Sciences, Queensland University of Technology (QUT), Brisbane, Australia

relevance_to_user: 该论文在计算模型中使用了不确定性量化框架，可迁移至植入物力学设计的代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper does not develop a surrogate model to replace expensive FEA simulations; it applies a reaction-diffusion model directly, and it does not address implant biomechanics or structural design.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究3D打印支架中孔隙几何形状对组织生长的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用反应扩散模型结合似然不确定性量化框架。
summary_zh.result: 发现细胞迁移和增殖率与孔隙几何形状基本无关，曲率效应由空间可用性主导。
summary_zh.validation: 通过成骨细胞在熔融电纺支架上的实验进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To understand how pore geometry influences tissue growth in 3D printed scaffolds for tissue engineering.
summary_en.method: A reaction-diffusion model coupled with a likelihood-based uncertainty quantification framework was used to quantify cell migration and proliferation rates.
summary_en.result: Cell migration and proliferation rates were found to be largely independent of pore geometry, with curvature effects attributed to space availability rather than direct cell behavior modulation.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation was performed using osteoblastic cells cultured on melt electrowritten scaffolds with square and non-square pores.

title: Machine learning-assisted extrusion-based 3D bioprinting for tissue regeneration applications
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh-517619, India

corresponding_authors.name: Mamilla Ravi Sankar
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology, Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh-517619, India

relevance_to_user: 该综述总结了机器学习在挤出式生物打印工艺参数优化中的应用，但与自主决策验证仍有差距。
why_not_core: This is a review paper with no experimental validation or implementation of ML models in actual bioprinting workflows.

summary_zh.motivation: 挤出式生物打印需优化多参数，传统方法难以处理复杂性。
summary_zh.method: 综述了机器学习模型建立打印性与参数间关系的方法。
summary_zh.result: 指出机器学习能有效处理多参数优化，但面临挑战。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: Optimizing multiparameter interactions in extrusion-based bioprinting is complex, motivating the use of machine learning.
summary_en.method: This review surveys machine learning approaches that model printability as a function of biological, mechanical, and rheological parameters.
summary_en.result: Machine learning is identified as a promising tool for overcoming parameter complexity, though challenges remain for tissue regeneration applications.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a literature review summarizing existing work.

title: Lattice Thermal Conductivity from First Principles and Active Learning with Gaussian Process Regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示的高斯过程回归与主动学习结合方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理模型构建，但并未涉及有限元分析或约束优化。
why_not_core: Does not address FEA-based surrogate modelling, implant biomechanics, or design optimization with constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 低成本预测晶格热导率，加速低热导材料发现。
summary_zh.method: 基于GPR和主动学习构建代理模型，迭代选择高不确定性样本。
summary_zh.result: 预测1574种化合物热导率，发现27种极低热导率新材料。
summary_zh.validation: 通过DFT计算验证预测结果，R²达0.81。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently predict lattice thermal conductivity for a large number of materials while minimizing expensive first-principles calculations.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process regression surrogate model is iteratively improved via active learning, selecting the most uncertain candidates for additional DFT training data.
summary_en.result: The model predicts thermal conductivity for 1574 cubic compounds, identifying 27 novel low-thermal-conductivity materials validated by DFT.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation against DFT calculations yields an R² score of 0.81 and Spearman correlation of 0.93.

title: CFDBench: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Machine Learning Methods in Fluid Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 提供了一个用于评估神经算子泛化能力的CFD基准，其方法学可迁移至固体力学代理建模，但不直接涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fluid dynamics benchmarks and does not address solid mechanics, implant design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 构建用于评估神经算子泛化能力的CFD基准
summary_zh.method: 使用四种经典CFD问题生成302K帧数据
summary_zh.result: 基线模型在某些问题上误差高达300%且自回归推理误差累积严重
summary_zh.validation: 数值方法生成的数据集上进行评估

summary_en.motivation: To create a benchmark for evaluating the generalization ability of neural operators in computational fluid dynamics.
summary_en.method: A dataset of 302K frames from four classic CFD problems was generated using numerical methods.
summary_en.result: Baseline models exhibit up to 300% error on some problems and severe error accumulation during autoregressive inference.
summary_en.validation: Validation was conducted on the dataset produced by numerical simulation.

title: An Extreme Learning Machine-Based Method for Computational PDEs in Higher Dimensions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效求解高维PDE的方法，可能对生物力学仿真中的替代模型有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modelling for design optimization, nor does it include uncertainty quantification or constraint handling typical in FEA surrogate models.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统方法求解高维PDE时计算成本高，需要更高效的方法。
summary_zh.method: 基于极限学习机，用随机化神经网络表示解，在配点上强制执行PDE和边界条件。
summary_zh.result: 在高维PDE上比PINN更准确且成本更低，误差接近机器精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在多个高维线性和非线性PDE上进行数值仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational challenges of solving high-dimensional partial differential equations, a more efficient method is needed.
summary_en.method: Two methods are proposed: one using a randomized feed-forward neural network with extreme learning machine, and another combining it with an approximate theory of functional connections to avoid exponential growth in terms.
summary_en.result: The methods achieve high accuracy on high-dimensional linear and nonlinear PDEs, outperforming physics-informed neural networks in both cost and accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulations on various high-dimensional stationary and dynamic PDEs demonstrate the performance, with errors approaching machine precision for lower dimensions.

title: Promises of Deep Kernel Learning for Control Synthesis
relevance_to_user: 该论文的深度核学习方法结合了不确定量化，可转移到植入物/生物力学设计的代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on control synthesis of stochastic dynamical systems with temporal logic specifications, not on FEA surrogate modeling for expensive structural simulations or implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 结合深度核学习与形式化抽象，实现复杂规范下的随机系统控制综合。
summary_zh.method: 使用DKL学习未知系统，抽象为区间马尔可夫决策过程，进行带正确性保证的控制综合。
summary_zh.result: 在包括5维非线性随机系统的基准测试中，优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准测试验证，包括高维非线性系统。

summary_en.motivation: Leverage deep kernel learning's uncertainty quantification and representational power to enable control synthesis for complex stochastic dynamical systems with formal guarantees.
summary_en.method: Propose an abstraction-based framework that uses DKL to learn the system from data, abstracts the learned model into an Interval Markov Decision Process (IMDP), and synthesizes a controller satisfying temporal logic specifications.
summary_en.result: The approach demonstrates superior performance on benchmarks including a 5-D nonlinear stochastic system compared to state-of-the-art methods.
summary_en.validation: Validated through numerical benchmarks on nonlinear stochastic systems with up to five dimensions.

key_terms.zh: 区间马尔可夫决策过程

title: In-Silico Prediction of Mechanical Behaviour of Uniform Gyroid Scaffolds Affected by Its Design Parameters for Bone Tissue Engineering Applications
first_author_affiliation: Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, 5063 Bergen, Norway

corresponding_authors.name: Haja-Sherief N Musthafa
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Computer Science, Electrical Engineering and Mathematical Sciences, Western Norway University of Applied Sciences, 5063 Bergen, Norway

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过有限元方法预测Gyroid支架的力学性能，可应用于骨组织工程，但缺乏LPBF制造和实验验证，与研究方向中的制造和测试环节不直接相关。
why_not_core: This paper does not include LPBF fabrication, experimental mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or surface characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过设计参数调控Gyroid支架力学性能以匹配骨组织。
summary_zh.method: 结合TPMS和SDF设计多孔结构，用FEM预测弹性模量。
summary_zh.result: 有效弹性模量范围0.05-1.93 GPa，与松质骨相当。
summary_zh.validation: 仅数值模拟，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To achieve optimal mechanical properties for bone scaffolds by tuning design parameters, mimicking natural bone stiffness.
summary_en.method: Gyroid scaffolds with varying pore and strut sizes were designed using a combined TPMS and signed distance field method, and their effective elastic moduli under compression were predicted via finite element analysis.
summary_en.result: The predicted effective elastic moduli ranged from 0.05 GPa to 1.93 GPa, comparable to human trabecular bone.
summary_en.validation: The study relies solely on numerical simulation without experimental validation.

title: Fairness- and uncertainty-aware data generation for data-driven design
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至植入物设计中的训练数据生成，提升代理模型的数据效率，但未直接针对有限元代理建模或生物力学优化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on fair data generation for design exploration, not on surrogate modeling or solving expensive FEA sampling for implant biomechanics; no contact mechanics, no hip implant context, no constraint handling or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 数据驱动设计中数据集在形状和属性空间分布不均，导致探索偏差。
summary_zh.method: 提出FairGen方法，通过覆盖模块和不确定性模块指导贝叶斯优化选择目标属性，由生成模型预测形状，并用模拟验证。
summary_zh.result: 在S形槽辅助结构设计中，FairGen以两倍速度提升覆盖分数，并显著降低生成模型的预测误差。
summary_zh.validation: 通过S形槽辅助结构设计案例进行数值模拟验证。

summary_en.motivation: Data-driven design suffers from biased exploration in property space due to classical experimental design focusing on shape diversity.
summary_en.method: FairGen actively detects and generates missing properties from a small dataset using a coverage module and an uncertainty module to guide Bayesian optimization, then predicts shapes via a generative model and evaluates properties through simulation.
summary_en.result: In S-slot auxetic design, FairGen doubled coverage speed and significantly expanded the sampled property region, leading to consistent reductions in mean absolute errors of generative models.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation case study on S-slot auxetic structural design.

title: Bayesian Quality-Diversity approaches for constrained optimization problems with mixed continuous, discrete and categorical variables
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种面向混合变量约束优化的贝叶斯质量多样性方法，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的替代建模。
why_not_core: does not apply surrogate modelling to biomedical or implant design problems; no biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵仿真下混合变量约束优化的计算效率问题.
summary_zh.method: 采用高斯过程混合变量协方差模型和贝叶斯优化策略实现质量多样性搜索.
summary_zh.result: 相比经典方法，计算成本降低两个数量级.
summary_zh.validation: 在分析测试函数和航空系统问题上验证.

summary_en.motivation: To develop a Bayesian Quality-Diversity approach for constrained mixed-variable optimization under limited simulation budget.
summary_en.method: Gaussian process models with adapted covariance functions and dedicated enrichment strategy are used to handle mixed continuous, discrete, and categorical variables.
summary_en.result: The proposed method reduces computational cost by up to two orders of magnitude compared to classical Quality-Diversity approaches.
summary_en.validation: Validation on analytical benchmarks and two aerospace system design problems demonstrates efficiency in speed of convergence.

title: Hydroxyapatite 3D-printed scaffolds with Gyroid-Triply periodic minimal surface (TPMS) porous structure: Fabrication and an in vivo pilot study in sheep
first_author_affiliation: CERHUM - PIMW, 4000 Liège, Belgium; CIRIMAT, Université de Toulouse, CNRS / Toulouse INP / UT3, 31030 Toulouse, France
