corresponding_authors.name: Grégory Nolens
corresponding_authors.affiliation: CERHUM - PIMW, 4000 Liège, Belgium; Faculty of Medicine, University of Namur, 5000 Namur, Belgium. Electronic address: gregory.nolens@cerhum.com

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印多孔支架用于骨再生，但未使用LPBF工艺，也未针对应力遮挡或疲劳进行评价。
why_not_core: This paper does not use LPBF, does not address stress shielding or stiffness matching for load-bearing implants, and does not include fatigue testing or as-built surface characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估Gyroid-TPMS羟基磷灰石支架在大型动物模型中的骨再生能力
summary_zh.method: 利用VAT光聚合3D打印制备HA支架，进行力学测试并在羊股骨植入6个月
summary_zh.result: 支架骨再生效果与临床标准Bio-Oss相当，早期骨整合略优
summary_zh.validation: 羊体内植入实验，结合组织病理学和骨动力学分析

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the bone regeneration potential of Gyroid-TPMS hydroxyapatite scaffolds in a large animal model as a preclinical step toward clinical application.
summary_en.method: Hydroxyapatite scaffolds with Gyroid TPMS structure were fabricated via VAT photopolymerization, mechanically characterized, and implanted in sheep femur for 4 and 26 weeks.
summary_en.result: The scaffolds exhibited bone regeneration performance comparable to Bio-Oss with slightly better early osseointegration and mineral apposition.
summary_en.validation: In vivo pilot study in sheep with semi-quantitative histopathology, epifluorescence bone dynamics, and histomorphometry against a clinical standard.

title: A Novel Training Framework for Physics-informed Neural Networks: Towards Real-time Applications in Ultrafast Ultrasound Blood Flow Imaging
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的加速PINN训练方法和不确定性量化策略可迁移至生物力学代理模型构建，但未涉及植入物力学分析。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant stress shielding, contact mechanics, or bone-implant interface FEA; it focuses on blood flow velocity estimation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN求解血流Navier-Stokes方程速度慢，无法用于实时超声成像。
summary_zh.method: 提出SeqPINN分步求解和SP-PINN并行训练框架，结合平均常数随机梯度下降和SWAG不确定性估计。
summary_zh.result: 在直血管和三叉血管仿真及体模实验中，速度较原始PINN提升数倍，流速RMSE分别为0.63和1.35 cm/s。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元仿真和体外体模实验验证，与原始PINN对比精度和速度。

summary_en.motivation: Current PINN solvers for Navier-Stokes equations are too slow for real-time ultrafast ultrasound blood flow imaging.
summary_en.method: A sequential PINN training framework (SeqPINN) and a parallel training scheme (SP-PINN) with averaged constant stochastic gradient descent and SWAG uncertainty estimation are proposed.
summary_en.result: Both methods achieve several-fold speedup over standard PINN, with RMSE of 0.63 cm/s (SeqPINN) and 0.81 cm/s (SP-PINN) on straight vessel flow recovery.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed using finite-element simulations and in vitro phantoms of single-branch and trifurcate vessels, with accuracy comparisons against the original PINN.

title: Efficient Uncertainty Quantification in a Multiscale Model of Pulmonary Arterial and Venous Hemodynamics
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用多项式混沌展开进行不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物有限元代理建模中的不确定性分析。
why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no solid FEA surrogate, no stress shielding or micromotion analysis relevant to hip implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 肺血管疾病模拟中需量化参数不确定性对血流动力学预测的影响
summary_zh.method: 采用多项式混沌展开加速多尺度脉搏波传播模型的敏感性和不确定性分析
summary_zh.result: 微血管床密度参数对近端和远端循环的所有模拟量影响最大
summary_zh.validation: 基于数值模拟案例验证，无实验数据

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the influence of parametric uncertainty on hemodynamic predictions in multiscale pulmonary vascular models.
summary_en.method: Polynomial chaos expansions are used to accelerate sensitivity and uncertainty quantification in a pulse-wave propagation model of the pulmonary circulation.
summary_en.result: Microvascular bed density parameters dominate the uncertainty in blood pressure, flow, and wall shear stress in both proximal and distal vessels.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical simulation case studies without experimental data.

title: Decreasing the Computing Time of Bayesian Optimization using Generalizable Memory Pruning
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过记忆剪枝加速贝叶斯优化，虽未直接应用于生物力学，但可迁移至FEA替代模型的实验设计。
why_not_core: Does not address FEA surrogate modeling or expensive simulation sampling in biomechanics context; no constraint handling or uncertainty quantification beyond standard BO.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化在高维大数据下计算时间过长，需加速以减少实验延迟。
summary_zh.method: 提出通用的记忆剪枝与有界优化包装器，可适配任意代理模型和采集函数。
summary_zh.result: 计算时间从多项式增长变为锯齿状非增长模式，且不牺牲收敛性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在两个数据集、两个代理模型、四个采集函数上验证了普适性。

summary_en.motivation: Bayesian optimization suffers from prohibitive computing times when processing high-dimensional or large datasets, hindering experimentation.
summary_en.method: A generalizable wrapper of memory pruning and bounded optimization is proposed, compatible with any surrogate model and acquisition function.
summary_en.result: Wall-clock computing time per experiment shifts from a polynomially increasing pattern to a sawtooth non-increasing trend without sacrificing convergence performance.
summary_en.validation: Generalizability is demonstrated across two datasets, two surrogate models, and four acquisition functions on MIT Supercloud hardware.

title: A hybrid physics-informed neural network based multiscale solver as a partial differential equation constrained optimization problem
relevance_to_user: 该方法将物理信息神经网络与有限元结合用于多尺度PDE求解，可迁移至植入物生物力学中的多尺度模拟。
why_not_core: No biomechanical or implant application, no UQ, no experimental validation on relevant domains.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决带有特征尺度的多尺度PDE高效求解问题
summary_zh.method: 提出了混合PINN与有限元的伴随梯度优化方法，加入粗尺度正则化
summary_zh.result: 粗尺度信息提升了收敛性并得到非平凡解
summary_zh.validation: 在振荡系数热传导问题上验证

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve multiscale PDEs with two characteristic scales using a hybrid solver.
summary_en.method: A hybrid PINN-finite element method is formulated as a PDE-constrained optimization with adjoint-based gradient computation and coarse-scale regularization.
summary_en.result: Including coarse-scale information via weak convergence regularization improves convergence and yields non-trivial PINN solutions.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on a heat transfer problem with oscillating coefficients.

title: Broadband Ground Motion Synthesis via Generative Adversarial Neural Operators: Development and Validation
relevance_to_user: 虽然应用于地震工程，但生成对抗神经算子方法可迁移到生物力学有限元代理模型，提高采样效率。
why_not_core: Does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraints, or uncertainty quantification in the context of FEA surrogate modeling for biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高地震动时程合成效率，替代昂贵数值模拟
summary_zh.method: 采用生成对抗神经算子条件生成三分量加速度时程
summary_zh.result: 模型能学习震级、距离、场地条件缩放规律，高频段与传统GMM一致
summary_zh.validation: 基于模拟BBP数据和实测KiK-net数据验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop an efficient data-driven framework for broadband ground motion synthesis, reducing the computational cost of physics-based simulations.
summary_en.method: A conditional generative adversarial neural operator (cGM-GANO) is trained on simulated and recorded ground motions to generate three-component acceleration time histories conditioned on earthquake parameters.
summary_en.result: The model captures median scaling of amplitude spectra and pseudo-spectral accelerations over a wide frequency range, with discrepancies attributed to data scarcity and dataset inconsistencies.
summary_en.validation: Validation performed on simulated BBP platform data and recorded KiK-net data, comparing median scaling and aleatory variability with traditional ground motion models.

title: Random Postprocessing for Combinatorial Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过禁止重复采样加速贝叶斯优化，可迁移至代理模型驱动的仿真优化任务。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical design applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化中重复采样导致收敛慢的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出后处理方法严格禁止数据集中重复样本
summary_zh.result: 显著减少寻找全局最优所需的序贯步骤数
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准问题上进行性能比较

summary_en.motivation: Repeated access to the same points in Bayesian optimization slows convergence to the global optimum.
summary_en.method: A postprocessing method is introduced that strictly prohibits duplicate samples in the dataset.
summary_en.result: The number of sequential steps to find the global optimum is significantly reduced, especially for maximum a posteriori acquisition functions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks are used to compare the proposed method against standard Bayesian optimization.

title: On the Effects of Heterogeneous Errors on Multi-fidelity Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过异质误差建模提升了多保真贝叶斯优化性能，可迁移到植入物/生物力学设计中的替代建模与优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomechanics or implant design problems, lacks constraint handling, and validation is on general engineering and analytical examples, not on FEA or biomechanical simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服现有多保真贝叶斯优化对全局相关性和同质噪声的不合理假设。
summary_zh.method: 提出学习每个数据源噪声模型且能利用局部相关低保真源的多保真仿真方法。

summary_zh.method: 采用响应面法研究工艺参数对致密度和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.result: 获得了最优参数组合，提高了合金的力学性能。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸和硬度测试验证了优化结果。

summary_en.motivation: To optimize selective laser melting process parameters for Ti6Al4V-ELI alloy for enhanced mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Response surface methodology was employed to investigate the effects of process parameters on density and mechanical properties.
summary_en.result: Optimal parameter combinations were identified, leading to improved mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through tensile and hardness testing.

title: Deep Evidential Learning for Bayesian Quantile Regression
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了一种高效的贝叶斯不确定性量化方法，可迁移至有限元代理模型的预测不确定性估计。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply its uncertainty quantification method to FEA surrogate modeling, does not handle design constraints, and lacks validation on biomechanics or implant-related problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统不确定性量化方法计算昂贵且依赖高斯假设，需要高效单次前向传播的UQ方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于深度证据学习的贝叶斯分位数回归模型，无需高斯假设，单次前向传播即可捕捉不确定度。
summary_zh.result: 在非高斯分布上实现了校准的不确定性，并能分离偶然不确定性和认知不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成数据和标准回归数据集上验证了校准性和鲁棒性。

summary_en.motivation: Standard uncertainty quantification methods are computationally expensive and rely on restrictive Gaussian assumptions, motivating a single forward-pass approach for accurate uncertainty estimation.
summary_en.method: This work proposes a deep evidential learning framework for Bayesian quantile regression, which estimates target quantiles without assuming a Gaussian distribution and captures both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty in one forward pass.
summary_en.result: The method achieves calibrated uncertainties on non-Gaussian distributions, effectively disentangles aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty, and shows robustness to out-of-distribution samples.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on synthetic and benchmark regression datasets, demonstrating calibration and robustness.

title: Physics-guided training of GAN to improve accuracy in airfoil design synthesis
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过物理引导生成对抗网络提高设计精度，可迁移到植入体形状优化中，但未涉及生物力学约束或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanical constraints; it focuses on airfoil aerodynamic performance without implant-specific validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 生成模型常输出物理不合理形状，需引入物理约束提高精度。
summary_zh.method: 提出物理引导生成对抗网络，使用外部软件计算物理有效性指导训练。
summary_zh.result: 大幅提高生成形状的精度，并能生成训练集中不存在但物理合理的新形状。
summary_zh.validation: 在机翼设计任务上对比传统GAN，验证了物理引导的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Generative models often produce physically invalid shapes; this work introduces physical validity constraints to improve accuracy.
summary_en.method: A physics-guided GAN training framework that uses external general-purpose software to compute physical validity and guide the generator without requiring differentiable physics equations.
summary_en.result: The proposed method significantly improves accuracy and generates novel shapes that satisfy physical laws, overcoming limitations of standard GANs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on airfoil design demonstrate improved accuracy and physical validity compared to baseline GAN models.

title: Influence of β-Stabilizer Element on Microstructure and Mechanical Behavior of Porous Titanium Alloy Synthesized by Liquid Metal Dealloying.
first_author_affiliation: Division of Materials Mechanics, Institute of Materials Research, Helmholtz-Zentrum Hereon, 21502 Geesthacht, Germany.

corresponding_authors.name: Ilya Okulov
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Particles and Process Engineering, University of Bremen, Badgasteiner Str. 1, 28359 Bremen, Germany.; Leibniz Institute for Materials Engineering-IWT, Badgasteiner Str. 3, 28359 Bremen, Germany.

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过液态金属脱合金法制备多孔钛合金，解决了植入物刚度匹配问题，但未涉及增材制造（LPBF）工艺。
why_not_core: This paper does not use LPBF fabrication, nor does it report fatigue behavior, surface roughness, or osseointegration properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决金属植入物刚度不匹配导致的应力遮挡问题
summary_zh.method: 采用液态金属脱合金法制备多孔TiFe合金

summary_zh.validation: 微观结构表征与力学压缩测试

summary_en.motivation: To address stress shielding caused by stiffness mismatch between metallic implants and bone.
summary_en.method: Porous TiFe alloy was synthesized via liquid metal dealloying of a TiFeCu precursor in liquid Mg.
summary_en.result: The open porous alloy exhibited a low elastic modulus (6.4–6.9 GPa) and yield strength up to 185 MPa due to its α+β microstructure.
summary_en.validation: Microstructural analysis and compression mechanical testing were performed.

title: Reduced Order Modeling of a MOOSE-based Advanced Manufacturing Model with Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文中的算子学习方法（FNO）可用于生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型构建，但缺乏生物医学背景和实验验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, lacks experimental validation, and is applied to nuclear AM rather than biomedical problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 为核材料先进制造的高保真模型构建快速替代模型，以支持DRL过程控制。
summary_zh.method: 采用傅里叶神经算子作为算子学习方法，对基于MOOSE的热机械模型进行降阶建模。
summary_zh.result: 开发的ROM能够快速预测不同工艺参数下的温度场，并与DNN-ROM进行基准比较。
summary_zh.validation: 通过与高保真MOOSE模型对比来验证ROM的精度。

summary_en.motivation: Develop a fast surrogate for a high-fidelity MOOSE-based thermo-mechanical model to enable DRL-driven process control in advanced manufacturing.
summary_en.method: A Fourier Neural Operator is employed as a reduced order model to learn the parametric mapping from process variables to temperature fields, benchmarked against a conventional DNN ROM.
summary_en.result: The operator learning-based ROM achieves accurate predictions with significant speedup, outperforming the DNN ROM in the benchmark comparison.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing ROM predictions to the high-fidelity MOOSE simulation results.

title: HyperLoRA for PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过超网络与低秩适配实现参数化PDE的快速求解，虽未直接应用于植入物或生物力学，但其元学习范式有望迁移至代理建模场景。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no biomechanics or implant context, no constraint handling beyond PDE residuals, and validation only on fluid dynamics benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统PINN在参数变化时需重新训练的问题
summary_zh.method: 使用超网络结合低秩适配预测PINN权重，并添加物理约束
summary_zh.result: 在参数化PDE上实现快速求解，参数减少8倍
summary_zh.validation: 在Burger方程和Kovasznay流上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: Address retraining issue of PINNs for varying parameters.
summary_en.method: Hypernetwork with low-rank adaptation to predict PINN weights and physics-informed loss.
summary_en.result: Fast solutions for parameterized PDEs with 8x parameter reduction.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on Burger's equation and Kovasznay flow.

title: How important are specialized transforms in Neural Operators?
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了神经算子中变换层的重要性，提出了用可学习线性层替代的方法，可能对构建高效的有限元替代模型有启发。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or transferability to implant/biomechanics design; it only compares architectural choices in neural operators for PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究神经算子中变换层对性能的必要性
summary_zh.method: 用可学习线性层替换变换层进行对比
summary_zh.result: 线性层在性能和计算速度上均不逊于变换层
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准上进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: This work investigates whether specialized transform layers are essential for the success of transform-based neural operators in solving PDEs.
summary_en.method: The authors replace the transform layers in Fourier/ Wavelet Neural Operators with learnable linear layers and compare performance and computational cost.
summary_en.result: Linear layers achieve comparable performance to transform-based layers, often with a computational advantage.
summary_en.validation: Experiments are conducted on several standard PDE benchmarks, including Darcy flow and other representative problems.

title: Constrained Bayesian Optimization Using a Lagrange Multiplier Applied to Power Transistor Design
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的带拉格朗日乘子的约束贝叶斯优化方法可迁移至植入物/生物力学设计中的昂贵约束优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomechanics or implant design, lacks uncertainty quantification, and only demonstrates on electronic device optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决昂贵的约束优化问题，无需额外代理约束模型。
summary_zh.method: 将约束转化为拉格朗日函数，作为贝叶斯优化的目标函数。
summary_zh.result: 在LDMOS晶体管设计中实现了目标击穿电压约束下的性能优化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过半导体器件仿真案例验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: To perform constrained optimization under expensive black-box constraints without building separate surrogate models for constraints.
summary_en.method: Introduces a Lagrange multiplier to convert the constrained problem into an unconstrained optimization of the Lagrangian within Bayesian Optimization.
summary_en.result: Achieves optimized figure of merit while satisfying target breakdown voltage constraints in LDMOS transistor design.
summary_en.validation: Validated through simulation case studies on power transistor design across a voltage range.

title: A hybrid Decoder-DeepONet operator regression framework for unaligned observation data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了针对非对齐观测数据的混合算子学习框架，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理模型，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或具体植入物应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomechanical constraints, uncertainty quantification, or implant-specific designs; it is validated only on fluid/porous media benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 处理算子学习中常见的非对齐观测数据问题
summary_zh.method: 提出混合Decoder-DeepONet框架，利用平均场输入增强
summary_zh.result: 在Darcy流和机翼绕流问题上预测精度显著提升
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个标准数值算例验证框架有效性

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of unaligned observation data in neural operator learning by developing a framework that reduces dimensionality and computational cost.
summary_en.method: A hybrid Decoder-DeepONet architecture with a Multi-Decoder variant using average-field input augmentation is proposed, grounded in the universal approximation theorem.
summary_en.result: The proposed methods demonstrate improved prediction accuracy and efficient handling of unaligned data on the Darcy flow and airfoil flow problems.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated through two numerical benchmark experiments: the Darcy problem and flow-field around an airfoil.

title: Tipping Point Forecasting in Non-Stationary Dynamics on Function Spaces
relevance_to_user: 本文的神经算子和不确定性量化方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型与临界点预测。
why_not_core: No application to implant mechanics or biomedical FEA; focuses on climate and fluid dynamics tipping points.

summary_zh.motivation: 预测非平稳动力系统的临界点，如气候突变，需要高效且带不确定性的方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出循环神经算子学习函数空间映射，结合共形预测监测物理约束偏差来预警临界点。
summary_zh.result: 在Lorenz-63、Kuramoto-Sivashinsky及平流层云盖等案例中成功预测临界点，并具有零样本泛化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过已知和近似的物理约束在数值基准和实际案例中验证预测准确性。

summary_en.motivation: Forecasting abrupt transitions in non-stationary dynamical systems demands efficient models with rigorous uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.method: A recurrent neural operator learns mappings between function spaces, and a conformal prediction framework detects tipping points by monitoring deviations from physics constraints.
summary_en.result: The method accurately predicts tipping points in Lorenz-63, Kuramoto-Sivashinsky, stratocumulus cloud cover, and airfoil wake transitions, with zero-shot generalization to varying Reynolds numbers.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks and real-world scenarios using both exact and approximate physics constraints.

title: Multi-fidelity Fourier Neural Operator for Fast Modeling of Large-Scale Geological Carbon Storage
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出多保真FNO求解昂贵仿真问题，可迁移至生物力学替代建模以减少计算成本。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on geological carbon storage rather than implant or biomechanics design; it does not address constraints, uncertainty quantification, or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速大规模地质碳封存中压力和CO2羽流的预测。
summary_zh.method: 提出多保真傅里叶神经算子，结合迁移学习处理不同保真度数据。
summary_zh.result: 多保真模型在数据成本降低81%时保持与高保真模型相当的精度。
summary_zh.validation: 在11万和100万网格的油藏模型上进行数值测试。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate prediction of reservoir pressure and CO2 plume migration in large-scale geological carbon storage.
summary_en.method: A multi-fidelity Fourier Neural Operator (FNO) is proposed, leveraging transfer learning across datasets of different fidelities.
summary_en.result: The multi-fidelity model achieves accuracy comparable to a high-fidelity model while reducing data generation cost by 81%.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulations are performed on reservoir models with 110k and 1 million grid cells to test accuracy and generalizability.

title: Enhancing Convergence Speed with Feature-Enforcing Physics-Informed Neural Networks: Utilizing Boundary Conditions as Prior Knowledge for Faster Convergence
relevance_to_user: 该论文改进了PINN的训练收敛速度，可迁移至生物力学或植入物设计的代理模型加速。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and not applied to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速物理信息神经网络收敛，解决损失函数不平衡问题。
summary_zh.method: 两阶段训练：先基于边界条件预训练部分权重，再整体微调。
summary_zh.result: 消除超参数调优需求，在多种基准上加速收敛并提高稳定性。
summary_zh.validation: 在二维圆柱绕流、逆问题和Burgers方程上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the convergence of Physics-Informed Neural Networks by mitigating imbalance in the loss function caused by initial weight states, domain-to-boundary point ratios, and loss weighting factors.
summary_en.method: Proposes a two-stage training method where a unique loss function is used in the first stage to pre-train weights emphasizing boundary conditions, followed by standard PINN training with partial weight initialization from the first stage.
summary_en.result: The method eliminates the need for hyperparameter tuning and achieves faster and more robust convergence compared to vanilla PINNs across several benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation on three numerical benchmarks: 2D flow over a cylinder, an inverse inlet velocity problem, and the Burgers equation.

title: Discretization-Induced Dirichlet Posterior for Robust Uncertainty Quantification on Regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种稳健的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至代理模型回归任务，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not address simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or biomechanical FEA surrogate modeling; it is validated only on vision regression tasks.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决深度神经网络在回归任务中的鲁棒不确定性估计
summary_zh.method: 提出基于离散化狄利克雷后验的广义辅助不确定性估计方案
summary_zh.result: 在年龄估计、深度估计和超分辨率任务上验证了方法的鲁棒性
summary_zh.validation: 在图像级和像素级回归任务上实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To achieve robust uncertainty quantification for deep neural networks in regression tasks, especially under out-of-distribution inputs.
summary_en.method: Proposes Discretization-Induced Dirichlet Posterior (DIDO) for epistemic uncertainty and Laplace distribution for aleatoric uncertainty within an auxiliary uncertainty estimator framework.
summary_en.result: The method provides robust uncertainty estimates on age estimation, monocular depth estimation, and super-resolution tasks, maintaining performance under noisy inputs.
summary_en.validation: Validated on image-level and pixel-wise regression benchmarks with out-of-distribution detection experiments.

title: Structural optimization of orthopedic hip implant using parametric and non-parametric optimization techniques.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少髋关节植入物的应力屏蔽效应
summary_zh.method: 使用参数化和非参数优化技术（拓扑优化与中心复合设计）减轻股骨柄重量
summary_zh.result: 拓扑优化实现34.9%质量减少，参数优化实现22%质量减少
summary_zh.validation: 基于有限元仿真的结构优化验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce stress shielding in hip implants by minimizing implant stiffness through weight reduction.
summary_en.method: Parametric (DoE central composite design with hole diameters) and non-parametric (topology) optimization techniques are applied to a hip implant stem.
summary_en.result: Topology optimization achieves 34.9% mass reduction, while parametric optimization achieves 22% mass reduction.
summary_en.validation: Structural optimization outcomes are validated via finite element simulations.

title: Robust Bayesian Satisficing
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种鲁棒贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至面向植入物设计的代理模型优化中，以处理分布偏移问题。
why_not_core: Does not address expensive FEA simulation, does not handle constraints, and lacks application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 分布偏移对鲁棒性构成挑战
summary_zh.method: 提出RoBOS鲁棒贝叶斯满足算法
summary_zh.result: 实现与偏移量无关的亚线性后悔
summary_zh.validation: 在多个学习任务上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: Distributional shifts challenge robustness in machine learning, requiring methods that ensure performance above a threshold under unknown shifts.
summary_en.method: We propose RoBOS, a robust Bayesian satisficing algorithm for contextual noisy black-box optimization, guaranteeing sublinear lenient regret under distribution shift assumptions.
summary_en.result: RoBOS achieves sublinear robust satisficing regret independent of the shift amount, demonstrated on various learning benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: The algorithm is validated through numerical experiments on learning problems, comparing to distributionally robust optimization.

title: Fast Uncertainty Quantification of Spent Nuclear Fuel with Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用神经网络作为替代模型进行不确定性量化，其方法可迁移至骨科植入物设计的计算效率提升。
why_not_core: This paper addresses nuclear fuel characterization, not biomechanical FEA surrogate nor implant design constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速核废料特性计算及不确定性量化
summary_zh.method: 基于神经网络替代模型预测衰变热和核素浓度
summary_zh.result: 预测精度高，计算成本降低至少10倍
summary_zh.validation: 与CASMO5物理模型及实测数据对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the computationally expensive physics-based simulations for characterizing spent nuclear fuel with uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A neural network surrogate is trained on CASMO5 lattice calculation data to predict decay heat and nuclide concentrations from input parameters.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieves high accuracy and reduces computational cost by a factor of 10 or more compared to the physics-based model.
summary_en.validation: Validation against CASMO5 simulations and experimental measurements from two pressurized water reactors.

title: BREATHE: Second-Order Gradients and Heteroscedastic Emulation based Design Space Exploration
relevance_to_user: 该文提出的约束多目标优化框架结合异方差代理模型和二阶梯度，可迁移至髋关节植入物设计空间探索，但未涉及生物力学FEA验证。
why_not_core: It does not validate on FEA-based biomechanical simulations nor address specific challenges of implant design (e.g., stress shielding, osseointegration).

summary_zh.motivation: 针对昂贵模拟器下设计空间探索样本效率低的问题，提出高效约束多目标优化方法。
summary_zh.method: 利用二阶梯度和异方差代理模型实现样本高效的向量和图空间优化。
summary_zh.result: 在单个目标任务中超基线64.1%，在多目标任务中超基线的超体积达21.9倍。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准MOO基准和图形搜索任务上进行数值评估。

summary_en.motivation: To address sample inefficiency in exploring large design spaces with expensive simulators, this work proposes a constrained multi-objective optimization framework.
summary_en.method: It leverages second-order gradients and heteroscedastic surrogate modeling to achieve sample-efficient optimization over both vector and graph-based design spaces.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms baselines by 64.1% in single-objective tasks and achieves up to 21.9× higher hypervolume in multi-objective tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is conducted on standard MOO benchmarks and a graph-based search example.

title: [Mid-term effectiveness of hip preservation in the reconstruction of ultrashort bone segments in the proximal femur with three-dimensional printed customized cementless intercalary endoprosthesis with an intra-neck curved stem].

summary_zh.method: 对17例患者采用带股骨颈内弯柄的3D打印非骨水泥间置假体，术后随访影像和功能评分。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the design and mid-term outcomes of a 3D-printed cementless intercalary endoprosthesis with an intra-neck curved stem for reconstructing ultrashort proximal femoral segments after tumor resection.

title: Learning Power Flow with Confidence: A Probabilistic Guarantee Framework for Voltage Risk
relevance_to_user: 该论文的GP代理模型与主动学习策略可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但其验证场景为电力系统而非植入物设计。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on power flow surrogate modelling for voltage risk, not on FEA for implant biomechanics, and lacks biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 为机器学习潮流计算提供形式化的可靠性保证，用于安全关键的电压风险评估。
summary_zh.method: 基于高斯过程回归，设计顶点度核函数和网络扫描主动学习算法。
summary_zh.result: 在IEEE大系统上实现高精度电压估计，用15倍更少计算量复现蒙特卡洛级风险。
summary_zh.validation: 在IEEE 118、500、1354节点系统上数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To provide formal probabilistic guarantees for machine-learning-based power flow estimation to enable its use in safety-critical voltage risk assessment.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian Process regression framework with a novel Vertex-Degree Kernel that exploits topology and a network-swipe active learning algorithm for efficient sampling.
summary_en.result: The method achieves mean absolute voltage errors below 1e-03 p.u. and reproduces Monte Carlo-level voltage risk estimates with 15x fewer AC power flow computations.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on IEEE 118-, 500-, and 1354-bus systems verify accuracy and computational savings.

title: Deep Neural Operator Driven Real Time Inference for Nuclear Systems to Enable Digital Twin Solutions
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的DeepONet方法可用于生物力学代理建模，但领域为核工程，缺乏约束处理和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant or biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现核系统数字孪生的实时推理
summary_zh.method: 采用DeepONet作为粒子传输问题的代理模型
summary_zh.result: DeepONet在精度和速度上优于传统机器学习方法
summary_zh.validation: 在粒子传输基准问题上进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To enable real-time inference for digital twins in nuclear systems.
summary_en.method: DeepONet is employed as a surrogate model for the particle transport problem.
summary_en.result: DeepONet outperforms traditional ML methods in both accuracy and computational speed.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a benchmark particle transport problem.

title: A physics-informed machine learning model for reconstruction of dynamic loads
relevance_to_user: 该方法基于高斯过程回归进行力重构，具有不确定性量化能力，可迁移至生物力学中的载荷重构问题。
why_not_core: Does not address expensive FEA simulation surrogate, does not handle constraints, and is not applied to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 从稀疏噪声桥梁响应数据中重构动态荷载
summary_zh.method: 基于物理信息的高斯过程回归模型
summary_zh.result: 重构荷载与真实荷载吻合良好
summary_zh.validation: 大贝尔特东桥气动分析数值模拟

summary_en.motivation: To reconstruct dynamic forces on long-span bridges from sparse and noisy measurements under inherent uncertainty.
summary_en.method: A probabilistic physics-informed Gaussian process regression model that reconstructs forces from deflections, velocities, or accelerations using a quasi-steady aerodynamic model as prior.
summary_en.result: The predicted dynamic loads show good agreement with applied loads, enabling validation of design models and structural health monitoring.
summary_en.validation: Aerodynamic analysis of the Great Belt East Bridge with numerical simulation of quasi-steady response and sparse measurement reconstruction.

title: Fourier neural operator for learning solutions to macroscopic traffic flow models: Application to the forward and inverse problems
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用傅里叶神经算子作为代理模型求解PDE，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的代理建模，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses solely on traffic flow PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 发展神经算子学习交通流PDE的解
summary_zh.method: 使用基于物理的傅里叶神经算子并加入守恒正则化
summary_zh.result: 准确预测环形路网和信号化道路的密度动态
summary_zh.validation: 基于随机分段常数输入的数值模拟验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a neural operator for learning solutions to nonlinear hyperbolic PDEs in macroscopic traffic flow models.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed Fourier neural operator (π-FNO) is trained with a discrete conservation law regularization to capture shocks.
summary_en.result: The operator accurately predicts traffic density dynamics for ring-road and urban signalized networks, with sub-linear extrapolation error growth.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments using the LWR model with random piecewise constant inputs validate the approach.

title: Bayesian Physics-Informed Neural Network for the Forward and Inverse Simulation of Engineered Nano-particles Mobility in a Contaminated Aquifer
relevance_to_user: 该方法将贝叶斯物理信息神经网络应用于地下水纳米颗粒传输建模，其不确定性量化框架可迁移至植入物生物力学代理模型，但非直接针对植入物设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant biomechanics, structural FEA, or surrogate modeling for medical device design; it focuses on environmental groundwater transport.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发预测工具以理解纳米颗粒在地下水中的迁移行为。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯物理信息神经网络模拟纳米颗粒迁移并反演参数。
summary_zh.result: 正向模型准确预测迁移并量化不确定性，反向模型估计控制参数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: The need for a predictive tool to understand and model the transport and retention of engineered nanoparticles in heterogeneous aquifers for effective groundwater remediation.
summary_en.method: A Bayesian Physics-Informed Neural Network (B-PINN) framework is employed for forward simulation and inverse parameter estimation of nanoparticle mobility.
summary_en.result: The forward model accurately predicts nanoparticle transport with uncertainty quantification, and the inverse model successfully estimates governing parameters.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through numerical benchmark cases without experimental data.

key_terms.zh: 贝叶斯物理信息神经网络

title: Learning fast, accurate, and stable closures of a kinetic theory of an active fluid
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用神经网络构建替代模型，通过主动学习和可微求解器实现高效且稳定的闭包预测，其方法可迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模中。
why_not_core: The paper does not address finite element analysis, implant biomechanics, or structural optimization; its application is limited to active fluid kinetic theory.

summary_zh.motivation: 动力学理论模拟计算成本高，需要降阶闭包模型
summary_zh.method: 利用旋转对称性的神经网络学习闭包，结合主动学习和可微求解器
summary_zh.result: 数据驱动闭包准确稳定地复现了速度统计量和功率谱
summary_zh.validation: 与动力学模拟的直接数值结果对比验证

summary_en.motivation: Kinetic theories for active matter are high-dimensional and computationally expensive, necessitating reduced-order closures.
summary_en.method: A neural network exploiting rotational symmetries learns closure terms from simulations, coupled with active learning and a differentiable pseudo-spectral solver for stable a-posteriori inference.
summary_en.result: The data-driven closure accurately reproduces mean velocity, order parameters, and power spectra of the full kinetic model.
summary_en.validation: A-priori and a-posteriori comparisons against kinetic simulations validate accuracy and stability.

title: A practical PINN framework for multi-scale problems with multi-magnitude loss terms
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种针对多尺度问题的PINN损失函数改进方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型，但未涉及植入体或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on multi-scale PDEs without uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or any biomedical/implant application, making it not directly applicable to implant design optimization under uncertainty.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多尺度问题中PINN损失项量级差异大导致优化困难。
summary_zh.method: 提出分组正则化策略调整损失项量级，并采用傅里叶特征等网络结构。
summary_zh.result: 数值算例显示计算精度和效率显著优于传统PINN及现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个多尺度PDE数值算例验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: The paper addresses the challenge of training physics-informed neural networks on multi-scale problems where loss terms have disparate magnitudes.
summary_en.method: It introduces a grouping regularization strategy to rebalance loss terms and combines it with specialized architectures like Fourier features.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate significant improvements in accuracy and efficiency compared to standard PINNs and state-of-the-art methods.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on several challenging multi-scale PDE examples, showing superior performance.

title: A Domain-adaptive Physics-informed Neural Network for Inverse Problems of Maxwell's Equations in Heterogeneous Media
relevance_to_user: 该方法中的域自适应PINN可迁移至生物力学中的异质介质问题，但论文本身未涉及植入物力学或生物医学背景。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on Maxwell's equations in electromagnetics, not on biomechanics, implant design, or stress shielding; it lacks any biomedical context or experimental validation for medical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决异质介质中Maxwell方程逆问题求解困难
summary_zh.method: 提出域自适应PINN，引入介质界面位置参数和界面条件
summary_zh.result: 两个案例验证有效性
summary_zh.validation: 数值模拟案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the challenge of solving inverse problems of Maxwell's equations in heterogeneous media using PINNs.
summary_en.method: A domain-adaptive PINN is proposed, which introduces a location parameter for the media interface and incorporates interface conditions into the loss function.
summary_en.result: The effectiveness is demonstrated with two case studies.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation case studies.

title: PDE Discovery for Soft Sensors Using Coupled Physics-Informed Neural Network with Akaike's Information Criterion
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的PDE发现方法可能迁移到生物力学领域，但未涉及植入物设计或有限元分析验证。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on PDE discovery for soft sensors in industrial processes, with no application to implant biomechanics, FEA surrogate modeling, or uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 弥补理想偏微分方程与实际软传感器之间的差距
summary_zh.method: 结合耦合物理信息神经网络与赤池信息准则自动发现PDE结构
summary_zh.result: 在人工和实际数据集上验证了所提方法的有效性
summary_zh.validation: 人工数据及工业过程实际数据测试

summary_en.motivation: To bridge the gap between idealized PDEs and practical soft sensors by automatically discovering proper PDE structures.
summary_en.method: A coupled physics-informed neural network with Akaike's information criterion (CPINN-AIC) is proposed, using a data-physics hybrid loss function to select differential operators.
summary_en.result: The method demonstrates feasibility and effectiveness on both artificial and practical datasets for soft sensor modeling.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using artificial datasets and a practical industrial process dataset.

key_terms.zh: 数据-物理混合损失函数

title: A study of selective laser melting process for pure zinc and Zn10mg alloy on process parameters and mechanical properties
first_author_affiliation: Faculty of Materials and Manufacturing, Beijing University of Technology, Beijing, China

corresponding_authors.name: Muhammad Waqas
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Faculty of Materials and Manufacturing, Beijing University of Technology, Beijing, China

relevance_to_user: 论文研究了用于生物医学植入物的锌合金的SLM工艺，但未涉及多孔结构、应力遮挡或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration; it focuses on dense zinc alloys.

summary_zh.motivation: 为生物医用可降解锌合金植入物获得高力学性能。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM技术结合响应面法优化工艺参数，制备高致密度锌和Zn10Mg试样。
summary_zh.result: 最优参数下相对密度达99.63%，压缩强度214±13 MPa。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩测试和腐蚀行为分析验证性能。

summary_en.motivation: To fabricate zinc and Zn-10Mg alloys with high mechanical properties via selective laser melting for biomedical implant applications.
summary_en.method: Response surface methodology was used to optimize SLM parameters to achieve high relative density in pure Zn and Zn-10Mg samples.
summary_en.result: Under optimal processing conditions, a relative density of 99.63% and compressive strength of 214±13 MPa were obtained.
summary_en.validation: The mechanical properties were validated through compression testing and corrosion behavior analysis.

title: GPLaSDI: Gaussian Process-based Interpretable Latent Space Dynamics Identification through Deep Autoencoder
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于高斯过程和自动编码器的降阶模型，可用于替代昂贵仿真，且具备不确定性量化能力，对生物力学中的代理模型构建具有迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constrained optimization, multi-objective design, or implant/biomechanics-specific applications; validation is limited to academic PDE benchmarks without biomechanical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 偏微分方程数值求解昂贵，需要快速且准确的降阶模型。
summary_zh.method: 结合自动编码器与高斯过程，在潜空间学习并插值ODE动力学。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE问题上实现200至100,000倍加速，相对误差低于7%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过Burgers、Vlasov和热气泡问题的数值案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Solving PDEs numerically is computationally expensive, motivating the development of reduced-order models that are both accurate and fast.
summary_en.method: GPLaSDI integrates a deep autoencoder to map full-order solutions to a latent space and uses Gaussian processes to interpolate the ODE dynamics governing latent space evolution.
summary_en.result: The method achieves speed-ups between 200x and 100,000x with relative errors up to 7% on benchmark PDE problems.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical simulations of the Burgers equation, Vlasov equation, and a rising thermal bubble problem.

title: 3D-Printed PEEK/Silicon Nitride Scaffolds with a Triply Periodic Minimal Surface Structure for Spinal Fusion Implants
first_author_affiliation: Institute for Biomechanics,ETH Zurich, Zurich 8093, Switzerland

corresponding_authors.name: Xiaoyu Du
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute for Biomechanics,ETH Zurich, Zurich 8093, Switzerland

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过TPMS多孔结构和力学测试评估了PEEK/SiN支架的骨匹配性能，但未涉及疲劳测试、应力遮挡或LPBF制造。
why_not_core: This paper does not use LPBF fabrication, does not report fatigue testing, surface roughness, or osseointegration, and does not explicitly address stress shielding in the context of hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发具有骨匹配力学性能和成骨能力的脊柱融合植入物材料与结构。
summary_zh.method: 采用3D打印制备不同孔隙率PEEK/SiN TPMS支架，进行力学测试和有限元分析。
summary_zh.result: 30%孔隙率支架的压缩强度和弹性模量与骨小梁相似，并具有良好阻尼性能和成骨分化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩试验和有限元模拟验证力学性能，通过细胞实验验证成骨分化。

summary_en.motivation: To develop biomaterials and structures for spinal fusion implants that mimic the mechanical properties and osteogenic capacity of host bone.
summary_en.method: 3D-printed polyether ether ketone/silicon nitride scaffolds with triply periodic minimal surface structures of varying porosities were fabricated and characterized mechanically via testing and finite element analysis.
summary_en.result: The scaffold with 30% porosity exhibited compressive strength and elastic modulus comparable to trabecular bone, along with favorable damping properties and stimulated osteogenic differentiation.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated by compression testing and finite element simulations, while biological activity was confirmed through in vitro osteogenic differentiation assays.

title: Efficient Bayesian Optimization with Deep Kernel Learning and Transformer Pre-trained on Multiple Heterogeneous Datasets
relevance_to_user: 该论文的预训练代理模型方法可迁移至生物力学植入物设计的昂贵仿真采样优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design problems, does not handle constraints common in design optimization, and lacks experimental validation on physical or biomedical FEA simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用多任务预训练提升贝叶斯优化采样效率
summary_zh.method: 使用Transformer编码器学习深度核函数，结合高斯过程构建预训练代理模型
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实基准测试上优于现有迁移BO方法
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准数据集上比较性能

summary_en.motivation: To improve the sampling efficiency of Bayesian optimization by pre-training a surrogate model on multiple heterogeneous datasets from prior tasks.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process with a deep kernel defined by a Transformer encoder is pre-trained on prior tasks, with a mix-up initialization for unseen input variables.
summary_en.result: The proposed transfer BO approach outperforms existing methods on both synthetic and real benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard benchmark functions and datasets.

title: Generative Models for Anomaly Detection and Design-Space Dimensionality Reduction in Shape Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过降维和异常检测提高形状优化效率，可迁移至植入物或生物力学设计的代理模型优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, does not include constraints handling for biomedical applications, and lacks experimental validation in a biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高形状优化效率并避免几何异常设计
summary_zh.method: 使用概率线性潜变量模型（因子分析、PPCA）降维并检测异常
summary_zh.result: 新框架提升了优化收敛速度，仅生成高质量几何设计
summary_zh.validation: 通过DTMB 5415船体形状优化数值验证

summary_en.motivation: Improve efficiency of shape optimization while preventing geometrically anomalous designs.
summary_en.method: Reduce design space dimensionality and detect anomalies using probabilistic latent variable models (factor analysis, PPCA).
summary_en.result: The framework enhances convergence of global optimization algorithms and produces only high-quality designs, saving computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated on the DTMB 5415 hull shape optimization benchmark.

title: Fourier neural operator for real-time simulation of 3D dynamic urban microclimate
relevance_to_user: 该论文的FNO方法可迁移到生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或生物医学场景。
why_not_core: No implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速城市微气候CFD模拟，实现实时预测。
summary_zh.method: 用CFD数据训练FNO模型预测三维风场。
summary_zh.result: FNO毫秒级预测，对不同风向泛化良好。
summary_zh.validation: 用不同风向的CFD测试数据验证模型泛化能力。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate computationally expensive CFD simulations of urban microclimates for real-time applications.
summary_en.method: A Fourier Neural Operator is trained on CFD-generated data to predict 3D wind velocity fields in urban areas.
summary_en.result: The FNO model predicts instantaneous wind fields in milliseconds and generalizes to unseen wind directions.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing FNO predictions against CFD simulations for different wind directions.

title: Learning-based Near-optimal Motion Planning for Intelligent Vehicles with Uncertain Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 与用户方向无直接关联，但GP和RL方法可迁移至代理模型和优化问题
why_not_core: No FEA, no biomechanics, no implant design. Vehicle dynamics only.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决不确定动力学下智能车辆运动规划效率与最优性问题
summary_zh.method: 提出基于高斯过程和稀疏核强化学习的在线自适应规划算法
summary_zh.result: 算法在仿真和实车实验中优于多种先进方法
summary_zh.validation: 仿真和实车实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To address efficient and optimal motion planning under uncertain dynamics, a sparse kernel-based RL algorithm with GP regression is proposed.
summary_en.method: The method learns uncertain dynamics online using sparse GP and optimizes policies with an exponential barrier function for obstacle avoidance.
summary_en.result: The approach outperforms baselines in simulations and real vehicle tests, demonstrating practical planning capability.
summary_en.validation: Validation includes extensive simulations and experiments on a Hongqi E-HS3 vehicle.

title: Densification behaviour of laser powder bed fusion processed Ti6Al4V: Effects of customized heat treatment and build direction
venue: Proceedings of the Institution of Mechanical Engineers Part E Journal of Process Mechanical Engineering
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Jammu, Jammu, J&K, India

corresponding_authors.name: S. Anand Kumar
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical Engineering, Indian Institute of Technology Jammu, Jammu, J&K, India

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF Ti6Al4V的致密化和力学性能，对理解植入物制造工艺有参考价值，但未涉及应力屏蔽或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not link porous structure to stress shielding or stiffness matching, nor does it report fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究定制热处理和构建方向对LPBF Ti6Al4V致密化行为的影响。
summary_zh.method: 采用定制热处理、光学显微镜和XRD分析孔隙和微观结构。
summary_zh.result: 定制热处理使总孔隙率降低两倍，水平方向超级微孔减少44%，垂直方向减少46%，延展性各向异性大幅改善。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试（延展性）和微观结构表征验证。

summary_en.motivation: This work investigates the effects of customized heat treatment and build direction on the densification behavior and microstructural evolution of laser powder bed fusion (LPBF) Ti6Al4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Customized heat treatment was applied, and optical microscopy and X-ray diffraction were used to evaluate porosity, microstructure, and phase composition.
summary_en.result: Customized heat treatment reduced overall porosity by a factor of two compared to as-printed samples, decreased super-micropores by approximately 44% in the horizontal direction and 46% in the vertical direction, and significantly improved ductility isotropy (isotropic index from 0.61 to 0.97).
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (ductility measurements) and microstructural characterization (optical microscopy, XRD) were performed to validate the effects.

title: Applied metamodelling for ATM performance simulations
relevance_to_user: 该论文将主动学习元建模方法应用于空中交通管理仿真，但方法（主动学习+SHAP）可迁移至FEA替代模型，未涉及生物力学或植入物设计约束与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA, implant design, biomechanics, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification in the context of solid mechanics; its application domain is air traffic management.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低ATM仿真计算负担，提高可解释性
summary_zh.method: 提出XALM框架，结合主动学习和SHAP构建元模型
summary_zh.result: 预测性能与XGBoost相当，但所需仿真次数更少
summary_zh.validation: 以巴黎戴高乐机场实际场景的Mercury仿真器验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of air traffic management simulations while enhancing interpretability for policy analysis.
summary_en.method: XALM integrates active learning with SHAP values to build sparse yet accurate metamodels from simulator outputs.
summary_en.result: The active learning metamodel achieves predictive performance comparable to XGBoost with fewer simulations and superior explanatory capability.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on a real-world scenario at Paris Charles de Gaulle airport using the Mercury ATM simulator.

title: Randomized Neural Networks with Petrov-Galerkin Methods for Solving Linear Elasticity Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了随机神经网络与Petrov-Galerkin方法相结合求解线弹性问题，可直接作为FEA代理模型的基础方法，但缺乏UQ和植入物相关验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not include uncertainty quantification, implant-specific geometry or boundary conditions, nor any experimental or clinical validation for biomedical applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 发展高效且精确的线弹性问题数值解法
summary_zh.method: 采用随机神经网络结合Petrov-Galerkin变分框架，输出层由最小二乘确定
summary_zh.result: 与有限元、间断伽辽金及PINN相比，精度和效率更高

title: An overlapping domain decomposition method for the solution of parametric elliptic problems via proper generalized decomposition

why_not_core: This paper does not address uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics applications; it is validated only on numerical benchmarks for diffusion and convection-diffusion problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解参数化椭圆问题的代理模型
summary_zh.method: 结合重叠域分解和广义特征分解的非侵入式方法
summary_zh.result: 数值算例显示精度高且鲁棒性优于传统方法
summary_zh.validation: 扩散和对流扩散问题的数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently construct surrogate models for parametric linear elliptic problems by reducing computational cost.
summary_en.method: A non-intrusive proper generalized decomposition (PGD) strategy coupled with an overlapping domain decomposition (DD) method using arbitrary Dirichlet interface conditions and an algebraic formulation.
summary_en.result: The DD-PGD approach achieves high accuracy and robustness, outperforming standard high-fidelity DD methods on parametric diffusion and convection-diffusion problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on parametric diffusion and convection-diffusion problems demonstrate accuracy and computational efficiency.

title: Transport Equation based Physics Informed Neural Network to predict the Yield Strength of Architected Materials
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用PINN进行代理建模，可迁移至生物力学领域，但缺乏不确定性量化和约束处理。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用PINN求解输运方程，预测点阵材料屈服强度。
summary_zh.method: 构建含不同激活函数的PINN模型，基于数据集训练。
summary_zh.result: 激活函数选择对精度影响小，PINN泛化能力强。
summary_zh.validation: 使用MSE和MAE在数据集上评估模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: To apply Physics-Informed Neural Networks to solve a transport PDE for predicting the yield strength of architected materials.
summary_en.method: A PINN model with various activation functions was trained on a dataset of strut diameter, unit cell size, and yield stress values.
summary_en.result: The activation function choice had minimal effect on predictive accuracy, and the PINN demonstrated strong generalization without overfitting.
summary_en.validation: Model performance was validated using mean squared error and mean absolute error on the same dataset; no independent experimental validation was performed.

title: Extended tensor decomposition model reduction methods: training, prediction, and design under uncertainty
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出的张量分解模型降阶技术可用于生物力学代理模型构建，但未涉及植入物设计与骨骼界面力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not cover implant-specific contact mechanics, bone-implant interface, or patient-specific biomechanics validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升强非线性时空参数问题的模型降阶精度与可压缩性
summary_zh.method: 提出扩展张量分解方法，引入稀疏非分离富集项改进传统分解
summary_zh.result: 成功应用于弹塑性及增材制造残余应力预测，支持不确定性量化
summary_zh.validation: 与有限元对比验证计算效率与精度

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and compressibility of model reduction for highly nonlinear and singular parametric space-time problems.
summary_en.method: An extended tensor decomposition (XTD) method with sparse non-separated enrichment is proposed.
summary_en.result: The method accurately and efficiently predicts elastic-plastic and additive manufacturing residual stress with uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing predictions with full-order finite element simulations.

why_not_core: Does not cover porous structures for stress shielding, no fatigue testing, no surface roughness or osseointegration analysis.

summary_zh.result: Cu、W、Co的添加影响微观结构、力学和腐蚀行为。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和腐蚀实验验证材料性能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop biodegradable FeMn-based alloys with enhanced mechanical and corrosion properties for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: FeMn(35−x)–x (Cu, W, Co) alloys were synthesized via mechanical alloying followed by selective laser melting.
summary_en.result: The addition of Cu, W, and Co significantly altered the microstructure, mechanical strength, and corrosion rate of the alloys.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing (compression, hardness) and electrochemical corrosion tests were performed to characterize the materials.

why_not_core: Does not study porous structures, fatigue behavior, surface roughness, or osseointegration; lacks implant-specific stress shielding analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 控制增材制造钛合金的晶体取向以定制弹性模量
summary_zh.method: 通过多道耦合定向凝固技术编程<001>取向
summary_zh.result: 沿任意方向实现约60 GPa的低弹性模量
summary_zh.validation: 实验测量弹性模量

summary_en.motivation: To program crystallographic orientation along arbitrary 3D directions in additively manufactured beta-type titanium alloys for tailored properties.
summary_en.method: Established a multitrack coupled directional solidification technique via laser powder bed fusion to achieve continuous epitaxial growth.
summary_en.result: Achieved low elastic modulus of approximately 60 GPa along arbitrary 3D directions.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurement of elastic modulus using mechanical testing.

title: Prediction of wind turbines power with physics-informed neural networks and evidential uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用PINN和不确定性量化进行风机功率预测，其代理建模和约束处理技术可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的有限元替代建模。
why_not_core: This paper applies PINNs to wind turbine power prediction, not to FEA surrogate modelling for implant biomechanics, and lacks validation on biomedical or structural mechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 需要精确且鲁棒的风机功率预测模型以优化控制和故障检测
summary_zh.method: 利用物理信息神经网络结合证据不确定性层回归功率、扭矩和功率系数
summary_zh.result: 模型对真实数据与物理方程均表现出高精度，不确定性估计与绝对误差一致
summary_zh.validation: 使用四台风机历史数据验证，并与物理方程对比

summary_en.motivation: Accurate and robust wind turbine power prediction models are needed to optimize control and enable early fault detection.
summary_en.method: Physics-informed neural networks with an evidential uncertainty layer are used to regress power, torque, and power coefficient from historical data while enforcing physical constraints.
summary_en.result: The models achieve high accuracy on both real data and governing physical equations, with uncertainty estimates that are consistent with absolute errors.
summary_en.validation: Validated on historical data from four turbines in a wind farm, with comparison to physical equations.

title: Guaranteed Approximation Bounds for Mixed-Precision Neural Operators
relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于混合精度训练神经算子以提高效率，其方法可迁移至费时FEA代理模型的训练中。
why_not_core: Does not address FEA surrogate modeling for biomechanics, lacks uncertainty quantification and constraint handling, and no application to implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高分辨率神经算子训练受限于内存和时间
summary_zh.method: 理论证明混合精度FNO的误差界，并优化张量收缩顺序
summary_zh.result: GPU内存减少50%，吞吐量提升58%，精度几乎无损
summary_zh.validation: 在多种算子和数据集上实验验证

summary_en.motivation: Training neural operators at high spatial resolution is limited by GPU memory and time.
summary_en.method: We prove approximation bounds for mixed-precision Fourier Neural Operators and optimize half-precision tensor contraction order via greedy algorithm.
summary_en.result: Mixed-precision training reduces GPU memory by up to 50% and improves throughput by 58% with minimal accuracy loss.
summary_en.validation: Experiments on multiple neural operator architectures, datasets, and GPU platforms validate the theoretical bounds and practical gains.

title: Physics-Informed Machine Learning of Argon Gas-Driven Melt Pool Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽然应用于增材制造熔池模拟，但其物理信息神经网络框架可迁移至生物力学代理模型，减少昂贵仿真的采样成本。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no explicit handling of constraints, and no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低金属增材制造熔池动力学仿真的高计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 将神经网络与物理定律结合，无需速度训练数据求解Navier-Stokes方程。
summary_zh.result: 高效预测温度、速度和压力，同时发现模型常数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过偏微分方程软约束验证，与仿真结果对比。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of simulating melt pool dynamics in metal additive manufacturing using physics-based CFD.
summary_en.method: The authors propose a physics-informed neural network that integrates governing physical laws without requiring velocity training data, bypassing numerical solution of the Navier-Stokes equation.
summary_en.result: The PINN efficiently predicts temperature, velocity, and pressure fields, and infers difficult-to-determine model constants through data-driven discovery.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated by incorporating PDE residuals, initial conditions, and boundary conditions into the loss function, without external experimental data.

title: Neural Operators for PDE Backstepping Control of First-Order Hyperbolic PIDE with Recycle and Delay
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用神经算子逼近偏微分方程解，可迁移至有限元代理建模以提高采样效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification, or biomechanics/implant design; it focuses on control of hyperbolic PDEs with delays.

summary_zh.motivation: 将DeepONet框架扩展到含时滞的双曲型PDE控制中。
summary_zh.method: 用DeepONet近似PDE反步法产生的增益函数，替代数值求解。
summary_zh.result: 近似增益下闭环稳定，计算量降低两个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值仿真验证理论结果和效率提升。

summary_en.motivation: To extend the DeepONet operator-learning framework to control of first-order hyperbolic PIDEs with state and output delays.
summary_en.method: DeepONet is used to approximate the gain functions generated by PDE backstepping, mapping PDE coefficients to gain functions, replacing numerical PDE solving.
summary_en.result: Closed-loop stability is proven under approximate gains, and numerical simulations demonstrate two orders of magnitude computational savings.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulations illustrate the theoretical results and quantify computational efficiency.

title: Data-Induced Interactions of Sparse Sensors Using Statistical Physics
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至代理模型中的传感器布局优化与不确定性量化，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modelling, constraint handling, multi-objective optimization, or biomechanics implant design; it focuses on sparse sensor reconstruction in a general data-driven setting.

summary_zh.motivation: 最优传感器配置需要量化传感器间的相互作用
summary_zh.method: 将传感器放置问题转化为伊辛模型，计算数据诱导的传感器相互作用
summary_zh.result: 正则化重构显著降低了少传感器时的误差，并首次提供了不确定性量化
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证重构误差和不确定性估计

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the interactions among sensors for optimal placement and reconstruction from sparse measurements.
summary_en.method: Reformulates sensor placement as an Ising model to compute the full landscape of data-induced sensor interactions.
summary_en.result: Regularized reconstruction significantly reduces reconstruction error for few sensors and provides the first uncertainty quantification for sparse sensing.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks using gappy interpolation and QR factorization-based sensor placement algorithms.

title: Accurate error estimation for model reduction of nonlinear dynamical systems via data-enhanced error closure
relevance_to_user: 本论文针对非线性动力系统降阶模型的误差估计提出数据增强方法，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的准确性评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not include any implant biomechanics application, FEA case studies, or experimental validation in biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决模型降阶误差估计依赖时间积分方案的问题。
summary_zh.method: 提出数据增强的闭合项改进降阶模型精度。
summary_zh.result: 在三个非线性系统上验证了误差估计的准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To eliminate the dependence of a posteriori error estimators on specific time integration schemes for reduced-order models.
summary_en.method: A data-enhanced closure term is introduced to correct the reduced-order model and approximate local truncation error.
summary_en.result: The proposed error estimator achieves accurate error bounds and produces generalizable parametric reduced-order models on three test systems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on nonlinear dynamical systems.

title: LineWalker: Line Search for Black Box Derivative-Free Optimization and Surrogate Model Construction
relevance_to_user: 与FEA代理模型方向相关，但方法通用，未针对生物力学或植入物设计验证。
why_not_core: No FEA or biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification; tested only on synthetic benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对黑盒昂贵函数的优化与代理模型构建，提出简单有效的采样方法。
summary_zh.method: 沿一维线段等距布点，通过评估稀疏网格点并用禁忌搜索逐步细化代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 在非凸测试函数上优于贝叶斯优化和NOMAD等方法。
summary_zh.validation: 基于数学测试函数的数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize and approximate expensive black-box functions with a surrogate model using only a limited number of function evaluations.
summary_en.method: LineWalker iteratively samples sparse grid points along a line, identifies local minima and maxima via a smooth surrogate, and employs tabu search for diversification to guide new evaluations.
summary_en.result: On predominantly nonconvex benchmark functions, LineWalker outperforms Bayesian optimization and NOMAD in terms of convergence and surrogate accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks using standard test functions with known global optima.

title: Revealing the Predictive Power of Neural Operators for Strain Evolution in Digital Composites
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至生物力学代理建模，但缺乏不确定性量化且未涉及植入物设计约束。

summary_zh.motivation: 降低层次复合材料应变演化的计算成本

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the prohibitive computational cost of modeling strain evolution in hierarchical composites using physics-based solvers.
summary_en.method: Three neural operator architectures (FNO, WNO, MWT) are trained on initial strain frames to predict future strain trajectories in 2D digital composites.
summary_en.result: The Fourier Neural Operator achieves the best predictive performance and inference speed, reducing computation time by three orders of magnitude compared to finite element solutions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks against finite element simulations for various boundary conditions and geometries.

title: Physics-based Reduced Order Modeling for Uncertainty Quantification of Guided Wave Propagation using Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的贝叶斯优化降阶模型可用于解决昂贵仿真采样效率问题，且包含不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学植入物设计中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomechanical implant design, constraint handling, or multi-objective optimization; its validation is purely numerical and non-biomedical.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升结构健康监测中导波传播模拟的效率与不确定性量化准确性。
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯优化自适应采样结合机器学习降阶模型替代高保真有限元仿真。
summary_zh.result: 相比一次性采样方法，贝叶斯优化降阶模型在精度和计算加速上均更优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过铝板导波传播的有限元仿真案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of uncertainty quantification for guided wave propagation in structural health monitoring by reducing the number of expensive finite element simulations.
summary_en.method: A machine learning-based reduced order model is integrated with Bayesian optimization for adaptive sampling to construct a surrogate of the high-fidelity FEM simulation.
summary_en.result: The Bayesian optimization-driven reduced order model achieves higher accuracy and greater speed-up compared to one-shot sampling methods.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on a numerical case study of guided wave propagation in an aluminum plate with varying material properties.

title: Characterization of partial wetting by CMAS droplets using multiphase many-body dissipative particle dynamics and data-driven discovery based on PINNs

summary_zh.validation: 通过模拟数据验证PINN与B-PINN的参数识别能力。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently identify parameters governing the wetting dynamics of highly viscous molten CMAS droplets.
summary_en.method: Combines multiphase mDPD simulations with PINN-based parameter discovery and Bayesian UQ for a coarse ODE model.
summary_en.result: Closed-form dependencies of ODE parameters on initial droplet radius and contact angle are discovered via symbolic regression.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing PINN-identified parameters to simulation data and assessing uncertainty with B-PINNs.

summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art quality diversity algorithms on benchmark problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard test functions.

title: Artificial Intelligence for Science in Quantum, Atomistic, and Continuum Systems
relevance_to_user: 这篇综述涵盖AI在连续介质系统中的应用，但对FEA代理模型、植入物生物力学或约束优化缺乏专门讨论。
why_not_core: This paper is a broad review of AI methods across quantum, atomistic, and continuum systems; it does not provide specific methods for FEA surrogate modelling, constraint handling in design optimization, or implant biomechanics validation.

summary_zh.motivation: AI正在推动自然科学发现的新范式，需要统一处理量子到宏观尺度的物理系统。
summary_zh.method: 系统综述了在量子、原子和连续介质系统中实现对称性等变性的深度学习技术，并讨论了可解释性、分布外泛化等挑战。
summary_zh.result: 提供了技术性的统一阐述，分类整理了相关资源，为AI4Science研究奠定了基础。
summary_zh.validation: 作为综述，未提供新的验证结果，而是总结了现有方法的验证策略。

summary_en.motivation: Advances in AI are enabling a new paradigm for scientific discovery across multiple scales, necessitating a unified technical treatment of AI methods for physical systems.
summary_en.method: This review provides an in-depth account of techniques for achieving equivariance to symmetry transformations, along with discussions on explainability, out-of-distribution generalization, and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: It offers a comprehensive categorization of resources and a unified foundation for AI4Science in quantum, atomistic, and continuum domains.
summary_en.validation: The paper is a review and does not present new experimental validation; it surveys existing validation approaches from the literature.

title: Global sensitivity analysis with limited data via sparsity-promoting D-MORPH regression: Application to char combustion

summary_zh.motivation: 复杂工程系统中生成训练数据成本高昂，需要高效代理模型方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于稀疏性D-MORPH回归的代理模型，利用Lasso解指导回归。
summary_zh.result: 新方法仅需传统回归15%的训练数据即可达到相同精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数学函数和木炭燃烧模拟验证准确性和效率。

summary_en.motivation: Training expensive-to-evaluate complex engineering models motivates surrogate methods that work with limited data.
summary_en.method: A sparsity-promoting D-MORPH regression is proposed, using a sparse Lasso solution to define the cost function for subsequent D-MORPH optimization.
summary_en.result: The D-MORPH-based surrogate achieves the same accuracy as conventional regression while requiring only 15% of the training data.
summary_en.validation: Accuracy and efficiency are demonstrated on mathematical functions and an expensive char combustion simulation model.

title: Influence of stress-relieving heat treatments on the efficacy of Co-Cr-Mo-W alloy copings fabricated using selective laser melting

corresponding_authors.name: Hein Linn Htat

why_not_core: This paper focuses on dental copings rather than load-bearing hip implants, does not address porous structures or stress shielding, and lacks fatigue testing.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估应力消除热处理对SLM钴铬合金牙冠性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制造Co-Cr样品，进行750°C和1150°C应力消除处理，比较其微观结构、表面粗糙度、金属-陶瓷结合强度、边缘和内部适合作。
summary_zh.result: 热处理降低了结合强度和边缘适合性，而未经处理的样品性能更佳。
summary_zh.validation: 通过结合强度、硬度、残余应力和边缘间隙测量进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate the influence of stress-relieving heat treatments on the mechanical and fit properties of SLM-fabricated Co-Cr alloy dental copings.
summary_en.method: SLM-manufactured Co-Cr samples were stress-relieved at 750°C and 1150°C, and their microstructure, surface roughness, metal-ceramic bond strength, marginal/internal fit, Vickers hardness, and residual stress were compared to as-built samples.
summary_en.result: Post-heat treatments degraded bond strength and marginal fit, while as-built samples exhibited superior performance, suggesting direct application of as-built SLM crowns is viable.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing including bond strength, hardness, and residual stress measurements, along with marginal gap assessment using microscopy, validated the findings.

title: Auxiliary-Tasks Learning for Physics-Informed Neural Network-Based Partial Differential Equations Solving
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过辅助任务学习提高PINN求解偏微分方程的精度，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN求解偏微分方程的精度和收敛性。

summary_zh.result: 在三个PDE问题上最高提升96.62%精度，平均提升28.23%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个不同领域的PDE数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the accuracy and convergence of physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving PDEs.
summary_en.method: Proposes auxiliary-task learning modes with gradient cosine similarity to integrate auxiliary and primary losses.
summary_en.result: Achieves up to 96.62% accuracy improvement (average 28.23%) over single-task PINNs on three PDE problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three numerical PDE benchmarks from different physical domains.

title: A Solution to the Ill-Conditioning of Gradient-Enhanced Covariance Matrices for Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该方法改进了高斯过程代理模型的数值稳定性，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及实际FEA问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA surrogate modeling, does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization, and lacks validation on biomechanics or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决梯度增强高斯过程协方差矩阵病态问题
summary_zh.method: 使用对角预处理器和小幅nugget改善条件数
summary_zh.result: 新方法使贝叶斯优化收敛精度提高5-9个数量级
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To address the ill-conditioning of gradient-enhanced covariance matrices in Gaussian processes to improve surrogate modeling stability.
summary_en.method: A diagonal preconditioner combined with a small nugget is applied to bound the condition number without restricting data or hyperparameters.
summary_en.result: The new method improves convergence of Bayesian optimization by 5 to 9 orders of magnitude in gradient norm compared to baselines.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on standard optimization benchmarks and compared against hyperparameter constraint and rescaling methods.

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to fill the gap regarding the combined effects of hydroxyapatite concentration and unit cell geometry on the biomechanical performance of PCL/HA scaffolds produced by LPBF.
summary_en.method: Scaffolds with diamond and rhombic dodecahedron unit cells and HA concentrations of 5, 30, and 50 wt.% were fabricated by LPBF and subjected to structural, mechanical, and biological characterization.
summary_en.result: HA negatively affects compaction under compression but positively influences cell adhesion; unit cell geometry affects plastic mechanical response and cell proliferation.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical compression tests and in vitro cell viability assays were performed.

title: Functional PCA and Deep Neural Networks-based Bayesian Inverse Uncertainty Quantification with Transient Experimental Data
relevance_to_user: 该方法涉及贝叶斯逆不确定性量化与代理模型，可转移至生物力学仿真中的参数校准，但未涉及植入物设计或有限元分析。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently perform inverse uncertainty quantification for time-dependent responses by reducing the dimensionality of transient experimental data.
summary_en.method: Functional principal component analysis and deep neural network surrogates are employed to reduce dimension and accelerate Markov Chain Monte Carlo sampling.
summary_en.result: The functional alignment method improves dimensionality reduction of transient profiles, and the proposed inverse UQ process yields better agreement with experimental data.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated using the FEBA transient experiment measuring peak cladding temperature.

title: DADO -- Low-Cost Query Strategies for Deep Active Design Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出基于深度主动学习的设计优化策略，直接解决了昂贵仿真采样效率问题，方法可迁移至生物力学领域，但缺乏不确定性量化且未涉及植入物设计。

summary_zh.result: 在流体动力学数据集上显著优于随机采样。
summary_zh.validation: 基于流体动力学数据集的数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: Reduce the computational cost of expensive numerical simulations in design optimization by querying only promising candidates.
summary_en.method: Proposed two self-optimization selection strategies for deep active learning that avoid uncertainty estimation and support multi-objective optimization.
summary_en.result: The strategies achieved significant improvements over random sampling on a large fluid dynamics dataset.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark evaluation using a fluid dynamics dataset and two new performance metrics.

title: Training Physics-Informed Neural Networks via Multi-Task Optimization for Traffic Density Prediction

summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测量验证力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the microstructure and mechanical properties of TNTZO gum metal titanium alloy fabricated by selective laser melting for potential applications.
summary_en.method: Selective laser melting was used to fabricate the alloy, followed by microstructural characterization and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: The microstructure and mechanical properties were characterized, and the influence of processing parameters was analyzed.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical properties were validated through experimental testing.

title: Functional Causal Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了功能因果贝叶斯优化框架，利用高斯过程优化因果图中的功能干预，但其未涉及有限元分析或生物力学设计的具体应用，需额外适配。
why_not_core: No FEA simulation, no constraint handling, no biomedical or implant context, and no experimental validation in the target domain.

summary_zh.motivation: 已知因果图中通过功能干预优化目标变量，但现有方法无法处理函数形式的干预。
summary_zh.method: 提出fCBO框架，在再生核希尔伯特空间中用高斯过程建模未知目标函数，并通过期望改进获取函数顺序选择干预函数。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实因果图中，fCBO相比基线方法取得了更好的目标优化效果。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成数据和真实因果图上的数值实验进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing causal Bayesian optimization methods cannot handle functional interventions that set a variable as a deterministic function of others.
summary_en.method: fCBO models unknown objectives with Gaussian processes defined on a reproducing kernel Hilbert space and selects functions via an expected improvement acquisition functional.
summary_en.result: fCBO achieves better target variable optimization compared to baselines on both synthetic and real-world causal graphs.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic data and a real-world causal graph.

title: Stem alignment with short tapered-wedge cementless stems affects bone mineral density continuously for at least 5 years after primary total hip arthroplasty
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Osaka Saiseikai Nakatsu Hospital, Osaka, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Kentaro Iwakiri
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopaedic Surgery, Shiraniwa Hospital Joint Arthroplasty Centre, Nara, Japan

relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了短锥形压配无骨水泥柄对齐与Gruen区骨密度变化的临床证据，可用于验证或校准有限元模型中的骨重塑预测。
why_not_core: This paper does not perform any finite element analysis, contact mechanics simulation, or direct stress/strain measurement, and does not provide implant design or boundary conditions for FE modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估短锥形压配无骨水泥柄的三维对齐与术后5年骨密度变化的关系。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析52例患者，使用3D模板测量柄对齐，DXA评估7个Gruen区BMD变化。
summary_zh.result: 内翻和屈曲插入与特定区BMD下降显著相关，且影响持续5年以上。
summary_zh.validation: 基于患者临床DXA数据的回顾性研究。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the relationship between three-dimensional alignment of short tapered-wedge cementless stems and periprosthetic bone mineral density changes over 5 years after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: A retrospective analysis of 52 patients was performed, using 3D templating software to measure stem alignment and DXA to quantify BMD changes in 7 Gruen zones.
summary_en.result: Varus and flexed stem alignment were significantly correlated with decreased BMD in specific zones, with effects persisting beyond 5 years.
summary_en.validation: Clinical retrospective study with DXA measurements on patient cohort.

key_terms.zh: 短锥形压配无骨水泥柄

title: RANS-PINN based Simulation Surrogates for Predicting Turbulent Flows
relevance_to_user: 该论文的PINN方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但流体力学背景与固体力学植入物设计差异较大。
why_not_core: No solid mechanics, no implant or biomechanics application, no uncertainty quantification, and no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 湍流数值模拟计算成本高，需要高效代理模型
summary_zh.method: 提出RANS-PINN框架，结合两方程涡粘模型与物理信息神经网络
summary_zh.result: RANS-PINN能有效预测高雷诺数湍流的速度和压力场
summary_zh.validation: 基于参数化PINN在湍流基准案例上验证

summary_en.motivation: Simulating turbulent flows is computationally expensive, motivating the need for efficient surrogate models.
summary_en.method: RANS-PINN integrates a two-equation eddy viscosity model with physics-informed neural networks to predict mean flow fields.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework accurately predicts velocity and pressure in high Reynolds number turbulent regimes.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on parametric PINN using standard turbulent flow test cases.
