参数化物理信息神经网络

title: Group Equivariant Fourier Neural Operators for Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出的群等变神经算子可用于构建代理模型，但未涉及约束处理、不确定性量化或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: Does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or sampling efficiency in expensive simulations; no application to implant or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升神经算子对物理对称性的利用
summary_zh.method: 在频域引入群等变卷积，设计等变Fourier层
summary_zh.result: 新架构在不同输入分辨率和对称性下表现优异
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准实验

summary_en.motivation: To improve the exploitation of physical symmetries in neural operators for solving PDEs.
summary_en.method: Extends group convolutions to the frequency domain by leveraging the equivariance of the Fourier transform, designing Fourier layers equivariant to rotations, translations, and reflections.
summary_en.result: The proposed G-FNO architecture generalizes well across input resolutions and performs well in settings with varying levels of symmetry.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark PDE problems, demonstrating improved performance over standard FNOs.

title: Energy-Dissipative Evolutionary Deep Operator Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的能量耗散保持的算子学习方法可迁移至植入物生物力学的代理建模，但未涉及具体植入物应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant-specific mechanics, lacks experimental validation, and does not include uncertainty quantification for implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 为解决传统DeepONet无法保持物理约束的问题
summary_zh.method: 采用标量辅助变量法将物理守恒律嵌入网络损失函数
summary_zh.result: 在热方程和Allen-Cahn方程上验证了长时间预测的精度和能量耗散保持
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准算例对比预测解与解析解或数值解

summary_en.motivation: To address the limitation of standard DeepONets in preserving essential physical constraints such as energy dissipation in time-dependent PDEs.
summary_en.method: Incorporates a scalar auxiliary variable approach to enforce unconditional energy dissipation at the discrete level within the operator learning framework.
summary_en.result: Achieves accurate long-time predictions for heat and Allen-Cahn equations while maintaining the energy dissipation law.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks comparing predicted solutions with ground truth or high-fidelity numerical solutions.

title: Efficient Uncertainty Quantification and Reduction for Over-Parameterized Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的不确定性量化方法，可降低神经网络的训练开销，适用于代理模型的不确定性评估。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomechanics application, no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 深度神经网络的不确定性因训练噪声难以量化且计算成本高
summary_zh.method: 基于神经切线核理论构建过程噪声校正预测器，仅需一个辅助网络
summary_zh.result: 只需少量网络即可构建渐近精确覆盖的置信区间
summary_zh.validation: 理论证明和模拟验证

summary_en.motivation: Uncertainty quantification in deep networks is hindered by training noise and high computational cost of retraining.
summary_en.method: A procedural-noise-correcting predictor based on neural tangent kernel theory removes uncertainty using only one auxiliary network.
summary_en.result: Asymptotically exact coverage confidence intervals with as few as four trained networks.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical proofs and simulated experiments.

title: Deformable titanium for acetabular revision surgery: a proof of concept.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Orthopedics, University Medical Center Utrecht, Heidelberglaan 100, 3584 CX, Utrecht, The Netherlands. j.magre-2@umcutrecht.nl.; 3D Lab, Division of Surgical Specialties, University Medical Center Utrecht, 3584 CX, Utrecht, The Netherlands. j.magre-2@umcutrecht.nl.

corresponding_authors.name: J Magré
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Orthopedics, University Medical Center Utrecht, Heidelberglaan 100, 3584 CX, Utrecht, The Netherlands. j.magre-2@umcutrecht.nl.; 3D Lab, Division of Surgical Specialties, University Medical Center Utrecht, 3584 CX, Utrecht, The Netherlands. j.magre-2@umcutrecht.nl.

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出可变形多孔钛用于髋臼翻修，涉及应力屏蔽和机械测试，但未涉及LPBF制造与疲劳详细分析。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication details, no fatigue analysis beyond 1000 cycles, no surface roughness or osseointegration reported.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少髋臼翻修植入物的应力屏蔽。
summary_zh.method: 设计可变形多孔钛层植入物，压缩测试选出最佳结构。
summary_zh.result: 可变形钛层实现初步固定，1000次循环后下沉仅0.25mm。
summary_zh.validation: 锯骨模型循环压缩测试。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce stress shielding in acetabular revision implants by introducing a deformable porous titanium layer.
summary_en.method: Three porous titanium cylinder designs were compression-tested, and the best was used to fabricate acetabular implants with an integrated or separate deformable layer.
summary_en.result: Implants with an integrated deformable layer achieved immediate primary fixation with only 0.25 mm subsidence after 1000 cycles.
summary_en.validation: Cyclic compression testing in sawbone acetabular defect models.

title: A Bayesian Approach to Modeling Finite Element Discretization Error
relevance_to_user: 该论文关注有限元离散误差的贝叶斯建模，虽涉及不确定性量化，但未解决代理模型采样效率或优化约束问题，与用户研究方向间接相关。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on modeling finite element discretization error using Bayesian inference, but does not address surrogate modeling for expensive simulations, constraint handling, or transferability to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化有限元离散误差的不确定性以提高仿真可信度
summary_zh.method: 采用贝叶斯框架，通过粗离散化观测更新高斯过程先验来建模离散误差
summary_zh.result: 证明了基于格林函数协方差的先验可得到与离散误差相关的后验协方差，但需通过特征值缩放避免对右端项的依赖
summary_zh.validation: 理论推导与数值示例验证了协方差缩放方法的有效性

summary_en.motivation: To model the uncertainty caused by finite element discretization error within a Bayesian framework, improving the reliability of simulation predictions.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process prior is assumed over the solution space and updated using observations from a coarse finite element discretization, with a fine discretization representing the true field; two specific priors (white noise and Green's function-based) are investigated.
summary_en.result: The Green's function-based prior yields a posterior mean equal to the coarse solution and a covariance related to discretization error, but independence from the right-hand side term is overcome by eigenvalue rescaling.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated theoretically and through numerical examples demonstrating the effectiveness of the eigenvalue rescaling.

title: Real-time whole-heart electromechanical simulations using Latent Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用潜神经ODE对心脏电机械模拟进行加速和不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物生物力学代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on cardiac electromechanics, not implant biomechanics or stress shielding. No connection to implant design or bone-implant interface.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低心脏数字孪生的计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 用潜神经ODE从400次模拟中学习压力-体积动力学。
summary_zh.result: 实现300倍实时加速，支持敏感度分析与不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值模拟数据上验证，匹配未见压力-体积曲线。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the high computational cost of high-fidelity cardiac electromechanical simulations for digital twins.
summary_en.method: A Latent Neural Ordinary Differential Equation (LNODE) surrogate is trained on 400 3D-0D whole-heart closed-loop electromechanical simulations with 43 model parameters.
summary_en.result: The LNODE achieves 300x real-time speedup on a single laptop processor and enables global sensitivity analysis and robust parameter estimation with uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: The surrogate matches pressure and volume traces unseen during training and calibrates 4 to 11 model parameters with posterior distributions.

title: Bayesian Optimization of Expensive Nested Grey-Box Functions
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵嵌套目标优化，但未涉及植入物或有限元代理建模的具体问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modelling, implant mechanics, or biomedical constraints; it only validates on synthetic numerical benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 优化含有部分已知结构的昂贵嵌套函数
summary_zh.method: 提出基于乐观主义的贝叶斯优化算法
summary_zh.result: 相比黑盒方法显著提升全局最优解搜索速度
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize expensive nested functions where some components are known (white-box) and others unknown (black-box).
summary_en.method: An optimism-driven Bayesian optimization algorithm is designed for a general grey-box formulation, with regret analysis under Lipschitz assumptions.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves similar regret bounds as standard black-box Bayesian optimization up to a constant and empirically converges faster to the global optimum.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic test functions demonstrate improved optimization speed compared to black-box Bayesian optimization.

title: Self-Adjusting Weighted Expected Improvement for Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至生物力学设计中代理辅助的昂贵优化问题，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No explicit constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification beyond standard GP, and no application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高贝叶斯优化中采集函数的鲁棒性和自适应性
summary_zh.method: 提出自调整加权期望改进(SAWEI)方法，基于收敛准则动态平衡探索-利用
summary_zh.result: 在BBOB和HPOBench上优于手工设计的基线方法
summary_zh.validation: 在标准黑盒优化基准函数上进行数值测试

summary_en.motivation: To improve the robustness and adaptability of acquisition functions in Bayesian optimization by automating the exploration-exploitation trade-off.
summary_en.method: Proposes Self-Adjusting Weighted Expected Improvement (SAWEI), which adjusts the exploration-exploitation balance in a data-driven manner using a convergence criterion.
summary_en.result: SAWEI demonstrates favorable anytime performance compared to handcrafted baselines on noise-free BBOB functions and transfers well to HPOBench.
summary_en.validation: Empirically validated on standard black-box optimization benchmarks (BBOB and HPOBench) without physical or biomedical applications.

title: Material properties of selective laser melting additive-manufactured Ti6Al4V alloys with different porosities
first_author_affiliation: Graduate School of Engineering, Tohoku University, Japan

corresponding_authors.name: Masayoshi Mizutani
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Graduate School of Engineering, Tohoku University, Japan

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了不同孔隙率SLM Ti6Al4V合金的力学性能，与用户关注的生物医学植入物多孔结构力学匹配直接相关。
why_not_core: Does not include fatigue testing or surface characterization for osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究SLM Ti6Al4V合金孔隙率对力学性能的影响
summary_zh.method: 制备不同孔隙率SLM Ti6Al4V样品并进行力学测试
summary_zh.result: 孔隙率显著影响弹性模量和强度，可调节以匹配骨组织
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学实验验证不同孔隙率下的材料性能

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of porosity on the mechanical properties of SLM Ti6Al4V alloys for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Samples with different porosities were fabricated via selective laser melting and subjected to mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Porosity significantly influences elastic modulus and strength, allowing stiffness matching with bone.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical experiments validated the material properties across varying porosity levels.

title: Improving Hyperparameter Learning under Approximate Inference in Gaussian Process Models
relevance_to_user: 论文改进了高斯过程模型的超参数学习方法，可迁移至代理模型，但未涉及有限元或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply GP surrogates to finite element analysis or implant design; it addresses only abstract approximate inference in GP models.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决非共轭似然高斯过程模型中超参数学习与近似推理的耦合问题。
summary_zh.method: 设计混合训练程序，结合变分推理和期望传播优化超参数。
summary_zh.result: 在多个数据集上验证了混合方法优于标准方法。
summary_zh.validation: 基于标准数据集的数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To improve hyperparameter learning in Gaussian process models when approximate inference is required due to non-conjugate likelihoods.
summary_en.method: Proposes a hybrid training procedure combining variational inference for posterior approximation and an EP-like marginal likelihood for hyperparameter optimization.
summary_en.result: Empirical results show the hybrid approach outperforms standard VI, EP, and Laplace approximation across various datasets.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard datasets.

title: Data Mining for Faster, Interpretable Solutions to Inverse Problems: A Case Study Using Additive Manufacturing
relevance_to_user: 该论文采用高斯过程代理模型解决逆向问题，其加速和可解释性方法可迁移到生物力学植入物设计的代理建模中。
why_not_core: It does not address constraints, uncertainty quantification is not emphasized, and the application is additive manufacturing process parameters rather than implant biomechanics or finite element analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速逆向问题求解并提高高维空间的可解释性
summary_zh.method: 采用协方差锥化加速高斯过程代理，结合加权自组织映射可视化
summary_zh.result: 锥化方法在保持精度下显著加速，加权映射揭示输入关系
summary_zh.validation: 以增材制造数据集为例验证方法有效性

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate surrogate-based inverse problem solving and improve interpretability in high-dimensional input spaces.
summary_en.method: A tapered Gaussian process surrogate with modified covariance tapering is used to speed up computation, and Kohonen self-organizing maps with weighted distances visualize the inverse solution.
summary_en.result: The tapering method significantly reduces computation time without accuracy loss, and weighted SOMs reveal input relationships clearly.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated on an additive manufacturing dataset.

title: Vehicle Dynamics Modeling for Autonomous Racing Using Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 论文使用高斯过程构建车辆动力学代理模型，可迁移到生物力学FEA代理建模中，但缺乏生物医学验证和约束优化。
why_not_core: No FEA or implant biomechanics application; no constraint handling or optimization; uses only simulation data without experimental validation in biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 自动驾驶赛车中需高效建模车辆动力学，平衡计算成本与精度。
summary_zh.method: 构建高斯过程动力学与扩展运动学模型，研究核函数、样本量等影响。
summary_zh.result: 提出训练准确GP回归的建议，并通过400+仿真验证。
summary_zh.validation: 基于真实F1赛道布局的仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: Accurate vehicle dynamics modeling is critical for autonomous racing, requiring a trade-off between computational cost and model fidelity.
summary_en.method: Gaussian process regression is applied to construct dynamic and extended kinematic models for the F1TENTH platform, exploring the effects of kernel choice, sample size, and track layout.
summary_en.result: Comprehensive recommendations for training accurate single-track vehicle dynamics GP models are provided, validated through over 400 simulations on real F1 circuits.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated via extensive simulation on multiple real-world racetrack layouts.

title: Novel DeepONet architecture to predict stresses in elastoplastic structures with variable complex geometries and loads
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至生物力学中的应力预测代理模型，但尚未在植入物或生物医学场景中验证。
why_not_core: This work does not include biomedical context, implant-specific geometries, or uncertainty quantification, and lacks experimental validation on biomechanical problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速复杂几何与载荷下弹塑性应力场的预测
summary_zh.method: 提出以ResUNet为干网络的DeepONet架构，编码几何与载荷信息
summary_zh.result: 新架构与纯ResUNet精度相当，但内存效率更高且灵活性强
summary_zh.validation: 与有限元模拟及两种基线模型对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the prediction of full-field elastoplastic stress responses for complex geometries under variable loads, bypassing expensive finite element simulations.
summary_en.method: A novel DeepONet architecture is proposed, employing a ResUNet as the trunk network to encode complex input geometries and a fully-connected branch network for parametric loads, with element-wise fusion of latent representations.
summary_en.result: The proposed DeepONet achieves comparable accuracy to a standalone ResUNet while being more memory-efficient and flexible; both networks predict stress fields orders of magnitude faster than FEM and accurately identify stress concentration points.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing against finite element simulations and two baseline models (standalone ResUNet and vanilla DeepONet) on topology-optimized geometries.

title: Memory-Based Dual Gaussian Processes for Sequential Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的记忆双高斯过程方法可提升序贯学习效率，对代理模型构建和贝叶斯优化有参考价值，但未涉及FEA或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, no explicit constraint handling, and no biomechanics or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 序贯学习中历史数据受限时高斯过程易积累误差，需准确推断方法。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于记忆的双稀疏变分高斯过程，动态构建并更新历史数据。
summary_zh.result: 在贝叶斯优化、主动学习和持续学习中均实现了高效准确的学习。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准基准问题上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Sequential learning with Gaussian processes suffers from error accumulation when past data is limited, necessitating accurate inference methods.
summary_en.method: A memory-based dual sparse variational Gaussian process is proposed, which actively builds and updates a memory of past data.
summary_en.result: The method achieves efficient and accurate learning in Bayesian optimization, active learning, and continual learning benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard numerical benchmarks for sequential learning tasks.

title: Reliable Methods for Classification, Characterization, and Design of Cellular Structures for Patient-Specific Implants.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Polymer Engineering, Faculty of Mechanical Engineering, Budapest University of Technology and Economics, Műegyetem rkp. 3, H-1111 Budapest, Hungary.

relevance_to_user: 该论文直接关注植入物多孔结构的刚度匹配与应力遮蔽降低，与用户研究方向高度相关，但缺乏增材制造工艺与疲劳性能的具体验证。
why_not_core: Does not include LPBF fabrication process, fatigue testing, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发可普遍应用的周期性细胞结构表征方法，准确调谐刚度以减少翻修手术。

summary_en.result: The proposed DeepONet takes continuous rib geometry as input and outputs detailed pressure and heat transfer distributions, achieving accurate predictions with relatively small training datasets.
summary_en.validation: The surrogate model is validated against numerical simulations of a 2D rib-roughened internal cooling channel with varying rib profiles under geometric constraints.

summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To balance computational efficiency and numerical accuracy in uncertainty quantification of physical systems.
summary_en.method: Proposes a bi-fidelity variational auto-encoder with an autoregressive model in latent space that leverages low-fidelity data to enhance high-fidelity inference.
summary_en.result: The BF-VAE achieves significantly improved accuracy compared to using only high-fidelity data when high-fidelity samples are scarce.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated through numerical benchmark problems.

title: Advances in Computational Techniques for Bio-Inspired Cellular Materials in the Field of Biomechanics: Current Trends and Prospects.

why_not_core: This review provides no LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (fatigue or compression), no surface roughness or osseointegration data, and is a literature review, not original research.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述计算技术在设计生物启发多孔材料以避免应力遮挡中的应用趋势
summary_zh.method: 系统回顾了拓扑优化、机器学习及多尺度方法在多孔支架设计中的进展
summary_zh.result: 指出了当前趋势和未来方向，强调功能梯度与人工智能的潜力
summary_zh.validation: 属于综述性质，未涉及具体实验验证

summary_en.motivation: This review synthesizes computational techniques for designing bio-inspired cellular materials to mitigate stress shielding in orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: The article surveys state-of-the-art including topology optimization, modified algorithms, bio-inspired design, and machine learning for porous scaffold design.
summary_en.result: Current and future trends in orthopedic biomechanics, particularly implant and scaffold design, are identified, highlighting the role of functional gradients and AI.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation is provided as this is a literature review.

title: Accelerated solutions of convection-dominated partial differential equations using implicit feature tracking and empirical quadrature
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于经验求积的超简化方法用于对流主导问题，可转移到植入物生物力学代理模型，但未涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no constraint handling, no UQ, and validation is on CFD not biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 加速对流主导偏微分方程的求解
summary_zh.method: 基于经验求积和非线性流形的超简化模型
summary_zh.result: 在激波主导CFD基准上有效降低计算成本
summary_zh.validation: 数值模拟对比

summary_en.motivation: Accelerate solutions of convection-dominated PDEs with limited training data.
summary_en.method: Empirical quadrature-based hyperreduction with a nonlinear approximation manifold defined by composing affine spaces and domain bijections.
summary_en.result: Reduced computational cost while maintaining accuracy on two shock-dominated CFD benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulation cases compared to full-order model.

title: Probabilistic Exponential Integrators
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种针对刚性系统的概率指数积分器，其不确定性量化方法可迁移至有限元代理模型中的数值误差评估。
why_not_core: Does not address surrogate modelling for FEA, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升概率求解器对刚性系统的稳定性和计算效率。
summary_zh.method: 将快变线性动力学融入先验，并推广至任意非线性系统。
summary_zh.result: 在多个刚性微分方程上验证了改进的稳定性和效率。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证稳定性与效率。

summary_en.motivation: To improve the stability and computational efficiency of probabilistic solvers for stiff dynamical systems.
summary_en.method: Incorporates fast linear dynamics into the prior and generalizes to nonlinear systems via piecewise semi-linearity.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates improved stability and efficiency over existing probabilistic solvers on multiple stiff ODE benchmarks.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard stiff ODE problems.

title: Stochastic PDE representation of random fields for large-scale Gaussian process regression and statistical finite element analysis
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过SPDE表示随机场，实现大规模高斯过程回归和统计有限元分析，可转移至植入物生物力学代理模型与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: Paper does not handle constraints (e.g., multi-objective optimization) and lacks implant-specific validation or biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效表示复杂几何上的随机场，用于大规模贝叶斯建模
summary_zh.method: 利用随机偏微分方程(SPDE)表示随机场，得到稀疏精度矩阵，实现可扩展的统计有限元分析和GP回归
summary_zh.result: 在泊松和薄壳问题上验证了框架的通用性和收敛性
summary_zh.validation: 通过泊松方程和薄壳算例验证数值收敛性

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently represent random fields on complex geometries for scalable Bayesian modeling in engineering and machine learning.
summary_en.method: Leveraging the stochastic PDE (SPDE) representation to obtain sparse precision matrices, enabling large-scale statistical finite element analysis (statFEM) and Gaussian process regression.
summary_en.result: The framework demonstrates versatility and convergence properties on Poisson and thin-shell examples.
summary_en.validation: Numerical convergence studies on Poisson and thin-shell finite element problems.

title: Learning Relevant Contextual Variables Within Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至植入体设计中的昂贵仿真优化问题，但未直接验证于生物力学场景。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constrained optimization or apply to FEA/implant design problems, and lacks biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效优化具有未知相关性和成本的上下文变量的黑箱函数。
summary_zh.method: 提出SADCBO方法，通过敏感性分析选择相关上下文变量，并结合早停策略降低优化成本。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和真实实验中一致优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成函数和机器人实验中验证。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently optimize expensive black-box functions with contextual variables whose relevance and optimization cost are unknown.
summary_en.method: A sensitivity-analysis-driven contextual Bayesian optimization (SADCBO) method selects relevant contextual variables and uses early stopping to reduce cost.
summary_en.result: SADCBO consistently outperforms alternatives on both synthetic and real-world experiments.
summary_en.validation: Empirically validated on synthetic benchmarks and real robotic experiments.

title: Kernel Interpolation with Sparse Grids
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移至生物力学代理模型的构建，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化，且缺乏工程验证。
why_not_core: No FEA application, no constraint handling, no engineering or biomedical validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提升高斯过程在高维输入下的扩展性。
summary_zh.method: 采用稀疏网格插值核协方差矩阵并设计快速矩阵乘法。
summary_zh.result: 在更高维度上保持精度且计算近线性时间。
summary_zh.validation: 合成函数数值实验验证准确性。

summary_en.motivation: To scale Gaussian process inference to high-dimensional inputs via efficient kernel interpolation.
summary_en.method: Integrate sparse grids with structured kernel interpolation, using simplex-based interpolation and nearly linear matrix-vector multiplication.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates maintained accuracy in higher dimensions with near-linear computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation on synthetic benchmark functions.

title: Fourier Neural Operators for Arbitrary Resolution Climate Data Downscaling
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出的傅里叶神经算子可用于代理建模，但应用领域为气候降尺度，而非生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: Does not address constrained optimization, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高分辨率气候模拟计算成本高，降尺度方法受限于训练数据稀缺。
summary_zh.method: 使用傅里叶神经算子，从小上采样因子数据训练，实现任意分辨率零样本降尺度。
summary_zh.result: 在ERA5和Navier-Stokes数据上均优于卷积和生成对抗网络降尺度模型。
summary_zh.validation: 在ERA5气候数据和Navier-Stokes方程解上验证。

summary_en.motivation: High-resolution climate simulation is computationally expensive, and downscaling methods are limited by scarce high-resolution training data.
summary_en.method: A Fourier Neural Operator is trained with data of a small upsampling factor to perform zero-shot downscaling to arbitrary unseen high resolution.
summary_en.result: The proposed model outperforms state-of-the-art convolutional and generative adversarial downscaling models on ERA5 climate data and Navier-Stokes solutions.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on ERA5 reanalysis data and numerical solutions of the Navier-Stokes equations.

title: Equivariant Neural Simulators for Stochastic Spatiotemporal Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过等变概率神经模拟提高了随机动力学的仿真质量和不确定性量化，可迁移到植入物设计中的代理建模。
why_not_core: Does not address constrained optimization, implant-specific geometry, or boundary conditions in biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用对称性提升随机动力系统神经模拟器的精度与数据效率。
summary_zh.method: 提出等变概率神经模拟框架，对系统演化的等变分布进行自回归概率建模。
summary_zh.result: 在随机n体系统和细胞动力学上显著优于现有方法，提高了仿真质量与不确定性量化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过随机n体系统和细胞动力学两个数值案例进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Incorporate domain symmetries into probabilistic neural simulators to improve accuracy, sample efficiency, and uncertainty quantification for stochastic dynamical systems.
summary_en.method: Propose the Equivariant Probabilistic Neural Simulation (EPNS) framework, which autoregressively models equivariant distributions over system trajectories.
summary_en.result: EPNS outperforms existing probabilistic simulation methods on stochastic n-body and cellular dynamics, demonstrating better rollout stability, data efficiency, and calibrated uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of a stochastic n-body system and stochastic cellular dynamics, comparing against baseline neural network-based probabilistic simulators.

title: A reduced-order model for segregated fluid-structure interaction solvers based on an ALE approach
relevance_to_user: 该方法作为降阶建模技术可迁移至植入物力学仿真，但缺乏不确定性量化和对约束的处理。
why_not_core: No UQ, no explicit constraint handling, and applied to fluid-structure interaction rather than solid mechanics FEA for implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低流固耦合模拟的高计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 基于POD和径向基函数网络的混合投影降阶方法。
summary_zh.result: 降阶模型准确捕捉瞬态流场和结构受力，数值稳定。
summary_zh.validation: 通过圆柱涡激振动基准算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the high computational cost of fluid-structure interaction simulations, a reduced-order model is developed.
summary_en.method: A hybrid reduced-order model combining POD-Galerkin projection with radial basis function networks is proposed for segregated FSI solvers.
summary_en.result: The ROM accurately captures transient flow fields and forces on the moving structure without instability or divergence.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on a vortex-induced vibration benchmark (circular cylinder, Re=200).

title: Uncertainty and Structure in Neural Ordinary Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 本文提出神经ODE的不确定性量化与机械知识融合方法，可迁移至代理模型构建，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计的具体应用。
why_not_core: The paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling in design optimization, or implant/biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对科学工程中神经ODE缺乏结构化不确定性及机械知识融合问题
summary_zh.method: 采用拉普拉斯近似进行贝叶斯推断，并整合守恒定律等机械知识
summary_zh.result: 不确定性反映了机械知识的影响，结构提升了外推能力
summary_zh.validation: 低维ODE和高维PDE基准实验

summary_en.motivation: To address the lack of structured uncertainty estimates and integration of mechanistic knowledge in neural ODEs for scientific applications.
summary_en.method: Applied Laplace approximation for Bayesian inference and incorporated mechanistic knowledge such as conservation laws into neural ODE frameworks.
summary_en.result: Uncertainty quantification reflected the effect of mechanistic information, and structure improved extrapolation capabilities.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on low-dimensional ODE problems and a high-dimensional partial differential equation.

title: Triply Periodic Minimal Surface-Based Scaffolds for Bone Tissue Engineering: A Mechanical, In Vitro and In Vivo Study
first_author_affiliation: Center of Dental Medicine, Institute of Oral Biotechnology & Bioengineering, University of Zurich, Zurich, Switzerland

corresponding_authors.name: Franz E. Weber
corresponding_authors.affiliation: CABMM, Center for Applied Biotechnology and Molecular Medicine, University of Zurich, Zurich, Switzerland

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了TPMS支架的力学性能与体内骨整合能力，对骨组织工程中的多孔结构设计有直接参考价值。
why_not_core: The paper does not cover LPBF fabrication of metallic implants, fatigue testing, or stress shielding quantification for hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有TPMS支架研究缺乏体内比较，需要确定最佳微结构用于骨替代。
summary_zh.method: 制备四种TPMS微结构支架，进行力学测试、3D细胞培养和体内植入。
summary_zh.result: Diamond和Gyroid结构力学最强，体内骨长入和骨接触最高。
summary_zh.validation: 通过μCT、力学测试、体外细胞培养和体内大鼠模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing studies on TPMS scaffolds lack in vivo comparisons, motivating the need to identify the optimal microarchitecture for bone substitutes.
summary_en.method: Hydroxyapatite-based scaffolds with Diamond, Gyroid, Primitive, and Lattice microarchitectures were fabricated and evaluated via mechanical testing, 3D cell culture, and in vivo implantation.
summary_en.result: Diamond and Gyroid scaffolds exhibited higher compressive strength and superior in vivo bone ingrowth and bone-to-implant contact compared to Primitive and Lattice designs.
summary_en.validation: Validation included μCT for print precision, compression testing, in vitro cell culture with human bone marrow stromal cells, and in vivo implantation in a rat model.

title: MMGP: a Mesh Morphing Gaussian Process-based machine learning method for regression of physical problems under non-parameterized geometrical variability
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过网格变形与高斯过程回归，能够处理无参数化的几何变化，并提供了不确定性量化，可迁移至植入物设计的代理建模中。
why_not_core: This paper does not validate on biomedical implant geometries, does not handle multi-objective constraints, and only tests on generic numerical benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 工业设计中几何变化显著，但传统方法依赖参数化形状。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于网格变形和高斯过程的MMGP方法，无需形状参数化。
summary_zh.result: 在数值实验中，MMGP在训练效率和精度上与图神经网络相当。
summary_zh.validation: 通过平面应变问题、三维叶片等数值案例验证。

summary_en.motivation: In industrial design, geometric variabilities are common but traditional regression requires explicit shape parameterization, which is often unavailable.
summary_en.method: This paper proposes MMGP, combining mesh morphing onto a common support with Principal Component Analysis and Gaussian processes, avoiding the need for parameterization.
summary_en.result: MMGP achieves competitive accuracy and training efficiency compared to graph neural networks on several numerical experiments.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmarks including a plane strain problem (linear elasticity) and a 3D blade surface problem.

title: Cycle Consistency-based Uncertainty Quantification of Neural Networks in Inverse Imaging Problems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于循环一致性的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至代理模型的UQ，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, does not handle constraints, and is not validated on FEA or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 为逆问题神经网络提供一种简单快速的不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 利用前向-后向循环一致性并通过回归分析推导不确定性估计。
summary_zh.result: 在图像去模糊和超分辨率任务中，该方法在识别输入数据损坏和分布偏移方面优于其他模型。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准图像数据集上使用去模糊和超分辨率网络进行数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To provide a simple and rapid uncertainty quantification method for neural networks solving inverse problems.
summary_en.method: Build forward-backward cycles using the physical forward model and a trained inverse network, then derive uncertainty estimators via regression analysis on cycle consistency.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperformed other models in detecting input corruption and distribution shifts on image deblurring and super-resolution tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard image datasets using widely used deblurring and super-resolution neural networks as testbeds.

title: PDE-constrained Gaussian process surrogate modeling with uncertain data locations
relevance_to_user: 该方法处理输入位置不确定性的高斯过程代理建模，可迁移到生物力学设计中的替代建模，但未直接涉及约束或植入物设计。
why_not_core: Does not handle constraints, multi-objective optimization, or provide experimental validation; no direct application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 高斯过程代理模型常忽略输入位置的不确定性
summary_zh.method: 贝叶斯推断估计不确定输入的后验分布，并通过边缘化将其纳入预测
summary_zh.result: 在一维函数和PDE上验证，泛化性能好且预测不确定性降低
summary_zh.validation: 数值算例：一维函数、热方程和Allen-Cahn方程

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian process surrogate models often ignore uncertainty in input locations; this work proposes a Bayesian approach to incorporate such variability.
summary_en.method: A posterior distribution of uncertain inputs is estimated via Bayesian inference, then marginalized over in Gaussian process predictions.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated on multiple 1D functions, the heat equation, and the Allen-Cahn equation, showing improved generalization and reduced predictive uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks with analytical solutions and PDE simulations.

title: Adaptive choice of near-optimal expansion points for interpolation-based structure-preserving model reduction
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的结构保持降阶建模方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or implant/biomechanics applications, and validation is limited to numerical benchmarks without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 实现结构保持降阶模型的最优插值点自动选择
summary_zh.method: 基于IRKA的投影迭代插值方法，自适应选择近优插值点
summary_zh.result: 在不同频段上优于传统方法，精度和计算效率更高
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To automatically select near-optimal interpolation points and appropriate reduced-order model size for structure-preserving model reduction.
summary_en.method: A projection-based iterative interpolation method inspired by IRKA, adaptively computing interpolation points and model size.
summary_en.result: The proposed method outperforms established approaches in accuracy and computational cost, especially for specified frequency ranges.
summary_en.validation: Numerical examples with different system structures demonstrate the method's effectiveness.

title: A defect detection framework using three-dimensional convolutional neural network (3D-CNN) with in-situ monitoring data in laser powder bed fusion process
first_author_affiliation: Department of Aerospace Engineering, Seoul National University, Gwanak-gu Gwanak-ro 1, Seoul 08826, South Korea

corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Aerospace Engineering, Seoul National University, Gwanak-gu Gwanak-ro 1, Seoul 08826, South Korea

why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant applications, does not involve mechanical testing, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration, and does not link porous structures to stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 基于3D-CNN和原位监测数据检测激光粉末床熔融过程中的缺陷

summary_en.motivation: To detect defects in laser powder bed fusion process using 3D-CNN with in-situ monitoring data for improved quality control.
summary_en.method: Developed a 3D convolutional neural network that processes in-situ monitoring data to classify defect types.
summary_en.result: The model achieved high accuracy in defect detection, demonstrating effectiveness for LPBF process monitoring.
summary_en.validation: Validated on experimental in-situ monitoring data with ground truth defect labels.

title: Efficient Error Certification for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出对PINN残差误差进行保证的方法，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及植入物设计或约束优化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraints, multi-objective optimization, or transferability to implant/biomechanics design; it focuses solely on error certification for general PDEs.

summary_zh.motivation: 缺乏对PINN残差误差在连续域上的保证
summary_zh.method: 提出∂-CROWN框架进行后训练误差界限计算
summary_zh.result: 在Burgers、Schrödinger等方程上获得紧致误差证书
summary_zh.validation: 在经典及实际PDE数值基准上验证

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINN studies lack guarantees on worst-case residual error across the spatio-temporal domain, limiting deployment in critical applications.
summary_en.method: This paper introduces ∂-CROWN, a post-training framework that efficiently computes tight bounds on PINN residual errors.
summary_en.result: The framework demonstrates tight error certificates on Burgers', Schrödinger's, Allen-Cahn, and Diffusion-Sorption equations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks of classical and real-world PDEs.

title: Active Learning in Symbolic Regression with Physical Constraints
relevance_to_user: 该论文将主动学习与带物理约束的符号回归结合，提高了数据采样效率，可迁移至代理模型构建中减少昂贵仿真采样。
why_not_core: The paper does not address finite element surrogate modeling, uncertainty quantification beyond committee variance, or biomechanical/ implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少符号回归所需数据量，融入物理约束提升低数据下模型准确性。
summary_zh.method: 采用委员会查询的主动学习策略，以Pareto前沿方程作为委员会。
summary_zh.result: 在已知方程重发现任务中达到最先进的数据效率。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上测试方程重发现性能。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the amount of data required for symbolic regression by integrating physical constraints into an active learning framework.
summary_en.method: Active learning via query by committee, where the committee consists of equations on the Pareto frontier, combined with physical constraints.
summary_en.result: The approach achieves state-of-the-art data efficiency in rediscovering known symbolic equations.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks for equation rediscovery tasks.

title: A Global-Local Approximation Framework for Large-Scale Gaussian Process Modeling
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种大规模高斯过程建模的全局-局部近似方法，可迁移至FEA代理模型领域，但未直接应用于植入物或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on a general Gaussian process approximation technique without application to FEA surrogate modeling, biomechanics, or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决精确高斯过程建模在大规模数据上的计算瓶颈。
summary_zh.method: 结合全局和局部点的子集数据方法，并融合全局与局部核函数。
summary_zh.result: 方法在计算成本远低于现有方法的同时，性能相当或更优。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准基准数据集上比较性能。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational bottleneck of exact Gaussian process modeling for large-scale datasets.
summary_en.method: A combined global-local subset approach that selects both global points for capturing trend and local points for each testing location, with a mixed global-local kernel.
summary_en.result: The proposed TwinGP framework achieves comparable or better predictive performance than state-of-the-art methods at a fraction of the computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard benchmark datasets against existing GP approximations.

title: Conditional variational autoencoder with Gaussian process regression recognition for parametric models
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移用于植入物/生物力学的代理建模，但未直接应用于该领域。
why_not_core: No implant mechanics, no FEA validation on biomedical cases, and no constraint handling or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决GPR降阶模型线性局限和CVAE过拟合问题
summary_zh.method: 结合POD降维与CVAE-GPR识别模型进行参数化建模
summary_zh.result: 达到CVAE精度但参数更少，缓解过拟合
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the linear limitations of POD-based GPR reduced order models and the overfitting issues of CVAE for parametric systems.
summary_en.method: Proposes a CVAE with Gaussian process regression recognition (CVAE-GPRR) that uses POD to extract low-dimensional latent variables and GPR to learn the parameter-to-latent mapping, while neural networks reconstruct the full field.
summary_en.result: CVAE-GPRR achieves comparable accuracy to CVAE with fewer trainable parameters and effectively mitigates overfitting.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark examples demonstrate the method's accuracy and reduced overfitting compared to standard CVAE.

title: A deep learning method for multi-material diffusion problems based on physics-informed neural networks
relevance_to_user: 本文提出了一种基于PINN的多材料扩散问题求解方法，可迁移至生物力学中的代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not address surrogate modelling for structural mechanics or implant design; it focuses on diffusion problems without uncertainty quantification or constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准PINN无法处理多材料扩散问题中的界面不光滑性。
summary_zh.method: 引入连续性条件、空间分离和损失归一化策略改进PINN。
summary_zh.result: 新方法能准确求解多材料扩散方程，数值实验验证了鲁棒性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值算例验证方法的有效性和准确性。

summary_en.motivation: Standard PINN fails to accurately solve multi-material diffusion problems due to non-smooth solutions at interfaces.
summary_en.method: The proposed method integrates interface continuity conditions, a spatial separation strategy, and loss term normalization to enable single-network representation of discontinuous functions.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate that the method robustly and accurately predicts solutions for a class of multi-material diffusion problems.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated against analytical solutions and numerical benchmarks for various multi-material diffusion configurations.

title: Physics Informed Token Transformer for Solving Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文方法可用于生物力学中的代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No validation on biomechanics or implant design problems; no uncertainty quantification; no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解偏微分方程
summary_zh.method: 将PDE方程和导数标记化并嵌入Transformer
summary_zh.result: 在1D/2D任务上优于现有神经算子
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To solve partial differential equations more efficiently than classical numerical methods using machine learning.
summary_en.method: Tokenizes partial differential equations and their derivatives into a transformer architecture to learn a physically-informed neural operator.
summary_en.result: Outperforms popular neural operator models on challenging 1D and 2D PDE prediction tasks.
summary_en.validation: Tested on standard numerical benchmark problems for PDE operator learning.

title: Mastering the exploration-exploitation trade-off in Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽然未直接应用于生物力学，但所提出的自适应平衡探索与利用的采集函数可有效降低昂贵FEA仿真的采样成本，具有很高迁移潜力。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on a novel acquisition function for Bayesian optimization without addressing constraints handling, multi-objective optimization, or application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有采集函数难以自适应平衡探索与利用，导致优化效率不佳
summary_zh.method: 融合算法与人类搜索策略，提出一种自适应调节探索-利用平衡的新型采集函数
summary_zh.result: 在多个测试函数上Pareto分析表明，新采集函数几乎总是Pareto最优且平衡性最好
summary_zh.validation: 基于数学测试函数的数值基准验证

summary_en.motivation: Current acquisition functions fail to adaptively balance exploration and exploitation, hindering optimization efficiency.
summary_en.method: A novel acquisition function is proposed by integrating insights from algorithmic and human search strategies to dynamically adjust the exploration-exploitation trade-off.
summary_en.result: Pareto analysis on multiple test functions shows the proposed acquisition function is almost always Pareto optimal and provides the most balanced trade-off.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard test functions are used for validation.

title: Gradient-enhanced physics-informed neural networks based on transfer learning for inverse problems of the variable coefficient differential equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于迁移学习的梯度增强PINN可用于推断生物力学中的未知材料参数，为植入物设计中的逆问题提供可迁移方法。
why_not_core: No uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, no biomechanics or implant design context, only demonstrated on Schrödinger equation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高PINN对变系数偏微分方程逆问题的求解精度和效率。
summary_zh.method: 将梯度增强PINN与迁移学习结合，推断未知变系数。
summary_zh.result: TL-gPINN在精度和效率上均优于传统gPINN，且对噪声和超参数鲁棒。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多种函数形式的非线性薛定谔方程数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To improve accuracy and efficiency of physics-informed neural networks for inverse problems involving variable coefficient differential equations.
summary_en.method: Gradient-enhanced PINNs are combined with transfer learning to infer unknown variable coefficients of various forms.
summary_en.result: The proposed TL-gPINN method yields considerable accuracy improvement over PINN and gPINN, and outperforms gPINN in efficiency even with noisy data or varying hyperparameters.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on the variable coefficient nonlinear Schrödinger equation with polynomial, trigonometric, hyperbolic, and fractional polynomial coefficients demonstrate effectiveness.

title: Gaussian Process Port-Hamiltonian Systems: Bayesian Learning with Physics Prior
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供了带不确定性的物理学习框架，可迁移至植入物有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical or implant-specific context, no demonstration on contact mechanics or stress shielding.

summary_zh.motivation: 从数据中学习符合物理定律且带不确定性的动力学模型
summary_zh.method: 在端口-哈密顿系统中引入高斯过程先验，从数据推断哈密顿量
summary_zh.result: 生成具有物理一致性与不确定性量化的被动系统
summary_zh.validation: 在标准数值基准上验证物理一致性与预测性能

summary_en.motivation: To learn physically consistent dynamical models from data while providing uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process prior is imposed on the Hamiltonian within a port-Hamiltonian framework, enabling Bayesian inference of the system dynamics.
summary_en.result: The approach yields passive systems that preserve physical structure and provide uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on numerical benchmark problems demonstrating physical consistency and predictive performance.

title: Controlling Biofilm Transport with Porous Metamaterials Designed with Bayesian Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用贝叶斯优化结合高斯过程代理模型设计多孔材料，方法可迁移至种植体力学中的昂贵仿真优化，但领域不同。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA-based surrogate modeling for biomechanical implant design, does not handle multi-objective constraints or experimental validation, and focuses on biofilm transport rather than solid mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 结合贝叶斯优化与个体模型设计多孔材料以优化生物膜传输
summary_zh.method: 使用高斯过程回归作为代理模型，采用期望改进函数进行优化
summary_zh.result: 贝叶斯优化比网格搜索效率提升92-223%，优化结构显著增强生物膜生长
summary_zh.validation: 基于个体模型的仿真测试验证代理模型准确性

summary_en.motivation: To enable rapid design of porous metamaterials for enhanced biofilm transport by combining surrogate-based optimization with individual-based modeling.
summary_en.method: Bayesian optimization with Gaussian process regression as a surrogate model and expected improvement acquisition function is applied to design 2D/3D porous structures.
summary_en.result: Bayesian optimization outperforms uniform grid search by 92-223% in efficiency, and optimized structures increase bacterial cell counts by up to 128% compared to unconfined space.
summary_en.validation: Simulation tests on three structure types confirm that Gaussian process approximated design spaces closely match full individual-based model characterizations.

title: Neural operator for structural simulation and bridge health monitoring
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的神经算子方法可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模，但研究背景为桥梁结构而非植入物设计，缺少不确定性量化和多目标约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply to biomedical or implant design; lacks uncertainty quantification and multi-objective constrained optimization; validation is on bridge structures, not biomechanical FEA.

summary_zh.motivation: 提出神经算子作为桥梁结构数字孪生。
summary_zh.method: 基于傅里叶神经算子，训练正向和反向预测模型。
summary_zh.result: 正向预测响应优于有限元，反向能损伤定位定量。
summary_zh.validation: 有限元仿真数据集和桥梁实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a neural operator as a digital twin for bridge structures for both forward simulation and inverse damage identification.
summary_en.method: A Fourier Neural Operator (VINO) is trained on parametric FE simulations and fine-tuned with experimental data from a bridge.
summary_en.result: The forward model predicts structural responses more accurately than the FE model, and the inverse model successfully localizes and quantifies damage.
summary_en.validation: The model is validated using a dataset of parametric FE simulations and an experimental study on a bridge with four damage scenarios.

title: Online machine-learning forecast uncertainty estimation for sequential data assimilation
relevance_to_user: 该论文的UQ方法可迁移至代理模型不确定性量化，但缺少生物力学背景和约束处理。
why_not_core: Does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency or constraints for design optimization; applied to weather forecasting, not implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化数据同化中的预报不确定性需大量集成计算，效率低
summary_zh.method: 使用CNN估计预报误差协方差矩阵，结合混合数据同化方法
summary_zh.result: CNN能准确预测高维状态的协方差矩阵，混合方法性能接近EnKF
summary_zh.validation: 基于Lorenz'96模型的观测系统模拟实验

summary_en.motivation: Efficiently estimate state-dependent forecast uncertainty in data assimilation without multiple ensemble integrations.
summary_en.method: A convolutional neural network predicts the forecast error covariance matrix using a single deterministic forecast, trained with a heteroscedastic loss function.
summary_en.result: The CNN provides accurate covariance estimates in high-dimensional states, and the hybrid data assimilation method matches ensemble Kalman filter performance, outperforming it with small ensembles.
summary_en.validation: Observing system simulation experiments on the Lorenz'96 toy model.

title: A Shape Optimization Pipeline for Marine Propellers by means of Reduced Order Modeling Techniques
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用降阶模型和遗传算法进行形状优化，方法可迁移到植入物设计，但缺乏约束处理和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No biomedical application, no implant mechanics, no uncertainty quantification, and no explicit constraints handling in the optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高船用螺旋桨效率，降低全阶CFD仿真成本
summary_zh.method: 利用降阶模型替代全阶CFD，结合遗传算法进行形状优化
summary_zh.result: 优化后螺旋桨效率相比原始设计有所提升
summary_zh.validation: 通过OpenFOAM对变形螺旋桨进行全阶CFD仿真验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve marine propeller efficiency while reducing the computational cost of full-order CFD simulations.
summary_en.method: A non-intrusive reduced-order model is constructed from high-fidelity snapshots, then coupled with a genetic algorithm for shape optimization.
summary_en.result: The optimized propeller achieves higher efficiency compared to the baseline design.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed via full-order CFD simulations (OpenFOAM) of the deformed propeller blades.

title: NUBO: A Transparent Python Package for Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了贝叶斯优化的工具包，可用于替代昂贵的FEA仿真，但未直接针对生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No FEA simulation or implant biomechanics application; no uncertainty quantification beyond standard Gaussian process.

summary_zh.motivation: 为昂贵黑箱函数提供透明易用的贝叶斯优化工具。
summary_zh.method: 开发模块化Python包，支持约束、混合变量及并行优化。
summary_zh.result: 提供简洁代码与文档，适用于多学科优化。
summary_zh.validation: 仅包含经过验证的算法，未展示具体应用案例。

summary_en.motivation: To provide a transparent and user-friendly Bayesian optimization framework for optimizing expensive black-box functions.
summary_en.method: Develops a modular Python package with Gaussian process surrogate and acquisition functions supporting constraints and mixed input types.
summary_en.result: Enables efficient optimization with clean code and comprehensive documentation, suitable for diverse scientific fields.
summary_en.validation: Only algorithms validated in literature are included; no specific experimental or simulation case study is presented.

title: LatentPINNs: Generative physics-informed neural networks via a latent representation learning
relevance_to_user: 本文通过潜在表示学习加速PINN在不同参数下的求解，可迁移至植入物设计中的FEA代理建模。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification, no validation on biomechanical or implant problems, and no demonstration of transferability to structured field outputs like stress/strain.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决PINN对不同参数需重新训练的耗时问题
summary_zh.method: 学习PDE参数的潜在表示并作为PINN额外输入
summary_zh.result: 在新参数上无需额外训练即可求解，表现良好
summary_zh.validation: 在Eikonal方程三类速度模型上数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational cost of retraining PINNs for every new set of PDE parameters.
summary_en.method: LatentPINN learns latent representations of PDE parameters via diffusion models and uses them as additional inputs to the PINN.
summary_en.result: The model generalizes to unseen velocity models without retraining, maintaining accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on Eikonal equations with three velocity models.

title: Deep Finite Volume Method for Partial Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 提出一种基于有限体积的深度学习PDE求解方法，可替代PINN用于生物力学仿真，但未涉及植入物设计优化。
why_not_core: No biomechanics application, no implant design, no FEA surrogate for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有深度学习方法求解PDE计算成本高，对非光滑解精度差。
summary_zh.method: 基于有限体积法的弱形式损失函数，将高阶导数转化为一阶导数。
summary_zh.result: 在保持或提升精度的同时大幅降低计算成本，非光滑解误差降低两个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与PINN、DRM、WAN等方法对比。

summary_en.motivation: Existing deep learning PDE solvers suffer from high computational cost and poor accuracy for nonsmooth solutions.
summary_en.method: A deep learning framework using a finite volume-based loss function derived from local conservation laws, transforming high-order derivatives to first-order via automatic differentiation.
summary_en.result: Achieves equal or superior accuracy while drastically reducing computational cost, with relative errors up to two orders lower for nonsmooth solutions.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks compared against PINN, Deep Ritz Method, and Weak Adversarial Networks.

title: Physics-informed neural network for seismic wave inversion in layered semi-infinite domain
relevance_to_user: 该论文将物理信息神经网络用于地震波反演，方法可迁移到生物力学替代模型，但缺乏生物力学背景。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant mechanics, no structural FEA validation, no experimental data.

summary_zh.motivation: 用PINN解决地震波反演的高计算成本问题
summary_zh.method: 设计轻量网络学习材料分布，深度网络逼近解变量，吸收边界条件作为软约束
summary_zh.result: 方法在一维层状半无限域反演中有效
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验验证反演准确性

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of seismic wave inversion using a physics-informed neural network framework.
summary_en.method: A PINN with a lightweight network for unknown material distribution and a deep network for solution variables, incorporating absorbing boundary conditions as soft regularizers.
summary_en.result: The proposed method accurately recovers material parameters in 1D layered semi-infinite domains.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic data validate the inversion accuracy and robustness.

title: Uncertainty Quantification in Machine Learning for Engineering Design and Health Prognostics: A Tutorial
relevance_to_user: 该教程详细介绍了机器学习中的不确定性量化方法，可迁移到基于有限元的代理模型优化中，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This tutorial focuses on general UQ methods for engineering design and health prognostics, but does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 为机器学习模型提供不确定性量化教程，以提升高风险决策的安全性。
summary_zh.method: 综述了高斯过程回归、贝叶斯神经网络、集成学习和确定性UQ方法。
summary_zh.result: 通过电池寿命和涡扇发动机剩余寿命预测案例对比了各方法的性能。
summary_zh.validation: 使用玩具回归示例和两个公开案例进行定量评估。

summary_en.motivation: This tutorial provides a comprehensive overview of uncertainty quantification methods for machine learning to enable safer decision-making in high-stakes applications.
summary_en.method: It reviews Gaussian process regression, Bayesian neural networks, neural network ensembles, and deterministic UQ methods, with mathematical formulations and qualitative/quantitative comparisons.
summary_en.result: The methods are demonstrated and compared on lithium-ion battery early-life prediction and turbofan engine remaining useful life prediction.
summary_en.validation: Validation includes a toy regression example and two case studies with publicly available source codes.

key_terms.zh: 谱归一化神经高斯过程

title: Disentangled Multi-Fidelity Deep Bayesian Active Learning
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽然未直接应用于生物力学，但多保真深度贝叶斯主动学习可迁移至植入物FEA代理模型构建与数据采样优化。
why_not_core: Does not include biomechanical context, implant-specific constraints, or clinical/experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统多保真建模难以扩展至高维且易传播低保真误差
summary_zh.method: 提出解耦多保真深度贝叶斯主动学习方法，学习条件分布函数
summary_zh.result: 在PDE基准任务上优于现有方法，预测精度和采样效率显著提升
summary_zh.validation: 在热传导、泊松方程、流体模拟等数值基准上验证

summary_en.motivation: Existing multi-fidelity methods struggle with high-dimensionality and error propagation from low-fidelity representations.
summary_en.method: Proposes Disentangled Multi-Fidelity Deep Bayesian Active Learning, which learns surrogates conditioned on the distribution of functions across fidelities.
summary_en.result: Outperforms state-of-the-art in prediction accuracy and sample efficiency on PDE benchmarks including heat, Poisson, and fluid equations.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems of partial differential equations.

title: Mechanical and corrosion behavior of sheet-based 316L TPMS structures
first_author_affiliation: Mechanical Engineering, University of Texas at Dallas, Richardson, TX, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Golden Kumar
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Mechanical Engineering, University of Texas at Dallas, Richardson, TX, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了316L不锈钢TPMS结构的力学与腐蚀行为，可为生物医用多孔植入物的刚度匹配和耐腐蚀设计提供参考，但非直接应用于髋关节应力屏蔽。
why_not_core: This paper uses 316L instead of biomedical Ti alloys, does not explicitly link to stress shielding or hip implant context, and likely includes only static mechanical testing without fatigue or osseointegration assessment.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究片状316L不锈钢TPMS结构的力学与腐蚀性能，探索其在承重应用中的潜力。
summary_zh.method: 采用激光粉末床熔融制备片状TPMS结构，进行准静态压缩和电化学腐蚀测试。
summary_zh.result: TPMS结构的力学性能与相对密度相关，腐蚀行为受结构类型和制造缺陷影响。
summary_zh.validation: 通过实验测试验证了不同TPMS构型的力学和腐蚀性能。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to investigate the mechanical properties and corrosion behavior of sheet-based TPMS structures fabricated from 316L stainless steel for potential load-bearing applications.
summary_en.method: LPBF was used to fabricate sheet-based TPMS structures, which were then subjected to quasi-static compression tests and electrochemical corrosion measurements.
summary_en.result: The mechanical performance of TPMS structures correlates with relative density, while corrosion behavior is influenced by design type and manufacturing defects.
summary_en.validation: Experimental testing validated the mechanical and corrosion performance of various TPMS configurations.

title: No-Regret Constrained Bayesian Optimization of Noisy and Expensive Hybrid Models using Differentiable Quantile Function Approximations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种带约束的贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移到植入物设计中昂贵的仿真优化问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to FEA or implant/biomechanics design; it lacks biomedical context and experimental validation on mechanical systems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解含噪声观测的混合模型约束全局优化问题
summary_zh.method: 提出约束上分位数边界(CUQB)方法，利用复合结构并采用可微样本平均近似最大化采集函数
summary_zh.result: 在环境模型标定和反应器优化中显著优于传统贝叶斯优化
summary_zh.validation: 数值实验与理论收敛性证明

summary_en.motivation: Efficiently solving constrained global optimization of hybrid models with noisy black-box components, common in engineering.
summary_en.method: Proposes Constrained Upper Quantile Bound (CUQB), a deterministic acquisition function exploiting composite structure, optimized via differentiable sample average approximation.
summary_en.result: CUQB achieves substantially improved sampling efficiency over traditional Bayesian optimization on environmental calibration and reactor optimization problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on test problems with theoretical regret and constraint violation bounds.

title: Multilevel Monte Carlo estimators for derivative-free optimization under uncertainty
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多层级蒙特卡洛方法可降低优化中的不确定性量化成本，可用于生物力学仿真中的代理模型加速
why_not_core: Does not explicitly address FEA surrogate modelling, nor does it apply to implant or biomechanics design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低不确定性下优化的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 将多层蒙特卡洛与无导数优化集成到Dakota工具箱
summary_zh.result: 数值测试表明MLMC比标准MC节省计算成本
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准案例验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of optimization under uncertainty by leveraging multilevel Monte Carlo methods.
summary_en.method: Multilevel Monte Carlo estimators are integrated with derivative-free optimization in the Dakota toolkit to allocate resources across multiple fidelity models.
summary_en.result: Numerical test cases demonstrate that the proposed MLMC approach significantly reduces computational cost compared to standard Monte Carlo.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on several numerical benchmark problems.

title: Impact Study of Numerical Discretization Accuracy on Parameter Reconstructions and Model Parameter Distributions
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用高斯过程替代模型进行不确定性量化，方法可迁移至生物力学领域的有限元代理建模，但应用场景为光学纳米计量，非植入物设计。
why_not_core: Does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization, and is applied to optical metrology rather than biomechanics or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究数值离散化精度对参数重构和不确定性分布的影响。
summary_zh.method: 使用贝叶斯目标向量优化结合GP替代模型和MCMC采样。
summary_zh.result: 通过收敛性分析确定高效准确的数值参数。
summary_zh.validation: 基于光学纳米计量FEM模型进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate how numerical discretization accuracy affects parameter reconstructions and model parameter distributions in optical nano metrology.
summary_en.method: Bayesian target vector optimization with Gaussian process surrogates and Markov chain Monte Carlo sampling.
summary_en.result: Convergence studies enable efficient and accurate reconstruction by selecting appropriate numerical discretization parameters.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on a finite element model of a nano-structured line grating.

title: High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization via Semi-Supervised Learning with Optimized Unlabeled Data Sampling
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过半监督学习提升贝叶斯优化的样本效率，可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA or biomechanics problems; no constraint handling; focuses on synthetic optimization benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少贝叶斯优化中对昂贵标记数据的依赖。
summary_zh.method: 提出教师-学生框架，用优化未标记数据采样训练学生模型以正则化教师。
summary_zh.result: 在全局优化任务中显著提升样本效率。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准优化基准测试上进行数值实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the number of expensive labeled data queries in Bayesian optimization by leveraging unlabeled data.
summary_en.method: A teacher-student framework with optimized unlabeled data samplers that generate pseudo labels for student training, providing selective regularization to the teacher.
summary_en.result: Significantly improved sample efficiency on several global optimization benchmarks under tight labeled data budgets.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on standard synthetic global optimization problems (e.g., Ackley, Rosenbrock) and compared against state-of-the-art BO variants.

title: A Generative Modeling Framework for Inferring Families of Biomechanical Constitutive Laws in Data-Sparse Regimes
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种结合生成式深度学习与贝叶斯推断的方法，能够在数据稀疏条件下推断生物力学本构关系，其神经网络算子与不确定性量化技术可迁移至植入物有限元分析的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address multi-objective optimization or constraint handling in implant design; it focuses on material law discovery rather than full FEA surrogate for biomechanical design.

summary_zh.motivation: 在数据稀疏条件下高效推断血管生物力学本构关系。
summary_zh.method: 将生成对抗网络与贝叶斯推断结合，以神经算子为生成器、全连接网络为判别器。
summary_zh.result: 准确估计了小鼠主动脉本构关系的均值和标准差。
summary_zh.validation: 基于模型合成数据和基因缺陷小鼠离体实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To infer families of biomechanical constitutive laws from limited data without requiring explicit prior knowledge of the model form.
summary_en.method: A generative adversarial network with a neural operator as generator and a fully-connected discriminator, integrated with Bayesian inference for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The framework accurately estimates means and standard deviations of constitutive relationships for murine aortas using both synthetic and ex vivo data.
summary_en.validation: Validation using model-generated synthetic data and ex vivo experiments on genetically deficient mice.

title: Multi-Fidelity Data-Driven Design and Analysis of Reactor and Tube Simulations
relevance_to_user: 该方法的多保真贝叶斯优化框架可迁移至植入物设计的昂贵仿真优化问题，但缺乏生物力学约束处理。
why_not_core: Does not address implant mechanics, FEA validation, or biomedical constraints; focused on chemical reactor mixing optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 为3D打印化学反应器设计高效优化框架
summary_zh.method: 使用高斯过程多保真模型与贝叶斯优化自适应采样
summary_zh.result: 获得混合性能最优的螺旋管反应器几何
summary_zh.validation: 3D打印实物实验验证混合效果

summary_en.motivation: To develop a data-driven design framework for highly parameterized 3D-printed chemical reactors.
summary_en.method: Multi-fidelity Gaussian process regression with adaptive sampling using weighted acquisition functions for Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.result: Optimal helical-tube reactor geometry achieved enhanced mixing, confirmed by experimental testing.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation via 3D printing and mixing performance measurement.

title: Differences in hip musculoskeletal loads between limbs during daily activities in patients with 3D-printed hemipelvic reconstructions following tumor surgery.
first_author_affiliation: Bioengineering and Computing Laboratory, IRCCS Istituto Ortopedico Rizzoli, Bologna, Italy. Electronic address: giordano.valente@ior.it.

corresponding_authors.name: Giordano Valente
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Bioengineering and Computing Laboratory, IRCCS Istituto Ortopedico Rizzoli, Bologna, Italy. Electronic address: giordano.valente@ior.it.

relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及3D打印骨盆假体的临床生物力学分析，但未涉及LPBF制造工艺、多孔结构或疲劳测试。
why_not_core: Does not cover LPBF fabrication, mechanical testing (static or fatigue), porous structure design for stiffness matching, or surface characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 分析3D打印半骨盆重建患者的髋关节及肌肉力量不对称性。
summary_zh.method: 基于逆动力学和肌肉骨骼模型计算五类日常活动的关节力。
summary_zh.result: 对侧髋关节负荷显著增加（中位高达25%），但仍在生理范围内。
summary_zh.validation: 利用六名患者的足底反力数据进行模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify hip contact and muscle forces in patients with 3D-printed hemipelvic reconstructions to determine if ground reaction force asymmetries translate to musculoskeletal load imbalances.
summary_en.method: Optimization-based inverse dynamics musculoskeletal modeling was used to compute joint and muscle forces during five daily activities from measured ground reaction forces.
summary_en.result: Hip loads were significantly higher on the contralateral limb (up to 25% median increase), especially during stair descent and chair rise/sit, but both hips remained within physiological ranges.
summary_en.validation: Model-based forces were validated against ground reaction force measurements from six patients performing motor activities.

title: A biomimetic gradient porous cage with a micro-structure for enhancing mechanical properties and accelerating osseointegration in spinal fusion.
first_author_affiliation: Medical School of Chinese PLA, Beijing, 100853, China.; Department of Orthopedics, Chinese PLA General Hospital, Beijing, 100853, China.

corresponding_authors.name: Xue-Song Zhang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Medical School of Chinese PLA, Beijing, 100853, China.; Department of Orthopedics, Chinese PLA General Hospital, Beijing, 100853, China.

relevance_to_user: 该论文虽涉及3D打印多孔植入物，但针对脊柱融合而非髋关节植入物，且未涉及疲劳、LPBF工艺或应力遮挡分析。
why_not_core: Does not investigate fatigue behavior, is not fabricated via LPBF, and addresses spinal fusion rather than hip implant stress shielding or micromotion.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计一种同时增强力学性能和加速骨整合的脊柱融合器。
summary_zh.method: 基于PEEK/Ta复合材料，仿生梯度多孔结构，3D打印制备。
summary_zh.result: PEEK/Ta-15 gyroid结构融合器接近椎体力学性能，促进骨长入和骨整合。
summary_zh.validation: 体外实验和绵羊颈椎融合模型验证。

summary_en.motivation: To design a spinal fusion cage that simultaneously enhances mechanical properties and accelerates osseointegration to prevent implant failure.
summary_en.method: A biomimetic gradient porous microstructure was fabricated via 3D printing using PEEK/Ta composites with varying Ta content.
summary_en.result: The PEEK/Ta-15 gyroid cage exhibited mechanical properties close to cervical vertebra and promoted new bone penetration and osseointegration in vivo.
summary_en.validation: In vitro characterization and in vivo sheep cervical fusion model.

title: 129. Micropuncture Vascularization of Intraoperative Bioprinted Scaffolds
first_author_affiliation: Penn State College of Medicine, Hershey, PA, USA

corresponding_authors.name: Summer Horchler
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Penn State College of Medicine, Hershey, PA, USA

relevance_to_user: 该论文仅将AI用于后处理图像分析，未嵌入生物打印工作流中实现自主决策，但微穿刺血管化方法可作为生物打印构建物早期血管化的思路参考。
why_not_core: AI is used only for post-hoc image analysis, not for process control or autonomous decision-making in the bioprinting workflow.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决术中生物打印支架血管化不足的问题
summary_zh.method: 在大鼠模型中结合微穿刺与挤出式生物打印，用AI分析血管指标
summary_zh.result: 微穿刺组支架血管密度、管长等指标显著提升
summary_zh.validation: 大鼠后肢模型体内实验结合免疫荧光和AI图像分析

summary_en.motivation: To improve vascularization of intraoperative bioprinted scaffolds by integrating a microsurgical micropuncture technique.
summary_en.method: Microsurgery (micropuncture of femoral vessels) was combined with extrusion bioprinting of collagen scaffolds in a rat hindlimb model, and AI-based image analysis quantified vessel metrics.
summary_en.result: Micropuncture significantly increased vascular density, tube length, branch and loop counts in bioprinted scaffolds at day 10.
summary_en.validation: In vivo rat model with laser Doppler, fluorescence angiography, and histological immunofluorescence (CD31, DAPI) validated the vascularization improvement.

title: Representing Additive Gaussian Processes by Sparse Matrices
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的稀疏矩阵表示方法可加速高斯过程计算，对代理模型和贝叶斯优化有参考价值，但未涉及有限元或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, implant biomechanics, or any biomedical context; it focuses purely on algorithmic efficiency for additive GPs.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决加法高斯过程后验方差和似然计算效率低的问题
summary_zh.method: 利用稀疏矩阵和向量表示后验均值、方差、似然及其梯度，推广回拟合算法
summary_zh.result: 所有计算复杂度降至O(n log n)，贝叶斯优化中采集函数计算降至O(log n)或O(1)
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试验证算法效率

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the computational bottleneck of posterior variance and log-likelihood in additive Matérn GPs for high-dimensional problems.
summary_en.method: Derive sparse matrix and vector representations for posterior mean, variance, log-likelihood, and their gradients, enabling back-fitting-based algorithms to achieve O(n log n) complexity.
summary_en.result: The proposed algorithms reduce the time complexity of computing the acquisition function and its gradient in Bayesian optimization from O(n^2) to O(log n) or O(1).
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks demonstrate the efficiency gains over standard GP methods.

title: A reduced-order model for advection-dominated problems based on Radon Cumulative Distribution Transform
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于Radon累积分布变换的非线性降阶方法可处理对流主导问题，对生物力学中具有移动特征或形状变化的代理模型构建具有潜在迁移价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on advection-dominated fluid dynamics problems without biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 经典线性降阶方法难以处理对流主导问题中的移动特征和形状变化。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于Radon累积分布变换的非线性降阶方法，克服POD的局限性。
summary_zh.result: 数值实验表明该方法能准确插值对流主导现象，但离散变换可能引入伪影。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个制造算例和流体动力学问题验证。

summary_en.motivation: Classical linear model reduction methods fail to capture moving features and shape variations in advection-dominated problems.
summary_en.method: A nonlinear model order reduction approach based on the Radon Cumulative Distribution Transform is proposed to overcome limitations of standard POD.
summary_en.result: Numerical experiments demonstrate accurate interpolation of advection-dominated phenomena, though discrete transforms may introduce artifacts.
summary_en.validation: Validated on manufactured examples and fluid dynamics test cases.
