title: Yield Strength-Plasticity Trade-Off and Uncertainty Quantification for Machine-learning-based Design of Refractory High-Entropy Alloys
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示了机器学习在材料设计中的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至植入物力学性能预测。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on refractory high-entropy alloys, not on biomedical implant design or biomechanical FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发耐火高熵合金的机器学习设计方法，解决成分空间大、实验探索困难的问题。
summary_zh.method: 使用深度学习模型预测屈服强度和塑性，结合不确定性量化与模型可解释性。
summary_zh.result: 成功预测并实验验证了两种新合金的性能，揭示了影响力学性能的关键特征。
summary_zh.validation: 通过文献数据和新合金的合成与实验表征进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop machine learning models for refractory high-entropy alloys that can efficiently explore vast composition spaces and predict mechanical properties.
summary_en.method: Deep learning models with uncertainty quantification and interpretability techniques are used to predict compressive yield strength and room-temperature plasticity.
summary_en.result: Two new alloys were synthesized and experimentally validated, and key features influencing properties and uncertainty were identified, consistent with physical theory.
summary_en.validation: Experimental validation through literature data and synthesis/characterization of two new RHEAs.

title: Uncertainty Aware Neural Network from Similarity and Sensitivity
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于相似性和敏感性的不确定性量化方法，可迁移至代理模型中的不确定性估计，但未涉及有限元仿真或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: No FEA validation, no biomedical context, no implant mechanics, and no constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经网络不确定性量化方法在输入域中表现不佳且原因不明。
summary_zh.method: 通过训练误差预测网络和基于敏感性的相似样本选择，构建初始不确定性边界并校正。
summary_zh.result: 提出一种无需强假设的不确定性边界计算方法，最终输出一个不确定性边界预测网络。
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准上验证，未涉及实验或仿真案例。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural network uncertainty quantification methods often perform poorly in certain input domains without clear reasons.
summary_en.method: The method trains a shallow NN for point prediction, then an error prediction NN, selects sensitivity-aware similar samples to construct initial uncertainty bounds, and finally trains a bound correction NN.
summary_en.result: The approach produces a final uncertainty bound computation NN that provides prediction intervals without strong assumptions.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks; no experimental or simulation case studies are included.

title: Physics-informed Data-driven Discovery of Constitutive Models with Application to Strain-Rate-sensitive Soft Materials
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的物理信息数据驱动本构建模方法可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on constitutive modeling of strain-rate-sensitive soft materials without FEA surrogate or optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 结合热力学物理约束与机器学习，发现应变率敏感软材料的本构模型。
summary_zh.method: 基于粘性耗散框架，用三个高斯过程回归代理分别预测应力分量。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型在多种变形模式下准确预测应力-应变-应变率响应，泛化性好。
summary_zh.validation: 数值生成的小样本训练，多变形模式测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: To discover constitutive models for strain-rate-sensitive soft materials by integrating thermodynamic constraints with machine learning.
summary_en.method: Three Gaussian process regression surrogates are trained for volumetric, isochoric hyperelastic, and viscous overstress components using an irreducible integrity basis.
summary_en.result: The surrogate models accurately predict stress-strain-strain rate responses across multiple deformation modes with improved generalization and data efficiency.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerically generated datasets with small training samples and extensive testing on unseen deformation modes.

title: Lowering the Entry Bar to HPC-Scale Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种用于HPC规模不确定性量化的软件架构，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型的UQ应用。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on software infrastructure for UQ scaling, not on surrogate modeling methods, constraint handling, or implant/biomechanics-specific applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低HPC不确定性量化的技术门槛，促进UQ方法在复杂模型中的应用。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于UM-Bridge接口的并行软件架构，分离UQ与模型专家职责。
summary_zh.result: 在三个工程应用中展示了从单机到云集群的扩展能力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过三个不同领域的实际应用案例验证架构的可行性和可扩展性。

summary_en.motivation: To lower the technical barrier for applying HPC-scale uncertainty quantification to complex computational models by simplifying software integration.
summary_en.method: A parallel software architecture based on the UM-Bridge universal interface is introduced to decouple UQ methods from model solvers.
summary_en.result: Three realistic applications from different engineering domains demonstrate scaling from single machines to large cloud clusters.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through simulation case studies on three diverse applications, showing scalability and ease of deployment.

title: AI-aided Geometric Design of Anti-infection Catheters
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用Fourier神经算子加速细菌动力学模拟，方法可迁移至植入物力学代理建模，但应用领域为导管抗感染而非生物力学。
why_not_core: No FEA or solid mechanics context; no implant stress/strain or contact mechanics; no uncertainty quantification.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决导管细菌逆流感染问题，缺乏有效表面结构设计。
summary_zh.method: 基于Fourier神经算子构建AI代理模型，优化导管几何形状。
summary_zh.result: 优化设计使上游细菌污染抑制提升1-2个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 准二维微流控实验和3D打印原型导管测试。

summary_en.motivation: To address bacterial upstream contamination in catheters, which current coatings and surface structures fail to fully prevent.
summary_en.method: A Fourier neural operator-based AI surrogate model is used to predict bacterial dynamics and optimize catheter geometry.
summary_en.result: The optimized catheter design achieves 1-2 orders of magnitude improvement in suppressing bacterial contamination at the upstream end.
summary_en.validation: Validation via quasi-2D microfluidic experiments and 3D-printed prototype catheters under clinical flow rates.

title: Nonlocality and Nonlinearity Implies Universality in Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种极简的神经算子架构（ANO），其通用逼近性证明对开发高效代理模型具有理论指导意义，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计的具体应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant biomechanics, lacks constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or any biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 探索神经算子通用逼近所需的最小非局部和非线性条件。
summary_zh.method: 提出平均神经算子（ANO），仅使用空间平均作为非局部成分，并证明其通用逼近性。
summary_zh.result: ANO即使只保留单一傅里叶模式也能实现通用逼近，统一了多种神经算子架构的分析。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值实验展示通道宽度和傅里叶模式数对复杂度的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To determine the minimal nonlocal and nonlinear ingredients required for universal approximation of neural operators.
summary_en.method: Proposes the averaging neural operator (ANO), which uses only a spatial average as its nonlocal component, and proves its universal approximation property.
summary_en.result: The ANO achieves universal approximation even with a single Fourier mode, unifying the analysis of various neural operator architectures.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments illustrate the impact of channel width and number of Fourier modes on complexity.

title: Kernel Methods are Competitive for Operator Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于核方法的算子学习框架，具有不确定性量化能力，可迁移至生物力学有限元代理建模。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on general operator learning benchmarks without implant or biomechanics-specific FEA validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发一种简单、可解释且具有不确定性量化的算子学习方法。
summary_zh.method: 利用再生核希尔伯特空间和最优恢复构建核方法算子学习框架。
summary_zh.result: 在多数基准测试中，核方法在成本-精度权衡上匹配或超越神经网络方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准问题与DeepONet和FNO进行对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a simple, interpretable operator learning method with convergence guarantees and Bayesian uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A kernel-based framework using reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces and optimal recovery to approximate operators between Banach spaces.
summary_en.result: Kernel methods match or outperform neural network approaches on most benchmarks in terms of cost-accuracy trade-off.
summary_en.validation: Comprehensive numerical comparisons with DeepONet and FNO on multiple benchmark problems.

title: Multiscale Homogenization Techniques for TPMS Foam Material for Biomedical Structural Applications.
first_author_affiliation: INEGI-Institute of Science and Innovation in Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, Rua Dr. Roberto Frias, s/n, 4200-465 Porto, Portugal.

corresponding_authors.name: Jorge Belinha
corresponding_authors.affiliation: INEGI-Institute of Science and Innovation in Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, Rua Dr. Roberto Frias, s/n, 4200-465 Porto, Portugal.; ISEP-School of Engineering, Polytechnic of Porto, Rua Dr. António Bernardino de Almeida, 431, 4249-015 Porto, Portugal.

relevance_to_user: 该论文通过数值均质化研究TPMS多孔结构以降低股骨柄应力遮挡，与研究方向中的髋关节植入物应力遮挡分析相关。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing, no fatigue or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 减少多孔结构分析计算成本，优化植入物以降低应力遮挡。
summary_zh.method: 采用数值均质化方法推导Gyroid和Primitive TPMS的弹塑性材料规律。
summary_zh.result: 功能梯度Gyroid股骨柄刚度接近松质骨，有效降低应力遮挡。
summary_zh.validation: 均质化模型与文献中实验数据对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost in analyzing complex lattice structures and optimize porous implants for stress shielding reduction.
summary_en.method: Numerical homogenization is applied to gyroid and primitive TPMS cellular structures to derive elastic and plastic material laws.
summary_en.result: A functionally graded femoral stem with gyroid foam achieves stiffness comparable to trabecular bone while minimizing stress shielding.
summary_en.validation: The homogenized model is validated against experimental data from literature.

title: Manufacturability study in laser powder bed fusion of biomedical Ti alloys for orthopedic implants: an investigation of mechanical properties, process-induced porosity and surface roughness

title: Quantile Extreme Gradient Boosting for Uncertainty Quantification

summary_zh.method: 在XGBoost中引入Huber范数近似分位数回归损失函数，实现概率预测。
summary_zh.result: QXGBoost在模拟和交通噪声数据集上生成90%预测区间，性能优于对比方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在模拟数据集和真实交通噪声数据集上验证预测区间覆盖率和宽度。

summary_en.result: QXGBoost produces 90% prediction intervals with comparable or better coverage width-based criterion than quantile light gradient boosting on simulated and real-world traffic noise data.

title: Increasing the Scope as You Learn: Adaptive Bayesian Optimization in Nested Subspaces

summary_zh.result: 在多个应用中优于现有方法，且具有理论保证。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准高维优化基准测试和实际应用上进行数值实验。

summary_en.motivation: High-dimensional Bayesian optimization methods suffer from degrading performance as dimensionality increases and risk failure under unverifiable assumptions.
summary_en.method: BAxUS adaptively optimizes over a nested family of random subspaces to match the problem structure.
summary_en.result: BAxUS achieves superior performance over state-of-the-art methods across a broad set of applications with theoretical guarantees.

title: Self-Correcting Bayesian Optimization through Bayesian Active Learning
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过主动学习优化高斯过程超参数，可提升贝叶斯优化的采样效率，对植入物设计中的昂贵仿真代理建模有潜在迁移价值。

summary_zh.validation: 在多个标准测试函数上进行数值基准验证。

summary_en.motivation: Gaussian processes are sensitive to hyperparameter selection, yet existing Bayesian optimization and active learning methods often neglect hyperparameter learning.
summary_en.method: This work proposes Statistical distance-based Active Learning (SAL) and Self-Correcting Bayesian Optimization (SCoreBO), which jointly optimize hyperparameters and sample selection via acquisition functions that prioritize hyperparameter learning.
summary_en.result: SAL and SCoreBO outperform state-of-the-art methods on standard benchmarks, achieving faster hyperparameter convergence and better optimization performance.
summary_en.validation: The methods are validated on multiple synthetic test functions using numerical benchmarks.

summary_en.motivation: Conventional AK-MCS relies on a candidate sample pool, which degrades efficiency and accuracy for systems with small failure probabilities.
summary_en.method: A CSP-free AK-MCS is proposed that selects representative samples via PSO optimization, with penalty intensity and density control to balance accuracy and efficiency.
summary_en.result: Numerical examples demonstrate that the proposed method overcomes the limitations of CSP-based AK-MCS and performs exceptionally well for small failure probabilities.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using multiple numerical benchmark examples.

summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on numerical benchmark examples for system identification.

summary_zh.motivation: 为PINN逼近二阶时间相关PDE提供严格误差界
summary_zh.method: 基于训练损失和配置点数推导误差界，提出改进损失函数的PINN变体
summary_zh.result: 新算法在波动、正弦-戈登和线弹性动力学方程上能较好逼近解
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准PDE数值算例验证理论

summary_en.motivation: To provide rigorous error bounds for physics-informed neural networks when approximating second-order time-dependent partial differential equations.
summary_en.method: We derive error bounds in terms of training loss and quadrature point count, and propose a variant PINN algorithm with a modified loss function that includes residuals crucial for the estimate.
summary_en.result: The new PINN variant accurately captures solutions of the wave, Sine-Gordon, and linear elastodynamic equations in extensive numerical experiments.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on standard PDE examples confirm the theoretical error bounds.

key_terms.zh: 二阶时间相关偏微分方程

title: Adaptive Conformal Prediction by Reweighting Nonconformity Score
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的自适应共形预测方法可迁移至代理模型的不确定性量化，但未涉及FEA或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or application to implant/biomechanics FEA surrogate modeling.

summary_zh.motivation: 共形预测的预测区间未反映模型对每个样本的不确定性，需自适应调整。
summary_zh.method: 使用分位数回归森林学习非一致性分数分布，并通过权重分配实现自适应区间。
summary_zh.result: 提出方法生成的区间长度与模型不确定性更对齐，且保证边际和训练条件覆盖。
summary_zh.validation: 在模拟和真实数据集上验证，相比现有方法有显著改进。

summary_en.motivation: Conformal prediction intervals often fail to reflect per-instance model uncertainty due to constant correction across test points.
summary_en.method: We propose using a Quantile Regression Forest to learn the nonconformity score distribution and assign higher importance to samples with similar residuals for adaptive intervals.
summary_en.result: The resulting prediction intervals align better with model uncertainty while maintaining marginal and training-conditional coverage guarantees.
summary_en.validation: Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate significant improvements over existing conformal prediction methods.

title: Active Learning Sensitivity Analysis of $γ^\prime$(L1$_2$) Precipitate Morphology of Ternary Co-Based Superalloys
relevance_to_user: 该方法中的主动学习高斯过程回归代理建模策略可迁移至生物力学FEA中的敏感性分析和设计优化，但未涉及植入物或生物力学场景。
why_not_core: No validation on biomechanical FEA; no application to implant design or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 理解钴基高温合金γ'析出相形态对相场参数的敏感性。
summary_zh.method: 采用高斯过程回归构建代理模型，结合贝叶斯优化主动学习提高采样效率。
summary_zh.result: 发现初始钴浓度和双势垒高度分别是尺寸和形态最敏感的参数。
summary_zh.validation: 通过相场模拟数据验证代理模型预测能力。

summary_en.motivation: To understand the sensitivity of equilibrium γ' precipitate morphology and size to phase-field parameters in Co-based superalloys.
summary_en.method: Gaussian Process Regression surrogate models are built and updated via a Bayesian Optimization active learning strategy to efficiently explore parameter space.
summary_en.result: Initial Co concentration and double-well barrier height are identified as the most sensitive parameters for precipitate size and morphology, respectively.
summary_en.validation: The surrogate models are validated against phase-field simulations, with noise tolerance added to avoid overfitting on irregular morphologies.

title: Compressive behavior and property prediction of gradient cellular structures fabricated by selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: Fujian Key Laboratory of Intelligent Machining Technology and Equipment, Fujian University of Technology, Fuzhou 350118, China

corresponding_authors.name: Changrong Chen
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Fujian Key Laboratory of Intelligent Machining Technology and Equipment, Fujian University of Technology, Fuzhou 350118, China

corresponding_authors.name: Yamin Liu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: School of Ecological Environment and Urban Construction, Fujian University of Technology, Fuzhou 350118, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了梯度多孔结构的压缩性能与性能预测方法，与用户关注的应力遮挡和刚度匹配相关，但未涉及生物医学背景或疲劳性能。
why_not_core: The paper does not address fatigue behavior, surface roughness, osseointegration, or biomedical context for hip implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 为设计匹配骨刚度的梯度多孔结构提供依据
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制备梯度点阵结构并进行准静态压缩实验
summary_zh.result: 建立了压缩性能预测模型，揭示了梯度参数对力学响应的影响
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验数据验证了预测模型的准确性

summary_en.motivation: To design gradient cellular structures with tailored stiffness for potential implant applications.
summary_en.method: Gradient cellular structures were fabricated via selective laser melting and tested under quasi-static compression.
summary_en.result: A property prediction model was established, showing the influence of gradient parameters on mechanical response.
summary_en.validation: The prediction model was validated against experimental compression test data.

title: Uncertainty-aware deep learning for digital twin-driven monitoring: Application to fault detection in power lines
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于数字孪生的不确定性感知深度学习监控方法，虽应用于电力线故障检测，但其方法可迁移至生物打印过程的质量监控。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve bioprinting, lacks experimental validation in bioprinting, and has no biomedical application context.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估数字孪生数据中参数不确定性对深度学习监控性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 提出不确定性感知深度神经网络，传播输入不确定性并利用MC dropout捕捉模型参数不确定性。
summary_zh.result: 概率模型相比确定性模型提供置信度信息并提升故障检测性能。
summary_zh.validation: 基于电力线物理模型生成数据进行仿真验证。

summary_en.motivation: To quantify the impact of parametric uncertainty from physics-based digital twin models on deep neural network performance for fault detection.
summary_en.method: An uncertainty-aware DNN is developed that propagates input uncertainty through all layers and uses Monte Carlo dropout to capture model parameter uncertainty.
summary_en.result: Probabilistic models provide prediction confidence and achieve improved fault detection performance over deterministic counterparts.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on a power line physics-based simulation with two input types and three architectures.

title: Solving High-Dimensional Inverse Problems with Auxiliary Uncertainty via Operator Learning with Limited Data
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过算子学习构建代理模型，结合贝叶斯逆问题框架处理辅助不确定性，可迁移至植入物力学设计中的高维逆问题与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant design, biomechanics, or any biomedical context; it is purely an atmospheric inverse problem with no biomechanical validation or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 大规模系统中高维逆问题求解困难，代理模型与不确定性量化至关重要。
summary_zh.method: 基于深度神经网络算子学习构建状态-源映射代理，结合贝叶斯近似误差方法反演源项。
summary_zh.result: 在有限数据下实现源识别与不确定性量化，处理辅助过程不确定性是反演成功的关键。
summary_zh.validation: 通过大气扩散数值算例验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Inverse problems in large-scale systems are hindered by high dimensionality, expensive simulations, and auxiliary uncertainties, necessitating efficient surrogate-based inversion with uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.method: A deep neural network operator surrogate is calibrated to flow maps from simulation ensembles and used in a Bayesian framework to identify sources from sparse observations, incorporating the Bayesian approximation error method to account for auxiliary process uncertainty.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework enables source identification with uncertainty quantification using limited data, and explicitly handling auxiliary wind uncertainty proves essential for reliable inversion.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on an atmospheric dispersion simulation case with varying wind fields as auxiliary processes.

title: Bi-orthogonal fPINN: A physics-informed neural network method for solving time-dependent stochastic fractional PDEs
relevance_to_user: 该方法将物理信息神经网络与双正交方法结合求解随机分数阶PDE，虽未直接应用于生物力学，但其处理不确定性和约束的能力可迁移至植入物代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modelling for implant design, lacks contact mechanics, and validates only on fractional PDE benchmarks without biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 结合PINN与双正交方法求解含不确定性的时间依赖随机分数阶PDE。
summary_zh.method: 提出BO-fPINN，采用弱形式损失函数和网格计算分数阶导数。
summary_zh.result: 有效处理特征值交叉问题，适用于正反问题。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准基准问题验证方法灵活性和效率。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently solve time-dependent stochastic fractional PDEs with uncertainty quantification by integrating bi-orthogonal representations with physics-informed neural networks.
summary_en.method: The BO-fPINN method embeds bi-orthogonal constraints into a weak-form loss function and computes fractional derivatives numerically on a grid to avoid automatic differentiation limitations.
summary_en.result: The method handles eigenvalue crossings and achieves competitive performance on forward and inverse benchmark problems with reduced computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on several benchmark SFPDE problems, demonstrating accuracy and efficiency for both forward and inverse settings.

title: LNO: Laplace Neural Operator for Solving Differential Equations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出Laplace神经算子，可加速PDE求解，但未涉及生物力学约束处理和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: Does not include uncertainty quantification, constraint handling, or biomechanical validation; only tested on standard ODE/PDE benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 改进神经算子对非周期信号和瞬态响应的建模能力
summary_zh.method: 利用拉普拉斯变换和极点-留数表示构建神经算子
summary_zh.result: 在多个ODE和PDE上超越傅里叶神经算子
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准与FNO对比验证精度

summary_en.motivation: To enhance neural operators' ability to handle non-periodic signals and transient responses in solving differential equations.
summary_en.method: The Laplace neural operator leverages the Laplace transform and pole-residue representation to learn mappings between function spaces.
summary_en.result: LNO achieves better approximation accuracy than FNO on Duffing oscillator, Euler-Bernoulli beam, and reaction-diffusion systems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on ODEs and PDEs demonstrate superior performance over Fourier neural operator.

title: Scalable Physics-based Maximum Likelihood Estimation using Hierarchical Matrices
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过分层矩阵加速基于物理的高斯过程建模，可迁移至生物力学代理模型中的不确定性量化，但未直接应用于植入物设计。
why_not_core: Does not apply the method to implant biomechanics, lacks validation on biomedical FEA cases, and does not address constraints optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决基于物理的高斯过程协方差建模中计算代价高的问题
summary_zh.method: 使用分层矩阵和随机素描近似协方差矩阵，实现矩阵构建和最大似然估计的线性对数复杂度
summary_zh.result: 数值实验证明了该方法在参数估计和不确定性量化中的有效性、准确性和高效性
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准测试验证了算法的精度和效率

summary_en.motivation: To address the high computational cost of constructing and inverting covariance matrices in physics-based Gaussian process models.
summary_en.method: Approximate the covariance function using hierarchical matrices with randomized range sketching, achieving O(log n) physical model runs and O(n log^2 n) MLE computations.
summary_en.result: Numerical results demonstrate effectiveness and efficiency for parameter estimation and uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: Validation via numerical benchmark experiments.

title: Mechanical behavior of CuZrAl metallic glass scaffolds fabricated by selective laser melting
first_author_affiliation: Department of Materials and Mineral Resources Engineering, National Taipei University of Technology, No. 1, Sec. 3, Zhong-Xiao E. Rd., Taipei 10608, Taiwan

corresponding_authors.name: Pei Wang
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Henan Key Laboratory of High Performance Carbon Fiber Reinforced Composites, Carbon Matrix Composites Research Institute, Henan Academy of Sciences, Zhengzhou 450046, China

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF制造金属玻璃支架的力学行为，但未涉及生物医学植入物的关键点如应力遮挡、疲劳或骨整合。
why_not_core: This paper does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue testing, surface morphology, or osseointegration for biomedical implants.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究CuZrAl金属玻璃支架的力学性能与晶格结构关系。
summary_zh.method: 采用SLM制造F2BCC晶格支架，比较直杆与弯曲杆的影响。
summary_zh.result: 弯曲杆使压缩延展性提高122%，能量吸收提高106%。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩力学测试验证结构性能。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of lattice structure design on the mechanical behavior of metallic glass scaffolds fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: CuZrAl metallic glass scaffolds with F2BCC lattice composed of straight or curved struts were fabricated via SLM and tested under compression.
summary_en.result: Scaffolds with curved struts exhibited 122% higher compressive ductility and 106% higher energy absorption than straight strut counterparts.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical validation was performed through uniaxial compression tests on as-fabricated lattice scaffolds.

title: Hierarchical-Hyperplane Kernels for Actively Learning Gaussian Process Models of Nonstationary Systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的主动学习高斯过程方法可迁移用于生物力学有限元代理模型的构建，但未涉及约束优化或生物医学应用。
why_not_core: No validation on FEA or biomechanics problems, and does not address constraint handling in optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 昂贵仿真需要高效代理模型和主动学习策略
summary_zh.method: 提出可学习的层次超平面核用于非平稳高斯过程
summary_zh.result: 在主动学习基准任务上表现优异
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the number of expensive experiments required for training surrogate models of nonstationary systems.
summary_en.method: Proposes a hierarchical-hyperplane kernel family for Gaussian processes that enables learnable input partitioning with flexible geometry.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates superior performance on various active learning benchmarks compared to baselines.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on synthetic and benchmark active learning problems.

title: Gyroid-like metamaterials: Topology optimization and Deep Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文将深度学习与拓扑优化结合用于TPMS超材料设计，虽未涉及LPBF制造或生物医学验证，但方法可迁移至多孔植入物的刚度匹配设计。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no mechanical testing (static or fatigue), no surface roughness or osseointegration data, and no biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统拓扑优化计算成本高，难以用于TPMS超材料逆向设计。
summary_zh.method: 提出基于体素算法和Heaviside滤波的均质化拓扑优化，并用3D CNN学习优化过程。
summary_zh.result: CNN模型可瞬时预测优化单元几何，精度高（低MSE和高Dice系数）。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试，与拓扑优化结果对比。

summary_en.motivation: Traditional topology optimization for TPMS metamaterials is computationally expensive, hindering inverse design.
summary_en.method: A voxel-based homogenization topology optimization with Heaviside filter is used to generate training data, and a 3D CNN learns the mapping from topology parameters to optimized geometry.
summary_en.result: The trained CNN predicts optimized unit cell geometries instantaneously with high accuracy (low MSE and high Dice coefficient).
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmark against topology optimization results.

title: Adaptive Modeling of Uncertainties for Traffic Forecasting
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种通用不确定性量化框架，可迁移到代理模型中，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on traffic forecasting, with no FEA surrogate modeling, no implant or biomechanics context, and no mechanical simulation validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有交通预测模型缺乏不确定性量化，无法提供预测区间。
summary_zh.method: 提出QuanTraffic框架，自动学习分位数函数并动态调整预测区间。
summary_zh.result: 在多个数据集上优于现有不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在七个公共数据集上与五种基线方法对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Current traffic forecasting models produce single-point predictions without uncertainty quantification, which is critical for decision making.
summary_en.method: QuanTraffic integrates a quantile function into arbitrary DNN training and adaptively adjusts the prediction interval based on input characteristics.
summary_en.result: QuanTraffic consistently outperforms five baseline uncertainty quantification methods across seven public traffic datasets.
summary_en.validation: The framework is validated on seven public datasets using five representative DNN models and compared against five uncertainty quantification baselines.

title: Structural disorder by octahedral tilting in inorganic halide perovskites: New insight with Bayesian optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文展示的贝叶斯优化方法可提高昂贵仿真采样效率，对骨科植入物FEA代理模型构建有转移潜力，但无直接生物力学验证。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve FEA, biomechanics, or implant design; it focuses on perovskite materials and DFT simulations.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究钙钛矿结构无序性，解决第一性原理计算采样效率低。
summary_zh.method: 结合贝叶斯优化与DFT进行三维势能面搜索。
summary_zh.result: 200个DFT点即可快速收敛三维PES，揭示温度与无序性关系。
summary_zh.validation: 仅数值收敛分析，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To characterize structural disorder in metal-halide perovskites by overcoming the sampling limitations of first-principles methods.
summary_en.method: Integrated Bayesian optimization with DFT calculations to efficiently map three-dimensional potential-energy surfaces and property landscapes.
summary_en.result: The approach achieved rapid convergence with only ~200 DFT data points, revealing that the band gap at finite temperatures is a statistical mean over disordered structures.
summary_en.validation: Demonstrated through numerical convergence of the potential-energy surface, without experimental or biomechanical validation.

title: Proper Orthogonal Decomposition Mode Coefficient Interpolation: A Non-Intrusive Reduced-Order Model for Parametric Reactor Kinetics
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽应用于反应堆动力学，但其中基于POD的非侵入式降阶建模技术可迁移至生物力学有限元代理模型构建。
why_not_core: This paper does not address constraints handling, uncertainty quantification, or biomedical implant/orthopedic FEA applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低参数化反应堆动力学仿真的计算成本
summary_zh.method: 提出基于POD模态系数插值的非侵入式降阶模型
summary_zh.result: 在参数空间中实现高精度QoI预测且加速比显著
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值算例验证模型精度与加速效果

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of parametric reactor kinetics simulations by constructing an efficient reduced-order model.
summary_en.method: The POD mode coefficient interpolation (POD-MCI) method builds a non-intrusive ROM directly from lower-dimensional quantities of interest, independent of the underlying full-order model.
summary_en.result: The POD-MCI ROM achieves accurate characterizations of QoIs within selected parameter spaces with extremely attractive computational speed-up factors.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on multiple numerical examples, demonstrating accuracy and speed-up relative to full-order models.

title: On the uncertainty analysis of the data-enabled physics-informed neural network for solving neutron diffusion eigenvalue problem
relevance_to_user: 该论文在PINN框架中引入了不确定性量化来处理噪声数据，其方法论可迁移至生物力学中基于PINN的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on neutron diffusion eigenvalue problems in nuclear physics with no biomedical context, solid mechanics FEA, or implant-related design.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究含噪声先验数据对DEPINN求解中子扩散本征值问题性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 提出带数学证明的区间损失函数以减轻噪声影响。
summary_zh.result: 通过大量数值实验验证了所提方法的鲁棒性和有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 在两个标准中子扩散基准问题上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: This paper investigates the performance of data-enabled physics-informed neural networks for neutron diffusion eigenvalue problems when prior data contain noise.
summary_en.method: Novel interval loss functions with rigorous mathematical proofs are proposed to reduce the effect of noise and improve data utilization.
summary_en.result: Numerical results on two benchmark problems demonstrate improved robustness and effectiveness of the proposed method.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through extensive numerical experiments on standard neutron diffusion benchmark problems.

title: Application of probabilistic modeling and automated machine learning framework for high-dimensional stress field
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的降维与贝叶斯/深度神经网络代理建模方法可转移至植入物生物力学设计中的高维应力场问题。
why_not_core: Does not demonstrate application to implant or biomechanics design; validation on a generic linear elastic stress field without experimental or clinical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统代理模型难以处理高维输入输出且需要大量数据。
summary_zh.method: 提出PCA降维结合贝叶斯混合模型或深度神经网络的端到端代理框架。
summary_zh.result: 在线弹性应力场问题中实现了高维输入到高维输出的高效映射。
summary_zh.validation: 通过线弹性应力场数值算例验证方法有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional surrogate models struggle with high-dimensional inputs and outputs and require large datasets.
summary_en.method: An end-to-end framework is proposed that applies PCA for dimensionality reduction coupled with either Bayesian hybrid modeling or DeepHyper's deep neural networks to map high-dimensional image-like inputs to high-dimensional outputs or key statistics.
summary_en.result: The approach efficiently emulates the behavior of expensive computer models on a linear elastic stress field problem, enabling tasks like uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on a numerical benchmark of linear elastic stress field data.

title: A Multifidelity deep operator network approach to closure for multiscale systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真深度算子网络方法可用于解决多尺度模拟中的闭合问题，对代理建模有参考价值，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No explicit uncertainty quantification, no constraint handling, and no validation on biomedical or implant-related problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多尺度系统降阶模型因未建模小尺度导致的误差。
summary_zh.method: 采用多保真深度算子网络与回路内训练实现闭合修正。
summary_zh.result: 在一维Burgers和二维Navier-Stokes案例中显著提升预测准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试（Burgers和Navier-Stokes）。

summary_en.motivation: To address inaccuracies in projection-based reduced order models for multiscale systems due to unresolved scale interactions (closure problem).
summary_en.method: Proposed a multifidelity DeepONet framework with in-the-loop training to correct the closure error.
summary_en.result: Significant improvement in predictive accuracy for shock advection and vortex merging test cases.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on Burgers equation and Navier-Stokes equations.

title: A Machine-Learning-Based Approach for Predicting Mechanical Performance of Semi-Porous Hip Stems.
first_author_affiliation: Department of Engineering Management, Prince Sultan University, P.O. Box 66833, Riyadh 11586, Saudi Arabia.

corresponding_authors.name: Faris Tarlochan
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department for Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, Qatar University, Doha 2713, Qatar.

relevance_to_user: 该论文利用机器学习预测半多孔髋关节假体的力学性能，但缺乏实验制造与测试，与AM生物医学材料方向联系较弱。
why_not_core: No LPBF fabrication, no experimental mechanical testing, no fatigue analysis, no surface roughness or osseointegration characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 基于机器学习预测半多孔髋关节假体的力学性能，避免昂贵有限元计算。
summary_zh.method: 使用六种机器学习算法训练有限元模拟数据，预测假体刚度、应力及安全系数。
summary_zh.result: 决策树回归验证MAPE为19.62%，岭回归预测趋势最一致。
summary_zh.validation: 通过有限元模拟数据验证，无实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To predict mechanical performance of semi-porous hip stems using machine learning, bypassing expensive finite element simulations.
summary_en.method: Six machine learning algorithms were trained on FEA data to predict stiffness, stress, and safety factor for new stem designs.
summary_en.result: Decision tree regression achieved the best validation MAPE of 19.62%, while ridge regression produced the most consistent test trends.
summary_en.validation: Validated against finite element simulation results without experimental testing.

title: Recent Advances and Applications of Machine Learning in Experimental Solid Mechanics: A Review
relevance_to_user: 这篇综述涵盖了机器学习在固体实验力学中的应用，但未聚焦于有限元分析的代理模型或植入物设计优化。
why_not_core: This paper is a broad review of ML in experimental solid mechanics, not specifically addressing surrogate modeling, constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or transferability to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述机器学习在实验固体力学中的最新应用与进展
summary_zh.method: 概述常见ML算法，重点介绍物理信息ML方法及其应用
summary_zh.result: 总结了ML在断裂力学、生物力学等领域的应用，并提出未来方向
summary_zh.validation: 作为综述，未提供新实验验证

summary_en.motivation: The paper provides a comprehensive review of recent machine learning applications in experimental solid mechanics, motivated by the rapid growth of the field.
summary_en.method: It overviews common ML algorithms, emphasizing physics-informed methods, and surveys applications across fracture mechanics, biomechanics, and other areas.
summary_en.result: The review highlights current challenges and proposes future research directions for integrating ML with multi-modal experimental data.
summary_en.validation: As a review, no new experimental validation is performed; it synthesizes existing literature.

title: Learning to Adapt the Parameters of Behavior Trees and Motion Generators (BTMGs) to Task Variations
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的基于高斯过程的代理模型方法可迁移至生物力学领域的有限元代理建模，但未涉及植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not involve finite element analysis, structural mechanics, implant design, or biomechanics; it focuses on robot task parameter adaptation.

summary_zh.motivation: 机器人需要适应任务变化，但传统方法无法泛化。
summary_zh.method: 结合高斯过程和SVM构建代理模型，预测参数性能并优化任务。
summary_zh.result: 在推和避障任务中，方法优于基线，实现快速自适应。
summary_zh.validation: 仿真与真实KUKA机器人实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: Robots must adapt to task variations, but current policy representations lack robustness and generalization.
summary_en.method: A surrogate model combining Gaussian process and weighted SVM predicts policy feasibility and performance, used in an optimizer to maximize task performance.
summary_en.result: The approach outperforms four baselines on push and obstacle avoidance tasks in both simulation and real-robot experiments.
summary_en.validation: Validation through simulation case studies and real KUKA iiwa robot experiments.

title: GaPT: Gaussian Process Toolkit for Online Regression with Application to Learning Quadrotor Dynamics
relevance_to_user: 该方法的高斯过程回归与不确定性量化可用于代理模型，但未涉及有限元或生物力学设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not address FEA surrogate modelling, handling constraints, or validation on implant/biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效的高斯过程回归用于在线机器人系统辨识。
summary_zh.method: 将高斯过程转换为状态空间形式并利用卡尔曼滤波实现线性时间回归。
summary_zh.result: 相比经典方法，大幅降低计算复杂度，实现实时回归。
summary_zh.validation: 通过四旋翼飞行器动力学仿真和实测数据进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient Gaussian process regression is needed for real-time inference on resource-constrained robotic platforms.
summary_en.method: The GaPT toolkit transforms GPs into state-space models and performs regression in linear time using Kalman filtering.
summary_en.result: GaPT achieves superior computational speed compared to classical GP regression while maintaining accurate modeling of nonlinear quadrotor dynamics.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on both simulated and real quadrotor flight data across multiple regimes and operating conditions.

title: An asynchronous parallel high-throughput model calibration framework for crystal plasticity finite element constitutive models
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用的异步并行约束贝叶斯优化方法可转移至生物医学植入物设计的昂贵有限元模拟校准问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address biomedical implant design, bone-implant interface mechanics, or patient-specific geometry optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高晶体塑性有限元模型校准效率，减少计算成本
summary_zh.method: 应用异步并行约束贝叶斯优化算法校准本构模型参数
summary_zh.result: 成功校准不锈钢、钽和Cantor高熵合金三种材料
summary_zh.validation: 通过与实验数据对比验证模型预测能力

summary_en.motivation: Efficient calibration of crystal plasticity finite element models is crucial for predictive materials science but computationally expensive.
summary_en.method: An asynchronous parallel constrained Bayesian optimization algorithm is applied to calibrate phenomenological constitutive models for three materials.
summary_en.result: The algorithm successfully calibrated models for stainless steel 304L, Tantalum, and Cantor high-entropy alloy.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed by comparing simulation predictions with experimental data for each material.

title: Efficient Bayesian Physics Informed Neural Networks for Inverse Problems via Ensemble Kalman Inversion
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过集成卡尔曼滤波实现高效贝叶斯推断，可迁移至生物力学代理模型的不确定性量化
why_not_core: Paper does not validate on FEA or biomechanics problems, nor address multi-objective constraints or sampling efficiency in high-dimensional design spaces.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解贝叶斯物理信息神经网络的高维后验推断
summary_zh.method: 利用集成卡尔曼滤波进行后验采样
summary_zh.result: 与哈密顿蒙特卡洛精度相当但计算成本大幅降低
summary_zh.validation: 数值基准测试

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently perform high-dimensional posterior inference in Bayesian Physics Informed Neural Networks while maintaining informative uncertainty estimates.
summary_en.method: Proposes using Ensemble Kalman Inversion (EKI) for posterior sampling in B-PINNs.
summary_en.result: Achieves comparable uncertainty estimates to Hamiltonian Monte Carlo with significantly reduced computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems involving partial differential equations.

key_terms.zh: 贝叶斯物理信息神经网络

title: Data-Driven Statistical Reduced-Order Modeling and Quantification of Polycrystal Mechanics Leading to Porosity-Based Ductile Damage
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的数据驱动降阶模型和不确定性量化方法可用于类似昂贵仿真问题，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计，需自行迁移。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on polycrystal ductile damage, not on implant-specific biomechanics, contact mechanics, or patient-specific design.

summary_zh.motivation: 预测多晶金属中孔隙韧性损伤过程及其不确定性
summary_zh.method: 基于矩演化和因果熵稀疏辨识的统计降阶框架，结合最大熵原理重建PDF
summary_zh.result: 模型准确捕捉非高斯PDF和极端事件概率，且具有良好的外推能力
summary_zh.validation: 在多晶数值样本上验证了矩方程和PDF预测的准确性

summary_en.motivation: To probabilistically forecast porosity-based ductile damage in polycrystalline metals, which involves strongly non-Gaussian PDFs and extreme events.
summary_en.method: A data-driven reduced-order model is constructed by learning moment evolution equations via causation-entropy sparse identification with physical constraints, then reconstructing PDFs using maximum entropy.
summary_en.result: The model captures the time-evolution of non-Gaussian stress PDFs and quantifies extreme event probabilities, showing robust extrapolation to unseen microstructures.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on polycrystal realizations validate the accuracy of predicted moments and PDFs against full-field simulations.

title: Tailoring the theory of critical distances to better assess the combined effect of complex geometries and process-inherent defects during the fatigue assessment of SLM Ti-6Al-4V
first_author_affiliation: AMBER, the SFI Research Centre for Advanced Materials and BioEngineering Research, Ireland

corresponding_authors.name: Bobby Gillham
corresponding_authors.affiliation: AMBER, the SFI Research Centre for Advanced Materials and BioEngineering Research, Ireland

corresponding_authors.name: Rocco Lupoi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: AMBER, the SFI Research Centre for Advanced Materials and BioEngineering Research, Ireland

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM Ti-6Al-4V的疲劳评估方法，对理解增材制造植入物的疲劳性能有参考价值，但未涉及应力遮挡或骨整合等核心问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, stiffness matching, or osseointegration; it focuses only on fatigue prediction methodology for SLM Ti-6Al-4V with defects.

summary_zh.motivation: 改进临界距离理论，用于评估SLM Ti-6Al-4V中复杂几何和缺陷的联合疲劳效应。
summary_zh.method: 提出修正的TCD方法，处理小尺度下多个应力集中特征的相互作用。
summary_zh.result: 最优新策略的平均误差在13.7%以内，提高了疲劳寿命预测精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过含缺陷SLM Ti-6Al-4V试样的疲劳实验数据验证模型。

summary_en.motivation: To adapt the Theory of Critical Distances for fatigue assessment of SLM Ti-6Al-4V by addressing multiple stress-rising features at small scales.
summary_en.method: Modified TCD strategies were developed to model combined effects of surface roughness and internal defects below the critical distance length.
summary_en.result: The optimal novel strategy achieved average prediction errors of 13.7% or better.
summary_en.validation: The model was validated against fatigue experiments on SLM Ti-6Al-4V specimens with engineered defects and surface roughness.

title: An approximate control variates approach to multifidelity distribution estimation
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于近似控制变量的多保真度分布估计方法，可高效解决仿真采样效率问题，适用于不确定性量化，但未涉及植入物力学或生物力学设计的具体应用。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant or biomechanics design, lacks experimental validation in a biomedical context, and focuses on general PDEs and SDEs rather than constrained optimization or point predictions.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效估计复杂仿真模型的输出分布，以支持鲁棒设计。
summary_zh.method: 利用低保真度模型构建近似控制变量，自适应选择模型子集估计累计分布函数。
summary_zh.result: 所提估计器一致且渐近最优，适用于多维输出。
summary_zh.validation: 通过参数化PDE和随机微分方程数值算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: Efficient estimation of the full distribution of quantities of interest from expensive simulations is critical for robust design.
summary_en.method: A general multifidelity framework using approximate control variates from lower-fidelity surrogates selects cost-effective model subsets to estimate the cumulative distribution function.
summary_en.result: The resulting estimator is uniformly consistent and asymptotically optimal as the budget grows, with mild assumptions.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on parametric PDEs and stochastic differential equations, including both academic and engineering examples.

title: Gaussian Max-Value Entropy Search for Multi-Agent Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种高效的多智能体贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移至生物力学设计中的代理辅助优化问题。

summary_zh.motivation: 解决多智能体贝叶斯优化中熵搜索计算成本高的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出高斯最大值熵搜索，用正态分布近似函数最大值
summary_zh.result: 在多智能体BO基线和真实机器人源搜索中表现优异
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值测试函数和真实机器人实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To address the high computational cost of entropy search in multi-agent Bayesian optimization.
summary_en.method: Proposed Gaussian Max-value Entropy Search, approximating the function maximum with a normal distribution.
summary_en.result: Outperformed multi-agent BO baselines on numerical and real-robot source-seeking tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard test functions and real-robot experiments.

title: Adaptive Gaussian Process Regression for Efficient Building of Surrogate Models in Inverse Problems

why_not_core: No specific application to implant or biomechanics problems; no experimental or numerical validation in the presented work

summary_zh.motivation: 针对逆问题中昂贵仿真构建代理模型，需平衡精度与计算成本
summary_zh.method: 提出自适应高斯过程回归，序贯优化采样点位置和精度
summary_zh.result: 在有限预算下找到最优实验设计
summary_zh.validation: 基于先验误差估计的理论分析

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently build surrogate models for inverse problems with costly finite element simulations by balancing accuracy and computational effort.
summary_en.method: An adaptive Gaussian process regression algorithm that sequentially selects sample points and their accuracy via a constrained convex optimization.
summary_en.result: The proposed method yields an optimal design that maximizes surrogate model improvement per unit computational cost.
summary_en.validation: Theoretical analysis using a priori error estimates and computational effort estimates, without numerical or experimental validation.

title: CoolPINNs: A Physics-informed Neural Network Modeling of Active Cooling in Vascular Systems
relevance_to_user: 该方法虽然应用于热管理，但其PINN框架可迁移至生物力学中的代理建模，但缺少不确定性量化和对约束的处理。

summary_en.motivation: Develop a fast and accurate surrogate model for active cooling in vascular systems using PINNs.

title: Fourier-MIONet: Fourier-enhanced multiple-input neural operators for multiphase modeling of geological carbon sequestration

summary_zh.method: 将MIONet框架与FNO结合，提出傅里叶增强多输入神经算子
summary_zh.result: 参数减少90%，训练快3.5倍，精度与U-FNO相当

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational cost of multiphase flow simulation for geologic carbon sequestration.

summary_en.result: Fourier-MIONet achieves similar prediction accuracy with 90% fewer parameters and 3.5x faster training.

title: An Active Learning Based Robot Kinematic Calibration Framework Using Gaussian Processes

summary_zh.motivation: 为冰月探测器机械臂开发自动、准确、数据高效的标定方法。

summary_en.result: The method demonstrates efficient reduction of required calibration measurements in simulations of 2-DOF, 6-DOF, and 7-DOF arms.

title: Developing a cost-effective emulator for groundwater flow modeling using deep neural operators

title: Neural-BO: A Black-box Optimization Algorithm using Deep Neural Networks

title: Neural Operator Learning for Long-Time Integration in Dynamical Systems with Recurrent Neural Networks

summary_zh.method: 结合神经算子与循环神经网络捕获时间依赖
summary_zh.result: 框架稳定求解并降低插值与外推误差

title: Learning Energy Conserving Dynamics Efficiently with Hamiltonian Gaussian Processes
relevance_to_user: 该论文的哈密顿高斯过程方法可用于代理建模和不确定性量化，可迁移至生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真替代。

summary_zh.result: 在多种数据设置下，成功从短和长轨迹中鲁棒学习哈密顿系统。

summary_en.motivation: To learn Hamiltonian systems from limited, noisy trajectories while accounting for model uncertainty.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process model with decoupled parameterization and an energy-conserving shooting method for robust inference.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated successful learning of Hamiltonian systems from both short and long noisy trajectories.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmarks of Hamiltonian systems.

title: Error convergence and engineering-guided hyperparameter search of PINNs: towards optimized I-FENN performance
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的I-FENN框架结合PINN与有限元方法，其误差收敛和超参数分析对生物医学植入物代理模型构建具有参考价值。

summary_en.method: Use normalizing flows for variational inference in the latent space of GAN-based functional priors, enabling mini-batch training.
summary_en.result: Normalizing flows achieve comparable accuracy to the gold-standard Hamiltonian Monte Carlo on ODE and Darcy flow problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on a nonlinear ODE and a 100-dimensional Darcy flow problem.

title: Improved uncertainty quantification for neural networks with Bayesian last layer
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种改进的贝叶斯最后一层神经网络不确定性量化方法，可迁移到有限元替代模型中提高预测可靠性，但未直接应用于生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: Does not apply to FEA or biomechanics surrogate modeling; validated only on synthetic data without any physical or engineering benchmark.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准神经网络在安全关键应用中缺乏可靠的不确定性量化
summary_zh.method: 重新参数化贝叶斯最后一层网络的对数边际似然，实现高效反向传播训练，并引入外推度量改进不确定性
summary_zh.result: 提出方法在测试数据上取得最高对数预测密度，优于固定特征贝叶斯线性回归和变分推断贝叶斯神经网络
summary_zh.validation: 在模拟数据集上对比基准方法验证预测密度性能

summary_en.motivation: Standard neural networks lack reliable uncertainty quantification for safety-critical applications, motivating Bayesian approaches that are often computationally intractable.
summary_en.method: We reformulate the log-marginal likelihood of a neural network with a Bayesian last layer to enable efficient training via backpropagation, and derive an extrapolation metric to improve uncertainty quantification for out-of-distribution points.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves the highest log-predictive density on test data compared to Bayesian linear regression with fixed features and a variational inference Bayesian neural network.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated through a simulation study with multivariate data, comparing predictive performance against standard Bayesian baselines.

title: Data-driven reduced-order modelling for blood flow simulations with geometry-informed snapshots
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了基于几何信息的降阶代理模型，可迁移至生物力学或植入物设计的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not address structural mechanics, implant-specific constraints, or uncertainty quantification; it focuses on hemodynamics. FEA surrogate for implant design requires extension to solid mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决血流模拟中几何参数化及计算效率低下的问题
summary_zh.method: 基于曲面配准构建几何感知快照，结合POD和RBF建立非侵入式降阶模型
summary_zh.result: 在狭窄和分叉血流案例中实现高效准确的代理预测
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个血流模拟案例进行了数值验证

summary_en.motivation: Parametric reduced-order models for hemodynamics struggle with unparameterized patient-specific geometries, motivating a data-driven surrogate that can handle shape variations.
summary_en.method: A non-intrusive reduced-order model is constructed by using group surface registration to parameterize shapes and formulating geometry-informed snapshots via diffeomorphisms, followed by POD for dimension reduction and RBF interpolation for coefficient prediction.
summary_en.result: The surrogate accurately predicts blood flow in stenosis and bifurcation cases with significant computational speedup, enabling potential real-time simulation.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation on two distinct blood flow scenarios (stenosis and bifurcation) demonstrates accuracy and efficiency.

title: RecFNO: a resolution-invariant flow and heat field reconstruction method from sparse observations via Fourier neural operator
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的傅里叶神经算子方法可用于从稀疏观测重建全场，对生物力学有限元分析的代理建模有参考价值，但未涉及约束处理或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on flow and heat field reconstruction from sparse observations, not on structural FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 从稀疏观测数据重建完整物理场，支持系统监测与设计。
summary_zh.method: 提出RecFNO，采用MLP/掩码/Voronoi嵌入和傅里叶层实现无穷维空间映射。
summary_zh.result: 相比POD和CNN方法精度更高，支持零样本超分辨率。
summary_zh.validation: 在流体力学和热学数值问题上验证重建效果与网格迁移性。

summary_en.motivation: To recover full physical fields from sparse observations for monitoring and design of physical systems.
summary_en.method: RecFNO uses three types of sparse observation embeddings (MLP, mask, Voronoi) and stacked Fourier layers to learn a mapping in infinite-dimensional space, enabling resolution-invariant reconstruction.
summary_en.result: The method outperforms POD-based and CNN-based methods on fluid and heat problems, achieving zero-shot super-resolution with high accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validated numerically on fluid mechanics and thermology benchmark problems, demonstrating accuracy and resolution transferability.

title: Quantifying uncertainty for deep learning based forecasting and flow-reconstruction using neural architecture search ensembles
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于神经网络架构搜索的集成不确定性量化方法，可迁移至代理模型中的预测不确定性估计。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply surrogate modeling to expensive finite element simulations, does not handle design constraints or optimization, and targets fluid dynamics forecasting rather than solid mechanics or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统深度学习模型缺乏不确定性估计，限制了其在决策中的可信度。
summary_zh.method: 提出可扩展的神经架构搜索方法，结合遗传算法和贝叶斯优化生成集成模型并分解方差。
summary_zh.result: 在海表温度预测和流场重建任务中，集成模型性能优于单个高性能模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过海表温度数据集的数值基准测试验证。

summary_en.motivation: Deep neural network models for forecasting and signal reconstruction often lack uncertainty estimates, crucial for trustworthy downstream decisions.
summary_en.method: An automated neural architecture search framework using genetic algorithms and Bayesian optimization constructs an ensemble of models, with variance decomposition for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The ensemble approach outperforms individual high-performing models on sea-surface temperature forecasting and flow reconstruction tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems using real-world sea-surface temperature data.

title: Non-rigid Medical Image Registration using Physics-informed Neural Networks
relevance_to_user: 该论文使用物理信息神经网络用于生物力学建模，可迁移至植入物设计的代理模型，但主要针对图像配准而非优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification for surrogate modeling in design optimization; it focuses on image registration with biomechanical constraints.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用物理约束提高医学图像配准的生物力学合理性
summary_zh.method: 采用PINN结合线性弹性模型和PointNet实现患者特异性配准
summary_zh.result: 在患者间和患者内配准中均有效
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床前列腺图像数据进行患者特异性验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve biomechanical plausibility of medical image registration using physics-informed constraints
summary_en.method: A PINN-based 3D linear elastic model coupled with PointNet for invariant feature extraction
summary_en.result: Demonstrated effective patient-specific and multi-patient registration
summary_en.validation: Validated on clinical prostate imaging data

title: Adaptive Sparse Gaussian Process
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种自适应稀疏高斯过程方法，能高效处理非平稳数据并具有不确定性量化能力，可迁移到有限元代理建模中提高采样效率。
why_not_core: This paper does not apply the method to any FEA or biomechanics design problem, nor does it handle constraints or demonstrate transfer to implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 需要一种计算成本低且能适应非平稳环境的稀疏高斯过程
summary_zh.method: 引入遗忘因子并每次仅更新一个诱导点以实现自适应稀疏GP
summary_zh.result: 在非平稳环境中快速收敛，置信区间估计优于对比方法
summary_zh.validation: 在数值基准数据集上比较预测后验均值和置信区间

summary_en.motivation: Efficient adaptive Gaussian process methods are needed for non-stationary environments with low computational cost.
summary_en.method: A variational sparse GP is made adaptive by a forgetting factor, and only a single inducing point is updated per new sample.
summary_en.result: The proposed algorithm achieves fast convergence and better confidence interval estimation than state-of-the-art approaches.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmark datasets comparing predictive mean and confidence intervals.

title: Credal Bayesian Deep Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种基于credal集的贝叶斯深度学习不确定性量化方法，可迁移至FEA替代模型的UQ任务。
why_not_core: Does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency or constraint handling; not applied to FEA surrogate or biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 更好区分BNN中的不同不确定性来源，提高鲁棒性
summary_zh.method: 利用有限生成credal集训练无限BNN集成，输出后验集进行不确定性量化
summary_zh.result: 优于单个BNN和集成在区分偶然与认知不确定性，运动预测和血糖控制表现更好
summary_zh.validation: 在自动驾驶运动预测和人工胰腺血糖控制案例上验证

summary_en.motivation: To better distinguish different sources of predictive uncertainty in Bayesian neural networks and improve robustness to distribution shifts.
summary_en.method: Uses finitely generated credal sets to train an infinite ensemble of BNNs and output a set of posteriors for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: Outperforms single BNNs and ensembles in disentangling aleatoric and epistemic uncertainties; demonstrates better performance on motion prediction and blood glucose modeling.
summary_en.validation: Validated on two case studies: motion prediction in autonomous driving and blood glucose-insulin dynamics for artificial pancreas control.

title: Advanced Soft Robotic System for In Situ 3D Bioprinting and Endoscopic Surgery
first_author_affiliation: Graduate School of Biomedical Engineering Faculty of Engineering UNSW Sydney  Kensington Campus Sydney NSW 2052 Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Thanh Nho
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Graduate School of Biomedical Engineering Faculty of Engineering UNSW Sydney  Kensington Campus Sydney NSW 2052 Australia

relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了用于原位生物打印的柔性机器人系统，采用学习控制器，与AI驱动生物打印方向相关，但主要关注机器人控制而非打印过程智能化。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on robotic system design and control for in situ bioprinting, but does not integrate AI into bioprinting workflow stages beyond basic control, lacks autonomous decision-making in bioprinting.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决传统体外生物打印的移植损伤和表面不匹配问题
summary_zh.method: 设计柔性机器人臂集成软打印头，采用运动学逆模型和学习控制器
summary_zh.result: 在结肠模型和猪组织上成功实现多层生物材料原位打印
summary_zh.validation: 通过结肠模型和新鲜猪组织实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome issues of surface mismatch and tissue damage in conventional in vitro bioprinting by enabling in situ bioprinting inside the body.
summary_en.method: Developed a flexible soft robotic printer (F3DB) with a high-DOF printing head, controlled by a kinematic inversion model and learning-based controllers.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated multilayered biomaterial deposition on various surfaces and a colon phantom, and endoscopic surgery on fresh porcine tissue.
summary_en.validation: Validated through phantom tests and ex vivo porcine tissue experiments.

title: Rapid Design of Top-Performing Metal-Organic Frameworks with Qualitative Representations of Building Blocks
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的潜变量高斯过程结合多目标贝叶斯优化方法可扩展到生物力学设计中的分类变量优化问题，但未涉及有限元仿真或植入物设计。
why_not_core: No finite element analysis, no biomechanical or implant context, and no constraint handling demonstrated.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效设计高性能金属有机框架材料，解决组合优化挑战。
summary_zh.method: 集成潜变量高斯过程和多目标批量贝叶斯优化，无需物理描述符。
summary_zh.result: 仅探索1%设计空间即识别出所有Pareto前沿及97%的顶级候选。
summary_zh.validation: 基于CO2吸附数据集与随机森林对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient discovery of high-performance metal-organic frameworks by addressing the combinatorial challenge of categorical building blocks.
summary_en.method: Integrated Latent Variable Gaussian Processes with Multi-Objective Batch-Bayesian Optimization for automated and interpretable design space exploration.
summary_en.result: The approach identified all Pareto-optimal MOFs and over 97% of the top 50 candidates by exploring only ~1% of the design space.
summary_en.validation: Validated against Random Forest on a dataset of 47,000 MOFs for CO2 capture performance.

key_terms.zh: 多目标批量贝叶斯优化

title: Properties Evaluations of Topology Optimized Functionally Graded Lattice Structures Fabricated by Selective Laser Melting
first_author_affiliation: Institute of Manufacturing Engineering, Huaqiao University, Xiamen 361021, China

corresponding_authors.name: Yangli Xu
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Institute of Manufacturing Engineering, Huaqiao University, Xiamen 361021, China

relevance_to_user: 本文研究了面向骨科应用的功能梯度点阵结构的SLM制备与力学性能，涉及刚度匹配和能量吸收，但缺少疲劳与骨整合评估。
why_not_core: This paper does not evaluate fatigue performance, surface roughness for osseointegration, or explicitly address stress shielding in a biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 设计并制造具有可调力学性能的梯度点阵结构，以满足不同应用场景的需求。
summary_zh.method: 采用拓扑优化设计均匀与梯度点阵结构，并通过SLM技术制备，结合有限元与压缩实验评估性能。
summary_zh.result: 梯度点阵结构表现出分层混合变形，能量吸收能力随相对密度增大而增加，建立了预测力学性能的数学模型。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验与有限元结果对比，验证了数学模型预测偏差小于10%。

summary_en.motivation: To design and fabricate functionally graded lattice structures (FGLSs) with tailored mechanical properties for applications including orthopedics.
summary_en.method: Two uniform and two graded lattice designs were created via topology optimization, manufactured by selective laser melting (SLM), and evaluated through finite element simulations and compression tests.
summary_en.result: FGLSs exhibited layer-wise mixed deformation; energy absorption capacity increased with relative density; mathematical models predicted mechanical properties with deviations below 10%.
summary_en.validation: Experimental compression tests validated the finite element models and mathematical predictions, confirming accuracy within 10% error.

title: Black-Box Batch Active Learning for Regression
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出一种黑盒批主动学习方法，可用于提高代理模型的采样效率，但未涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling in the context of FEA, does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization, and lacks uncertainty quantification or biomechanics application.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决大型未标注数据集上高效训练回归模型的问题
summary_zh.method: 提出仅依赖模型预测的黑盒批主动学习方法，扩展白盒方法到黑盒模型
summary_zh.result: 在回归数据集上达到与白盒深度学习方法相当的强性能
summary_zh.validation: 在多个回归数据集上与其他主动学习方法对比

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently train regression models on large unlabeled datasets by reducing the number of labels needed through batch active learning.
summary_en.method: Proposes a black-box batch active learning method that uses only model predictions, extending white-box methods like BADGE, BAIT, and LCMD to non-differentiable models.
summary_en.result: Achieves competitive performance on regression datasets compared to state-of-the-art white-box deep learning methods.
summary_en.validation: Evaluated on multiple standard regression benchmark datasets against other active learning methods.

title: Unleashing the Potential of Acquisition Functions in High-Dimensional Bayesian Optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了高维贝叶斯优化中采集函数最大化初始化的影响，其方法可迁移至植入物设计优化中的昂贵仿真采样问题。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA validation, biomechanical constraints, or uncertainty quantification in implant design; it focuses on general high-dimensional BO with synthetic benchmarks.

summary_zh.motivation: 高维贝叶斯优化中采集函数最大化初始化的影响被忽视。
summary_zh.method: 提出使用多个启发式优化器利用历史数据生成初始点。
summary_zh.result: 该方法在合成函数和实际应用中显著提升标准BO性能。
summary_zh.validation: 在多种合成函数和真实应用上进行大规模实证比较。

summary_en.motivation: The impact of acquisition function maximizer initialization in high-dimensional Bayesian optimization is largely understudied.
summary_en.method: A novel initialization approach employing multiple heuristic optimizers and historical data to generate initial points for acquisition function maximization.
summary_en.result: The proposed simple techniques significantly enhance standard Bayesian optimization and outperform state-of-the-art methods on most test cases.
summary_en.validation: Extensive empirical evaluation on synthetic benchmark functions and real-world applications demonstrates the effectiveness.

title: Trieste: Efficiently Exploring The Depths of Black-box Functions with TensorFlow
relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了基于TensorFlow的贝叶斯优化工具，可迁移至有限元替代模型的采样效率优化，但未涉及约束处理与生物力学设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发可扩展的贝叶斯优化库，提升黑箱函数探索效率。
summary_zh.method: 基于TensorFlow集成高斯过程模型实现序贯决策。
summary_zh.result: 提供了模块化、生产就绪的贝叶斯优化工具包。
summary_zh.validation: 通过全面的测试套件验证软件正确性。

summary_en.motivation: The motivation is to develop a scalable and efficient open-source Bayesian optimization library leveraging TensorFlow.
summary_en.method: The method integrates TensorFlow-based models like Gaussian processes and neural networks into a modular sequential decision-making framework.
summary_en.result: The result is a production-ready and research-friendly toolkit with comprehensive documentation and testing.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed through a comprehensive test suite ensuring software correctness and reliability.

title: Tensorial parametric model order reduction of nonlinear dynamical systems
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的张量参数模型降阶方法对提升有限元代理模型的效率具有潜在可迁移性，但未涉及植入物设计或生物力学约束。
why_not_core: This paper does not address implant biomechanics, does not handle design constraints, and lacks uncertainty quantification; it focuses on generic nonlinear dynamical systems without FEA or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 针对参数依赖的非线性动力系统，提出张量参数降阶模型以提高预测效率。
summary_zh.method: 采用张量低秩近似替代截断SVD，结合POD-DEIM构建参数局部化降阶模型。
summary_zh.result: 张量降阶模型在未见参数值上具有预测能力，且在线计算成本仅依赖于压缩秩。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个参数依赖的非线性动力系统数值算例验证了方法的性能。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently predict the dynamics of nonlinear dynamical systems that depend on parameters, a tensorial parametric model order reduction method is introduced.
summary_en.method: The method employs low-rank tensor approximations (canonical polyadic, Tucker, tensor train) in place of truncated SVD within a POD-DEIM framework, resulting in a parameter-localized reduced model.
summary_en.result: The tensorial reduced-order model achieves prediction for unseen parameters, reduces reduced-space dimensions, and has online costs dependent only on tensor compression ranks.
summary_en.validation: Performance is assessed on two numerical examples of parameter-dependent nonlinear dynamical systems.

title: Robust expected improvement for Bayesian optimization
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种鲁棒贝叶斯优化方法，可迁移到耗时的有限元仿真替代模型优化中，但未直接涉及生物医学植入物设计。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA surrogate modeling for implant design, nor does it handle constraints or uncertainty quantification in a biomechanics context.

summary_zh.motivation: 贝叶斯优化标准采集函数无法找到鲁棒最优解。
summary_zh.method: 提出鲁棒期望改进（REI）采集函数，集成对抗性目标。
summary_zh.result: 在合成和实际问题上优于标准EI等基准方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过多个数值基准测试和实际优化问题验证。

summary_en.motivation: Standard acquisition functions in Bayesian optimization fail to identify robust optima that lie in wide domains of attraction.
summary_en.method: A robust expected improvement (REI) acquisition function is proposed by incorporating an adversarial objective within the GP-based Bayesian optimization framework.
summary_en.result: REI outperforms standard EI and other competitors on both synthetic benchmarks and real-world optimization problems.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on benchmark functions and real problems of varying complexity are conducted to demonstrate the effectiveness.

title: Learning-based solutions to nonlinear hyperbolic PDEs: Empirical insights on generalization errors
relevance_to_user: 该方法使用物理信息傅里叶神经算子求解非线性双曲PDE，适用于有限元代理建模中的复杂PDE求解，但未涉及生物医学或植入物力学。
why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA-based implant mechanics, lacks biomedical context, and does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究使用神经算子学习非线性双曲PDE弱解的泛化误差
summary_zh.method: 采用物理信息傅里叶神经算子并引入正则化项改进不连续性预测
summary_zh.result: 泛化误差随输入复杂度线性增长，物理信息正则化改善间断预测
summary_zh.validation: 以LWR交通流模型为例进行数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the generalization error of neural operators when learning weak solutions to nonlinear hyperbolic PDEs with discontinuities.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed Fourier Neural Operator (π-FNO) with a regularization term is employed to capture discontinuities and quantify out-of-sample errors.
summary_en.result: The generalization error increases linearly with input complexity, and the physics-informed regularizer improves prediction of discontinuities.
summary_en.validation: Empirical validation is performed on the Lighthill-Whitham-Richards traffic flow model.

title: Learning Neural Operators on Riemannian Manifolds
relevance_to_user: 该方法可迁移到植介入器械的复杂曲面建模，但未涉及约束优化或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not demonstrate application to implant biomechanics, does not handle constraints or uncertainty quantification, and lacks validation on biomedical FEA problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 学习定义在复杂几何域（流形）上的函数映射是算子学习的挑战。
summary_zh.method: 提出NORM，利用拉普拉斯特征函数子空间将函数映射转化为有限维映射，保持离散无关性。
summary_zh.result: NORM在多个流形容器上取得SOTA，具有普适近似性质。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准流形（球面、环面）上进行数值实验，对比FNO、DeepONet等。

summary_en.motivation: Learning mappings between functions defined on complex geometries (manifolds) is a challenge for operator learning.
summary_en.method: NORM generalizes neural operators from Euclidean spaces to Riemannian manifolds by mapping functions to a finite-dimensional subspace of Laplacian eigenfunctions, preserving discretization independence.
summary_en.result: NORM achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple manifold benchmarks and possesses universal approximation properties.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on standard manifolds (sphere, torus) comparing against FNO and DeepONet.

title: Score-based Diffusion Models in Function Space
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的函数空间扩散模型有望应用于生成有限元分析中的场变量分布，但尚未涉及约束处理和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on generative modeling in function space without explicit treatment of design optimization constraints, uncertainty quantification, or application to biomechanical implant analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 生成函数空间中的高维数据样本
summary_zh.method: 提出去噪扩散算子（DDO），将扩散模型推广到无限维函数空间
summary_zh.result: 在固定计算成本下生成高分辨率函数样本，数值实验验证了有效性
summary_zh.validation: 在Navier-Stokes方程、InSAR和MNIST-SDF等函数数据上测试

summary_en.motivation: To generate high-dimensional functional data samples beyond finite Euclidean spaces.
summary_en.method: Proposes Denoising Diffusion Operators (DDOs) that generalize diffusion models to infinite-dimensional function spaces using Gaussian processes and function-valued Langevin dynamics.
summary_en.result: Achieves resolution-independent sampling with fixed computational cost, demonstrated on Navier-Stokes, InSAR, and MNIST-SDF.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on scientific and geometric functional data.

title: Scalable Bayesian optimization with high-dimensional outputs using randomized prior networks
relevance_to_user: 该方法可转移到植入物设计中的高维输出贝叶斯优化问题，但未涉及生物力学场景。
why_not_core: no biomedical or implant design context, no experimental validation in biomechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决高维输出下的昂贵黑箱函数全局优化问题
summary_zh.method: 基于随机先验网络的深度集成代理模型与多采样采集函数
summary_zh.result: 在多个高维优化任务中优于现有方法
summary_zh.validation: 标准数值基准与涡轮叶片形状优化案例

summary_en.motivation: To address global optimization of expensive black-box functions with high-dimensional outputs.
summary_en.method: A deep learning framework using bootstrapped ensembles of neural architectures with randomized priors, augmented with parallel acquisition functions and extensions for constraints and multi-fidelity.
summary_en.result: Demonstrated superior performance on several challenging high-dimensional optimization tasks including constrained multi-fidelity shape optimization.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks and a simulation case of rotor blade shape optimization in turbo-machinery.

title: Conditional deep generative models as surrogates for spatial field solution reconstruction with quantified uncertainty in Structural Health Monitoring applications
relevance_to_user: 本文提出了条件变分自编码器作为替代模型，可应用于结构健康监测中的高维随机模拟，其不确定性量化方法对生物力学替代模型有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper focuses on structural health monitoring under stochastic loading and does not directly address implant or biomechanics design, nor does it handle multi-objective constrained optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 为高维随机结构模拟建立高效替代模型以降低计算成本。
summary_zh.method: 采用条件变分自编码器结合卷积神经网络，利用有限元解训练以重建空间场。
summary_zh.result: 模型能高精度重建结构响应并量化载荷不确定性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过两个结构健康监测数值实例验证替代模型性能。

summary_en.motivation: To develop an efficient surrogate model for high-dimensional stochastic structural simulations to reduce computational cost.
summary_en.method: A conditional variational autoencoder with convolutional neural networks is trained on finite element solutions to reconstruct spatial structural response fields.
summary_en.result: The CVAE surrogate achieves high reconstruction accuracy while successfully encoding load uncertainty.
summary_en.validation: Two numerical examples inspired by structural health monitoring applications demonstrate surrogate performance.

title: Uncertainty quantification in coastal aquifers using the multilevel Monte Carlo method
relevance_to_user: 该论文虽聚焦于沿海含水层不确定性量化，但其多层级蒙特卡洛方法可迁移至植入物设计中的不确定性问题，提供了高效采样的思路。
why_not_core: Does not involve surrogate modeling, neural operators, or biomechanical implant design; focuses on classical Monte Carlo methods for groundwater flow.

summary_zh.motivation: 对沿海含水层盐碱化问题中的参数不确定性进行高效量化。
summary_zh.method: 采用多层级蒙特卡洛方法结合并行多重网格求解器，在不同空间和时间网格上运行多个场景。
summary_zh.result: 多层级蒙特卡洛方法能有效降低计算和存储成本，并以拟蒙特卡洛方法为参考验证准确性。
summary_zh.validation: 以Henry盐入侵问题为数值基准测试。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently quantify parametric uncertainties in coastal aquifer salinization problems.
summary_en.method: The multilevel Monte Carlo method is employed with a parallel multigrid solver, running multiple scenarios on different spatial and temporal meshes.
summary_en.result: The multilevel Monte Carlo method significantly reduces computational and storage costs, validated against a quasi-Monte Carlo reference solution.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on the benchmark Henry saltwater intrusion problem.

title: Low-dimensional Data-based Surrogate Model of a Continuum-mechanical Musculoskeletal System Based on Non-intrusive Model Order Reduction
relevance_to_user: 该论文直接使用降阶代理模型近似人体上臂有限元模型的变形和应力，与用户的生物力学FEA代理建模方向高度相关。
why_not_core: The paper does not address constraint handling or uncertainty quantification, and lacks experimental validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 有限元模型计算成本高，难以用于实时仿真。
summary_zh.method: 采用PCA、核PCA、自编码器和变分自编码器对状态降维，再用回归方法构建代理模型。
summary_zh.result: 代理模型能以低计算成本高精度近似变形和内部应力。
summary_zh.validation: 通过人体上臂复杂有限元模型验证代理模型的近似精度。

summary_en.motivation: High-fidelity finite element models are computationally expensive, limiting their use in real-time simulation and low-end hardware applications.
summary_en.method: We compare PCA, kernel PCA, autoencoders, and variational autoencoders for dimensionality reduction combined with regression to build surrogate models of a musculoskeletal system.
summary_en.result: The surrogate model accurately approximates deformation and internal stress with significantly reduced computational cost.
summary_en.validation: The approach is validated on a complex finite element model of a human upper arm, demonstrating high approximation quality.

title: Fourier-RNNs for Modelling Noisy Physics Data
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一个结合傅里叶神经算子和RNN的序列模型，可用于处理噪声物理数据，对替代建模任务具有方法上的可迁移性。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling, does not handle constraints or multi-objective optimization, lacks uncertainty quantification, and provides no validation on biomechanics or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 克服传统RNN在有限维空间建模物理数据的局限。
summary_zh.method: 将RNN的隐状态和输入输出映射均定义在傅里叶空间中，与FNO结合。
summary_zh.result: 在处理含噪非马尔可夫数据时优于FNO和经典RNN。
summary_zh.validation: 在偏微分方程数据和合成噪声数据上进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the limitations of classical RNNs operating in finite-dimensional Euclidean spaces when modeling physics-relevant data.
summary_en.method: Proposes Fourier-RNN, which amalgamates RNN architecture with Fourier Neural Operators by learning mappings in Fourier space for both the input-to-output and the hidden state.
summary_en.result: Fourier-RNN matches FNO on clean PDE data and outperforms both FNO and standard RNN on noisy, non-Markovian data.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on PDE solutions and synthetic noisy time-series data.

title: Physics informed WNO
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种无需标记数据的物理信息小波神经算子，可迁移用于力学仿真代理建模，但未涉及生物力学或植入物设计。
why_not_core: The paper does not address implant/biomechanics design, constraint handling, or uncertainty quantification, and its validation is limited to numerical benchmarks without experimental or biomedical context.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低神经算子对标记数据的依赖
summary_zh.method: 基于物理信息的小波神经算子方法
summary_zh.result: 无需标记数据即可预测PDE解
summary_zh.validation: 四个非线性时空系统数值验证

summary_en.motivation: To mitigate the data-hungry nature of deep neural operators and learn PDE solutions without labeled training data.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed Wavelet Neural Operator (WNO) is proposed, which uses wavelet transforms and physical loss to learn solution operators of parametric PDEs in an unsupervised manner.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework effectively predicts solutions of four nonlinear spatiotemporal systems without requiring any observed data.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on four benchmark nonlinear spatiotemporal PDE systems from engineering and science.

title: Fortuna: A Library for Uncertainty Quantification in Deep Learning
relevance_to_user: 该论文提供了深度学习不确定性量化的工具包，可迁移到代理模型的不确定性评估中。
why_not_core: Does not address FEA surrogate modeling, constraint handling, or implant biomechanics applications.

summary_zh.motivation: 简化深度学习中的不确定性量化方法应用与基准测试。
summary_zh.method: 开发开源库Fortuna，集成共形预测和贝叶斯推断等多种不确定性量化技术。
summary_zh.result: 提供了统一框架，使UQ方法更易使用和比较。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准深度学习基准上验证了校准和UQ方法的有效性。

summary_en.motivation: Simplify benchmarking and application of uncertainty quantification methods in deep learning.
summary_en.method: Develop an open-source library named Fortuna that integrates conformal prediction and scalable Bayesian inference for neural networks.
summary_en.result: Provides a coherent framework enabling easier use and comparison of advanced UQ techniques.
summary_en.validation: Validated on standard deep learning benchmarks demonstrating calibration and uncertainty estimation effectiveness.
