relevance_to_user: 本文涉及3D打印多孔Ti合金支架的生物活性玻璃涂层，可增强骨整合，但未涉及应力遮挡或疲劳性能，对用户的多孔植入物设计有参考价值。
why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue behavior, or as-built surface morphology of the porous structure.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高多孔钛合金支架的骨整合能力
summary_zh.method: 采用原位溶胶-凝胶法在3D打印多孔Ti6Al4V支架上涂覆pH中性生物活性玻璃
summary_zh.result: 涂层支架在体外和体内均显著促进骨生长和整合，并提高推出强度
summary_zh.validation: 体外细胞实验和体内动物植入实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve osseointegration of porous titanium alloy scaffolds by adding a bioactive coating.
summary_en.method: A pH-neutral bioactive glass (PSC) coating was applied to 3D-printed porous Ti6Al4V scaffolds via in situ sol-gel method.
summary_en.result: The coated scaffolds showed enhanced hydroxyapatite formation, cell proliferation, osteogenic differentiation, and significantly more bone ingrowth and higher push-out strength in vivo.
summary_en.validation: Validation included in vitro cell assays and in vivo implantation in animals with mechanical push-out testing.

title: IB-UQ: Information bottleneck based uncertainty quantification for neural function regression and neural operator learning
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种高效的不确定性量化方法，可转移到植入物力学代理模型中，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: Does not address constraint handling or multi-objective optimization, and no validation on biomechanics or implant design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 为神经网络和神经算子模型提供高效的不确定性量化方法。
summary_zh.method: 使用信息瓶颈框架，通过置信感知编码器和高斯解码器预测均值和方差。
summary_zh.result: 在含噪数据、外推和算子学习任务中实现了鲁棒预测和可靠不确定性评估。
summary_zh.validation: 在间断函数回归、真实数据集、PDE算子和气候模型上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a computationally efficient uncertainty quantification framework for neural function regression and neural operator learning.
summary_en.method: Proposes an information bottleneck approach with a confidence-aware encoder and Gaussian decoder to predict output means and variances.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates robust predictions and reliable uncertainty evaluation on noisy data, out-of-distribution inputs, and operator learning tasks.
summary_en.validation: Validated on discontinuous function regression, real-world datasets, PDE operator learning, and a large-scale climate model.

title: Building Orientation and Post Processing of Ti6Al4V Produced by Laser Powder Bed Fusion Process
venue: Journal of Manufacturing and Materials Processing
first_author_affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, University of Brescia, Via Branze 38, 25123 Brescia, Italy

corresponding_authors.name: Paola Serena Ginestra
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Department of Mechanical and Industrial Engineering, University of Brescia, Via Branze 38, 25123 Brescia, Italy

relevance_to_user: 该论文关注LPBF Ti6Al4V的表面改性和生物相容性，未涉及应力遮挡或力学性能匹配。
why_not_core: It does not quantify stress shielding, stiffness matching, or include mechanical testing (fatigue/static) of porous implants; instead focuses on surface biocompatibility and post-processing effects.

summary_zh.motivation: 探究SLM构建方向和后处理对Ti6Al4V表面生物相容性的影响。
summary_zh.method: 制备0°和45°构建方向的SLM样品，并进行阳极氧化和钝化处理。
summary_zh.result: 钝化处理提高矿化，阳极氧化有细胞毒性，构建方向影响细胞附着。
summary_zh.validation: 通过成骨细胞附着、矿化和骨整合实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the influence of building orientation and post-processing methods on the biocompatibility of SLM-fabricated Ti6Al4V for orthopedic implants.
summary_en.method: Ti6Al4V samples were fabricated by SLM at 0° and 45° building orientations and subsequently treated by anodization or passivation.
summary_en.result: Passivation enhanced mineralization over time, while anodization showed cytotoxicity; building orientation affected osteoblast attachment and osseointegration.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell assays including osteoblast attachment, mineralization, and osseointegration over extended culture periods.

title: Surrogate uncertainty estimation for your time series forecasting black-box: learn when to trust
relevance_to_user: 该方法提出了一种通用的不确定性量化框架，可迁移至代理建模场景，但需额外验证其在FEA和生物力学设计中的适用性。
why_not_core: No demonstration on FEA or biomechanics problems; validated only on time series forecasting, lacking simulation context and constraint handling.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决时间序列预测模型中缺失不确定性估计的问题
summary_zh.method: 用高斯过程代理模型为任意基础回归模型提供不确定性估计
summary_zh.result: 在中等数据量下，置信区间准确性优于Bootstrap和内置方法
summary_zh.validation: 在多个时间序列数据集上用多种基础模型验证

summary_en.motivation: To equip black-box time series forecasting models with reliable uncertainty estimates for better risk management and decision-making.
summary_en.method: A surrogate Gaussian process model is trained on the residuals of the base model to produce uncertainty estimates without data-specific assumptions.
summary_en.result: The surrogate-based method yields significantly more accurate confidence intervals than bootstrap and built-in methods across various base models in a medium-data regime.
summary_en.validation: Empirically validated on multiple time series datasets using linear regression, ARIMA, gradient boosting, and neural networks.

title: Multi-fidelity microstructure-induced uncertainty quantification by advanced Monte Carlo methods
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的多保真蒙特卡洛方法可用于生物力学有限元模拟的不确定量化，提高代理模型的采样效率。
why_not_core: Does not address implant/biomechanics design or constraint handling; focused on crystal plasticity of materials.

summary_zh.motivation: 晶体塑性有限元中微观结构变化带来的计算昂贵不确定性量化问题
summary_zh.method: 采用多水平蒙特卡洛和多指标蒙特卡洛方法，自适应利用不同保真度层次
summary_zh.result: 显著减少达到指定精度所需的微观结构样本数量
summary_zh.validation: 在多晶材料同质化性能预测中验证算法效率

summary_en.motivation: Quantifying microstructure-induced uncertainty in crystal plasticity finite element simulations is computationally expensive due to high fidelity requirements.
summary_en.method: A multi-fidelity uncertainty quantification framework is proposed using multilevel Monte Carlo (MLMC) and multi-index Monte Carlo (MIMC) to adaptively exploit a hierarchy of fidelities including mesh resolution, time-step, and constitutive model.
summary_en.result: The adaptive multi-fidelity approach substantially reduces the number of microstructure samples needed to achieve prescribed accuracy in homogenized material property predictions.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on polycrystalline material examples, demonstrating computational savings compared to single-fidelity Monte Carlo.

title: Combining Synchrotron X-ray Diffraction, Mechanistic Modeling, and Machine Learning for In Situ Subsurface Temperature Quantification during Laser Melting
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出的高斯过程回归替代模型方法可用于生物力学中植入物设计的温度或应力场模拟，具有不确定性量化能力。
why_not_core: Paper focuses on subsurface temperature quantification in additive manufacturing, not on implant biomechanics or stress/strain surrogate modeling for design optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决激光熔化过程中难以直接测量亚表面温度的问题
summary_zh.method: 用高斯过程回归替代模型结合机理模拟和XRD仿真预测温度分布
summary_zh.result: 温度指标不确定性5%-15%，固相最高温度达到固相线
summary_zh.validation: 通过原位同步辐射XRD实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To overcome the challenge of directly measuring subsurface temperature during laser melting in additive manufacturing.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process regression surrogate model is trained on coupled mechanistic simulations (heat transfer and fluid flow) and X-ray diffraction simulations to predict subsurface temperature distribution metrics with uncertainty.
summary_en.result: Temperature metrics are extracted with 5% to 15% uncertainty; maximum solid-phase temperature reaches solidus, while mean and minimum temperatures are hundreds of degrees lower.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed using in situ synchrotron X-ray diffraction measurements on an Inconel 625 wall specimen during laser melting.

title: Randomized Gaussian Process Upper Confidence Bound with Tighter Bayesian Regret Bounds
relevance_to_user: 该方法改进了贝叶斯优化中的置信上限算法，可迁移到FEA代理模型的优化中，但未涉及约束处理或生物力学应用。
why_not_core: No application to FEA surrogate modeling, no handling of constraints, no demonstration on structural or biomechanical optimization.

summary_zh.motivation: 标准GP-UCB置信参数过大且手工指定，易导致过度探索。
summary_zh.method: 提出使用两参数指数分布的改进随机化GP-UCB，理论推导更紧的贝叶斯遗憾界。
summary_zh.result: 算法避免后期过度探索，遗憾界更紧且实验验证有效。
summary_zh.validation: 在合成函数和超参数调优实验上验证算法性能。

summary_en.motivation: The standard GP-UCB suffers from overly large and heuristically chosen confidence parameters, leading to over-exploration.
summary_en.method: An improved randomized GP-UCB (IRGP-UCB) is proposed using a two-parameter exponential distribution, achieving tighter Bayesian regret bounds.
summary_en.result: IRGP-UCB avoids over-exploration in later iterations and provides tighter regret bounds while maintaining effectiveness.
summary_en.validation: Effectiveness is demonstrated through extensive experiments on synthetic functions and hyperparameter tuning tasks.

title: LSA-PINN: Linear Boundary Connectivity Loss for Solving PDEs on Complex Geometry
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过边界连接损失函数提升PINN在复杂几何上的采样效率，可迁移至植入物力学模拟的代理建模。
why_not_core: This paper does not include constraint handling, uncertainty quantification, or validation on implant/biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 现有PINN在复杂几何边界采样困难，过密或过疏均影响训练。
summary_zh.method: 提出线性边界连接损失函数（BCXN），近似边界梯度行为。
summary_zh.result: 在稀疏采样下误差降低数个量级，收敛更快。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准PDE基准上使用MLP和CNN进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing PINNs struggle with boundary sampling on complex geometries, leading to poor convergence or overfitting.
summary_en.method: We propose a linear boundary connectivity loss (BCXN) that approximates gradient behavior at boundaries to improve PINN training.
summary_en.result: The proposed LSA-PINN achieves orders of magnitude lower error with sparser training samples and fewer iterations.
summary_en.validation: The method is validated on standard PDE benchmarks using both MLP and CNN architectures.

title: Supersaturated solid solution enhanced biodegradable Zn-Mn alloys prepared by mechanical alloying and selective laser melting

summary_en.motivation: To develop biodegradable Zn-Mn alloys with enhanced mechanical properties for biomedical implant applications.
summary_en.method: Mechanical alloying was combined with selective laser melting to fabricate supersaturated solid solution Zn-Mn alloys.
summary_en.result: The supersaturated solid solution significantly improved both strength and ductility of the alloy.
summary_en.validation: The study validated the mechanical performance through tensile testing and microstructural characterization.

title: Randomized prior wavelet neural operator for uncertainty quantification
relevance_to_user: 该方法提供的不确定性量化模块可用于植入物/生物力学代理模型，但未涉及约束处理或多目标优化。
why_not_core: No constraint handling, no multi-objective optimization, no application to implant/biomechanics design.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统神经网络算子缺乏不确定性估计能力。
summary_zh.method: 在小波神经算子中引入随机先验网络实现不确定性量化。
summary_zh.result: 在四个算例中验证了该框架的有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值基准算例进行测试。

summary_en.motivation: Standard neural operators lack the ability to quantify prediction uncertainty, limiting their reliability in scientific applications.
summary_en.method: The randomized prior wavelet neural operator extends the wavelet neural operator by integrating randomized prior networks for inherent uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The proposed framework demonstrates effective uncertainty quantification across four benchmark examples.

summary_en.motivation: To enable efficient transfer of knowledge in neural operators across different PDEs with varying parameter fields, addressing the challenge of expensive data acquisition.
summary_en.method: Proposes MetaNO, a meta-learning approach that captures underlying parameter fields in the first layer of neural operator models.
summary_en.result: Demonstrates improved sampling efficiency on unseen tasks and handles complex nonlinear physical response learning.
summary_en.validation: Validated on PDE-based datasets and a real-world material modeling problem.

title: Influences of surface topography of porous titanium scaffolds manufactured by powder bed fusion on osteogenesis

relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了LPBF制造的钛合金多孔支架的表面形貌对成骨分化的影响，但与应力遮挡和力学性能无直接关联。
why_not_core: This paper does not include mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or stress shielding evaluation, which are central to the user's direction.

summary_zh.method: 使用PBF制备不同孔形状的Ti-6Al-4V支架，分析曲率和粗糙度，并进行体外细胞实验。
summary_zh.result: 孔形状改变表面曲率和粗糙度，进而影响成骨细胞的增殖与分化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验验证表面形貌对成骨活性的影响。

summary_en.motivation: To understand how pore shape influences surface topography and subsequently bone ingrowth in PBF-manufactured titanium scaffolds.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V scaffolds with circular, triangular, and rectangular pores were fabricated via PBF; surface curvature and roughness were analyzed, and Saos-2 cell behavior was assessed in vitro.
summary_en.result: Pore shape significantly alters local curvature and roughness, which correlates with differences in osteoblast proliferation and differentiation.
summary_en.validation: In vitro cell culture assays using Saos-2 cells provided experimental validation of the biological response to surface topography.

title: Bounding Box-based Multi-objective Bayesian Optimization of Risk Measures under Input Uncertainty
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了在输入不确定性下进行多目标贝叶斯优化的方法，可转移到生物力学代理模型的多目标约束优化中。
why_not_core: No FEA surrogate validation, no biomechanics or implant design context.

summary_zh.motivation: 高效识别输入不确定性下黑箱函数风险度量的帕累托前沿。
summary_zh.method: 基于高斯过程构建风险度量高概率边界框，利用最大化最小距离准则选点。
summary_zh.result: 理论证明有限步内返回任意精确解，数值实验优于现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 通过标准数值基准测试验证算法效果。

summary_en.motivation: To efficiently identify the Pareto front defined by risk measures for black-box functions under input uncertainty.
summary_en.method: Proposes a bounding box-based multi-objective Bayesian optimization using Gaussian process models and a maximin distance acquisition function to reduce uncertainty.
summary_en.result: Provides theoretical guarantees of convergence and demonstrates superior performance over existing methods in numerical experiments.
summary_en.validation: Validated on numerical benchmark problems with input uncertainty.

title: The multifaceted nature of uncertainty in structure-property linkage with crystal plasticity finite element model
relevance_to_user: 本文讨论了晶体塑性有限元模型中的不确定性量化方法，与用户对FEA代理模型及生物力学设计的兴趣有一定可转移性。
why_not_core: This paper does not present a surrogate model, does not address computational sampling efficiency, and lacks implant or biomechanics application.

summary_zh.motivation: 量化晶体塑性有限元模型中多种不确定性来源以提高模型可信度。
summary_zh.method: 综述不确定性量化、优化及机器学习在CPFEM中的应用。
summary_zh.result: 指出了当前研究热点及未来方向。
summary_zh.validation: 无具体验证，为文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: To address aleatory and epistemic uncertainties in crystal plasticity finite element models for reliable integrated computational materials engineering.
summary_en.method: This survey highlights ongoing research on uncertainty quantification, optimization, and machine learning applied to CPFEM for solving forward and inverse problems.
summary_en.result: The paper outlines key challenges and opportunities in UQ for CPFEM but does not present new numerical results.
summary_en.validation: No experimental or numerical validation is reported as the paper is a literature review.

title: Gaussian process regression and conditional Karhunen-Loéve models for data assimilation in inverse problems
relevance_to_user: 该方法在数据同化中通过降维提高计算效率，可迁移至植入物设计的参数估计和不确定性量化。
why_not_core: This paper does not address forward surrogate modelling for implant or biomechanics FEA; it focuses on inverse parameter estimation in subsurface flow.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高偏微分方程模型中空间异质参数场反演的计算效率。
summary_zh.method: 利用高斯过程回归构建条件KL展开，将参数场降维后同化状态观测值。
summary_zh.result: CKLEMAP方法执行时间随节点数超线性增长，优于标准MAP的二次方增长。
summary_zh.validation: 在二维稳态地下水流模型中使用合成数据验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost of estimating spatially heterogeneous parameter fields in PDE models by dimensionality reduction.
summary_en.method: Conditional Karhunen-Loéve expansions are constructed from Gaussian process regression of parameter measurements, and MAP estimation is performed on the reduced coefficients.
summary_en.result: CKLEMAP achieves near-linear scaling with mesh size, significantly outperforming standard MAP in execution time while maintaining accuracy.
summary_en.validation: Validation on a synthetic 2D steady-state subsurface flow problem with transmissivity and hydraulic head measurements.

title: A Hybrid Deep Neural Operator/Finite Element Method for Ice-Sheet Modeling
relevance_to_user: 该方法将DeepONet与有限元结合，适用于生物力学设计中的昂贵仿真加速与不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No biomedical context, no implant design, no contact mechanics or bone mechanics validation.

summary_zh.motivation: 提高冰盖模型计算效率以支持不确定性量化。
summary_zh.method: 用DeepONet替代有限元动量方程，保留厚度有限元离散。
summary_zh.result: 混合模型精度高，速度提升一个数量级。
summary_zh.validation: 合成冰盖模型和Humboldt冰川仿真案例。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce computational cost of ice sheet models for probabilistic sea level projections.
summary_en.method: Replace FEM momentum equations with a Deep Operator Network, retaining FEM for ice thickness evolution.
summary_en.result: Hybrid model achieves high accuracy and one order of magnitude speedup.
summary_en.validation: Tested on synthetic ice sheet model and Humboldt glacier simulation.

title: Koopman neural operator as a mesh-free solver of non-linear partial differential equations
relevance_to_user: 提出了一种基于Koopman算子的神经算子，作为网格无关的PDE求解器，可迁移至生物力学FEA代理建模。

summary_zh.motivation: 现有神经算子对非线性PDE长期行为预测精度和可解释性不足。
summary_zh.method: 用Koopman算子近似动态系统的流映射，将非线性PDE求解转化为线性预测问题。
summary_zh.result: 在多个PDE和真实动态系统上实现网格无关、长期和零样本预测，优于现有模型。
summary_zh.validation: 在Navier-Stokes等五个PDE基准和真实系统上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Existing neural operators suffer from poor accuracy and explainability when learning long-term behaviors of nonlinear PDE families.
summary_en.method: The Koopman neural operator approximates the Koopman operator acting on the flow mapping of the nonlinear dynamical system, transforming nonlinear PDE solution into linear prediction problems.
summary_en.result: The KNO achieves mesh-independent, long-term, and zero-shot predictions on five representative PDEs and three real dynamic systems, outperforming prior state-of-the-art models.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on numerical benchmarks (e.g., Navier-Stokes, Rayleigh-Bénard convection) and real-world data (global water vapor patterns, western boundary currents).

summary_zh.motivation: 提高牙种植体设计效率，替代耗时有限元分析
summary_zh.method: 构建U-net、ANN和随机森林组合的深度学习代理模型
summary_zh.result: 组织分化预测准确率82%，AUC高于0.86
summary_zh.validation: 基于不同咬合力与骨属性的35天仿真数据集验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve the efficiency of dental implant design by developing a surrogate model that replaces computationally expensive finite element analysis and mechano-regulation simulations.
summary_en.method: A data-driven deep learning network combining U-net, artificial neural network, and random forest was constructed to predict time-dependent tissue differentiation.
summary_en.result: The surrogate achieved 82% accuracy and AUC above 0.86 for predicting five tissue phenotypes across varying occlusal forces and bone properties.
summary_en.validation: The model was validated on simulated datasets spanning 35 days of healing with multiple boundary conditions.

title: Physics-informed Information Field Theory for Modeling Physical Systems with Uncertainty Quantification
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了一种带不确定量化的物理信息场理论方法，可转移至FEA代理建模，但未直接应用于植入物设计或约束处理。
why_not_core: This paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, does not handle constraints in optimization, and is not validated on implant or biomechanics problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 为物理系统建模提供与数值离散无关的不确定性量化方法
summary_zh.method: 将物理定律编码为信息场理论的函数先验，并采用随机梯度Langevin动力学采样
summary_zh.result: 方法在模型形式错误时仍能鲁棒识别物理不可信区域并退化为回归问题
summary_zh.validation: 通过Klein-Gordon方程及非线性逆问题的数值算例验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a discretization-independent Bayesian inference framework for physical fields that incorporates physical laws and quantifies uncertainty.
summary_en.method: Physics-informed Information Field Theory (PIFT) encodes physical laws into functional priors and uses stochastic gradient Langevin dynamics to sample from the joint posterior over field and parameters.
summary_en.result: The method remains robust under model-form error and automatically transitions to a regression problem when physics is unreliable.
summary_en.validation: Validated on analytical and numerical examples including the Klein-Gordon equation and nonlinear inverse problems with varying degrees of model-form error.

title: Improved generalization with deep neural operators for engineering systems: Path towards digital twin
relevance_to_user: 本文提出的DeepONet方法可用于替代昂贵FEA仿真，但未涉及植入物生物力学约束或不确定性量化。
why_not_core: No implant/biomechanics context, no constraint handling, no uncertainty quantification (point prediction only).

summary_zh.motivation: 提高工程系统数字孪生的代理模型泛化能力。
summary_zh.method: 使用DeepONet学习PDE解算子，采用分支-主干架构。
summary_zh.result: 在ODE和扩散问题上预测精度超0.96，并具备零样本泛化能力。
summary_zh.validation: 在三个数值基准（ODE、扩散、Burgers方程）上验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop generalizable surrogate models for digital twins of engineering systems governed by PDEs.
summary_en.method: DeepONets with branch/trunk architecture are trained to learn solution operators of ODEs, diffusion, and Burgers equation.
summary_en.result: Prediction accuracy exceeds 0.96 on ODE and diffusion problems, with zero-shot generalization to unseen scenarios.
summary_en.validation: Validated on three numerical benchmarks: an ODE system, a diffusion system, and the convection-diffusion Burgers equation.

summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试验证了不同晶粒结构下的性能变化。

summary_en.motivation: This study investigates the effect of boron nitride addition on the microstructure and mechanical properties of Ti-6Al-4V alloy fabricated by selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V-0.5BN (wt%) samples were fabricated via SLM, and the resulting mixed grain structure was characterized.
summary_en.result: The addition of BN led to the formation of a mixed grain structure, which significantly influenced the mechanical properties.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing was performed to validate the changes in properties corresponding to different grain structures.

title: Additively manufactured controlled porous orthopedic joint replacement designs to reduce bone stress shielding: a systematic review.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述多孔关节植入物设计以减少应力屏蔽的现状。
summary_zh.method: 系统检索六个数据库，筛选46篇研究，分类统一、梯度和优化设计。
summary_zh.result: 优化设计最有前景，但缺乏临床证据确定最佳方法。
summary_zh.validation: 无新实验，基于文献综述。

summary_en.motivation: To systematically review current design approaches using controlled porous structures to reduce stress shielding in total joint replacements.
summary_en.method: A systematic literature search in six databases yielded 46 studies, which were categorized into uniform, graded, and optimized porous design strategies.
summary_en.result: Optimized designs, including patient-specific approaches, showed the most promise for stress shielding reduction, but quantitative measures and clinical evidence remain limited.
summary_en.validation: The review synthesizes existing literature without new experimental validation.

summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V microbeams of varying dimensions were fabricated by laser powder bed fusion and subjected to mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Significant size effects were observed, with strength and modulus increasing as beam size decreased.
summary_en.validation: Experimental mechanical testing provided validation of the size-dependent mechanical behavior.

summary_en.method: A finite element model of the sheep stifle was developed to design homogeneous and locally-optimized TTA implants with varying stiffness (0.8, 0.6, 0.3/0.1 GPa), which were then fabricated via LPBF and implanted in an in vivo ovine pilot study for 12 weeks.
summary_en.result: The optimized low-stiffness design (Ti3) exhibited uniform bone ingrowth and greater bone-implant contact compared to homogeneous designs, with higher bone formation scores.

title: On the role of Model Uncertainties in Bayesian Optimization

summary_zh.validation: 在合成函数和真实问题上进行数值实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the impact of model uncertainties on Bayesian optimization performance and the role of uncertainty calibration.
summary_en.method: Compare popular surrogate models and analyze the relationship between calibration error and optimization regret.
summary_en.result: Positive association between calibration and regret disappears when controlling for model type; recalibration generally does not improve regret.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on synthetic functions and real-world experiments.

title: Multi-fidelity error estimation accelerates greedy model reduction of complex dynamical systems

summary_zh.result: 算法收敛速度提升3倍以上且精度损失小。

summary_en.motivation: To accelerate the offline construction of reduced-order models for complex dynamical systems.
summary_en.method: Replace high-fidelity error estimators with multi-fidelity error estimators in the greedy algorithm to reduce computational complexity.
summary_en.result: The algorithm converges more than three times faster without noticeable accuracy loss.
summary_en.validation: Numerical simulations on dynamical systems.

title: Learning Partial Differential Equations by Spectral Approximates of General Sobolev Spaces
relevance_to_user: 该方法是一种高效求解PDE的谱替代模型，可迁移至生物力学FEA替代建模，但未涉及不确定性量化或约束优化。

summary_zh.motivation: 提供高效且精确的PDE求解替代模型，避免传统方法对高性能计算的依赖。
summary_zh.method: 基于切比雪夫多项式构造Sobolev空间的谱近似，结合变分公式求解线性和非线性PDE。
summary_zh.result: 相比PINN，PSM在精度和速度上更优，且无需高性能计算即可求解典型PDE。

summary_en.motivation: To develop an efficient surrogate model for solving PDEs that avoids high-performance computing while maintaining high accuracy.
summary_en.method: A polynomial surrogate model (PSM) based on Chebyshev polynomials approximates general Sobolev spaces and solves PDEs via a variational formulation that yields convex optimization for linear problems.
summary_en.result: The PSM outperforms physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) in both accuracy and runtime, and solves prominent PDEs on a local machine without HPC.
summary_en.validation: Numerical benchmarks on linear and nonlinear PDEs demonstrate exponential convergence and efficiency advantages over PINNs.

summary_zh.result: 所提方法在数值实验和工业锻压案例中优于经典贝叶斯优化。
summary_zh.validation: 通过合成函数和工业锻压案例进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: Target value optimization of stochastic black-box functions is underexplored with existing Bayesian optimization methods focusing on expectation while ignoring output variance.
summary_en.method: We derive acquisition functions for expected improvement, probability of improvement, and lower confidence bound under the assumption of Gaussian aleatoric noise with known variance.
summary_en.result: The proposed acquisition functions outperform classical Bayesian optimization on synthetic benchmarks and an industrial billet forging case, even when the Gaussian assumption is violated.
summary_en.validation: Numerical experiments on synthetic functions and an industrial forging use case validate the approach.

summary_en.motivation: The lack of a complete framework connecting amino acid sequence to material properties hinders the rational design of structural proteins for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Unsupervised data analysis was applied to short molecular dynamics simulations to classify a library of elastin-like polypeptides based on their thermoresponsiveness at physiological temperature.
summary_en.result: The hydrophilicity/hydrophobicity and block distribution of the polypeptides control viscoelasticity and thermoresponsiveness, while concentration defines network permeability.
summary_en.validation: Hydrogels from predicted thermoresponsive polypeptides were experimentally characterized, confirming the predictive model and revealing design handles.

title: Active Learning Guided by Efficient Surrogate Learners
relevance_to_user: 该方法通过高斯过程代理模型实现主动学习，可迁移到有限元代理模型的采样效率优化。
why_not_core: The paper focuses on active learning for deep learning classification benchmarks, with no demonstration on FEA simulations or biomechanical design problems.

summary_zh.motivation: 批量主动学习存在冗余采样，需提高标签效率。
summary_zh.method: 用高斯过程代理更新主神经网络的动态学习过程。
summary_zh.result: 在四个基准数据集上超越或媲美现有方法。
summary_zh.validation: 在标准图像分类数据集上验证。

summary_en.motivation: Batch active learning often leads to redundant labeling, reducing efficiency. This work seeks to improve per-label yield by continuous surrogate updates.
summary_en.method: A Gaussian process surrogate is trained alongside the neural network to emulate its learning dynamics, enabling instance-level updates without full retraining.
summary_en.result: The proposed method achieves competitive or superior performance on four benchmark datasets compared to state-of-the-art batch active learning approaches.
summary_en.validation: Validation is performed on standard classification benchmark datasets (e.g., CIFAR-10, SVHN).

title: Sensitivity analysis using Physics-informed neural networks

summary_zh.motivation: 高效求解参数灵敏度，降低计算成本。

summary_zh.result: 在一维对流扩散、二维泊松及两相流问题中验证了有效性。
summary_zh.validation: 标准数值算例验证。

summary_en.motivation: To perform local sensitivity analysis efficiently using physics-informed neural networks without extra simulation cost.
summary_en.method: A novel loss term that regularizes the solution near the nominal parameter value, making the network output the derivative with respect to that parameter.
summary_en.result: The method successfully computes sensitivities for advection-diffusion, Poisson, and two-phase flow problems.
summary_en.validation: Validated on four numerical benchmarks with known analytical or reference solutions.

title: Stabilized Weighted Reduced Order Methods for Parametrized Advection-Dominated Optimal Control Problems governed by Partial Differential Equations with Random Inputs
relevance_to_user: 该论文提出了带不确定量化的降阶模型方法，可迁移至生物力学中的代理模型构建。

summary_zh.result: 加权ROM显著提升计算效率，同时保持与FEM解接近的精度。
summary_zh.validation: 通过FEM与ROM解的相对误差及加速比进行数值验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce the computational burden of solving parametrized advection-dominated optimal control problems with random inputs.
summary_en.method: A weighted Proper Orthogonal Decomposition reduced order model is combined with offline/online stabilization and multiple quadrature techniques for uncertainty quantification.
summary_en.result: The weighted ROM achieves substantial speedup while maintaining accuracy comparable to the high-fidelity FEM solution.
summary_en.validation: Relative errors between FEM and ROM solutions and speedup indices are used to assess performance.

title: Physics informed neural network for charged particles surrounded by conductive boundaries

summary_en.motivation: To develop a PINN-based surrogate model for predicting electrostatic potentials of charged particles in bounded domains, reducing computational cost of FEM.
summary_en.method: A physics-informed neural network is trained to satisfy Poisson's equation and boundary conditions, compared with random forest and standard neural networks.
summary_en.result: The PINN achieves MSE < 7% and R2 > 90%, with substantial reduction in computation time compared to FEM.
summary_en.validation: Numerical validation against FEM solutions and comparison with machine learning baselines.

summary_zh.motivation: 为了减少植入物与骨之间的界面应变，开发基于烧结钛纤维的可调各向异性生物金属。
summary_zh.method: 采用层叠烧结钛纤维制造六种拓扑结构，进行压缩、三点弯曲和扭转测试，并评估生物相容性和骨整合。
summary_zh.result: 材料表现出高达50 MPa的压缩屈服强度，各向异性与纤维布局相关，体内骨整合良好。
summary_zh.validation: 通过力学测试和羊体内植入实验验证。

summary_en.motivation: To reduce interface strain in orthopedic implants, a fiber-based biometal with tunable anisotropic mechanical properties is developed.
summary_en.method: Layered sintered titanium fibers are used to fabricate six topologies, tested under compression, bending, and torsion, followed by biocompatibility and osseointegration assessment.
summary_en.result: The material exhibits compressive yield strengths up to 50 MPa, strong anisotropy, and excellent osseointegration in a sheep model.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and in vivo implantation in sheep.

title: "Metal-bone" scaffold for accelerated peri-implant endosseous healing.

relevance_to_user: 提供了多孔钛合金支架骨整合的体内数据，但缺乏力学测试和应力屏蔽分析，与髋关节假体设计的相关性有限。

summary_zh.motivation: 为了解决骨缺损修复的临床挑战，需要开发符合临床标准的骨组织工程支架。
summary_zh.method: 将3D打印的多孔Ti6Al4V支架与骨移植技术结合，植入动物股骨3个月后取出，形成'金属-骨'支架再植入。
summary_zh.result: 与单纯多孔钛支架相比，含骨组织的支架在早期阶段加速了骨再生，骨整合效果更优。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外实验和动物体内植入进行验证，但未涉及力学性能测试。
